# Bridging the Gap: Automation as a Tool for Enhancing Team Collaboration

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fj5n7GU6Wl1m0uc8ylDDbaRiew.webp?width=1200&height=1200)

In today’s digital age, the concept of work has undergone a dramatic transformation, with remote work becoming more prevalent than ever before. This shift has necessitated the adoption of new strategies to ensure team collaboration remains strong, despite physical distances. One such strategy that has risen to prominence is the use of automation. Automation tools not only streamline various work processes but also enhance team efficiency and productivity. They reduce the time spent on repetitive tasks, allowing team members to focus more on complex and creative work. This shift towards automation in work collaboration is not just a trend, but a necessary evolution to adapt to the changing dynamics of the workplace.

![task automation for teams](https://framerusercontent.com/images/vRv96TUhV1micwUK5d2yXHtPzA.webp?width=1200&height=1200)

## [How Automation Overcomes Common Collaboration Challenges](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#how-automation-overcomes-common-collaboration-challenges)

Automation is a powerful remedy for many persistent team collaboration challenges, including misaligned communication, delayed responses, lack of project visibility, and low accountability. By centralizing communication channels and automating status updates, automation ensures that all team members receive consistent, real-time information—eliminating the confusion that often arises from fragmented or siloed communication tools. Heightened accountability encourages team members to take ownership of their work, ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks.

## [Key Use Cases and Applications](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#key-use-cases-and-applications)

Since automation streamlines many of the most laborious and error-prone aspects of teamwork, it has become a crucial component of contemporary team cooperation. One common scenario is the synthesis of ideas after team brainstorming sessions. Automated tools can categorize, sort, and summarize input from multiple contributors, making it easier to identify themes, prioritize suggestions, and turn collective insights into actionable plans. In workflow management, automation ensures that tasks are assigned, tracked, and progressed according to predefined rules, reducing manual oversight and preventing bottlenecks. Document sharing is another area where automation shines; platforms can automatically manage version control, grant appropriate access, and notify stakeholders of updates, ensuring everyone works from the latest information. It also helps align teams on project plans by syncing updates across calendars, task boards, and communication tools, so changes in one system are reflected everywhere. These applications not only save time but also foster transparency, accountability, and real-time alignment, which are essential for high-performing teams.

## [The Role of Automation in Team Scheduling and Task Management](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#the-role-of-automation-in-team-scheduling-and-task-management)

### [Simplifying Scheduling with Online Apps](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#simplifying-scheduling-with-online-apps)

The task of [coordinating team schedules](https://cal.com/teams) can often resemble a complex puzzle, especially when managing a remote team across different time zones. Here, online scheduling app platforms come to the rescue, simplifying the process by automating appointment bookings, meeting reminders, and calendar updates. Such platforms enable team members to view each other's availability in real time, making the scheduling of meetings or collaborative sessions a breeze. This not only reduces the back-and-forth emails but also ensures that everyone can find a suitable time slot without hassle, significantly improving team coordination and efficiency.

### [Streamlining Task Assignments](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#streamlining-task-assignments)

Automation in this area ensures tasks are distributed efficiently, according to each team member's workload and expertise. Workflow automation tools can automatically assign tasks based on predefined criteria, eliminating the potential for human error or bias. Moreover, these tools provide a centralized platform where all task-related information is accessible, offering a transparent overview of project progress and individual contributions.

### [Benefits of Automated Scheduling](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#benefits-of-automated-scheduling)

Automated scheduling brings a multitude of benefits to team collaboration. It eradicates the time-consuming process of manual coordination, therefore accelerating decision-making and project initiation. Teams that utilize online calendar management tools experience a noticeable uplift in productivity as these tools ensure optimal allocation of resources and prevent overbooking or double-booking scenarios. Moreover, automated reminders help in reducing missed deadlines and appointments, fostering a culture of punctuality among team members.

## [Enhancing Communication with Collaboration Software](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#enhancing-communication-with-collaboration-software)

### [Selecting the Right Software for Your Team](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#selecting-the-right-software-for-your-team)

With various options available today, it's crucial to pick a platform that not only facilitates easy interaction among team members but also integrates seamlessly with existing workflows and tools. This selection process is pivotal in building a more connected and productive team environment. Here are some key considerations to help guide your choice:

- **Ease of Use:** The [best collaboration software](https://cal.com/) offers an intuitive user interface that team members can quickly adapt to, minimizing the learning curve and reducing the need for extensive training. This ease of use ensures that all team members, regardless of their technical proficiency, can effectively communicate and collaborate. An intuitive platform enhances user adoption rates and enables teams to focus on their tasks rather than struggling with complex software navigation.

- **Integration Capabilities:** High-performing collaboration platforms feature robust integration capabilities with other essential tools and systems your team already utilizes, such as email clients, calendar applications, and project management software. This seamless integration facilitates a more streamlined workflow, allowing for efficient information exchange and project tracking. By choosing a platform that integrates well with existing tools, teams can avoid the pitfalls of disjointed systems and data silos, leading to more cohesive and effective collaboration.

- **Scalability:** Scalability is a critical factor when selecting collaboration software. The chosen platform should be capable of accommodating growth, both in terms of team size and project complexity, without significant performance degradation. This means the software should offer flexible user management options, the ability to add more features or integrations as needed, and the capacity to handle increased data volumes. Scalable software supports long-term growth and adaptation, ensuring that the platform remains a valuable asset as the team evolves.

- **Security Features:** The security of your team's data and communications cannot be overstated. Opt for collaboration software that provides comprehensive security measures, including end-to-end encryption, multi-factor authentication, and regular security audits. These features protect sensitive information from unauthorized access and potential cyber threats, giving your team peace of mind and safeguarding your organization's reputation.

- **Customization:** The ability to customize the collaboration platform according to your team's specific needs and workflows can significantly enhance productivity and user satisfaction. Customization options might include the ability to tailor the user interface, configure notifications, or add custom integrations and features. A customizable platform allows teams to create a more personalized and efficient working environment, aligning the software's functionality with the team's unique requirements and preferences.


Selecting the right collaboration software is a strategic decision that can greatly impact your team's communication, productivity, and overall success. By carefully evaluating each platform against these criteria, you can ensure that you choose a solution that not only meets your current needs but also supports your team's growth and evolution over time.

### [Automation Features that Boost Team Interaction](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#automation-features-that-boost-team-interaction)

Features such as automated meeting summaries, which transcribe discussions and highlight action items, ensure that team members who could not attend can quickly catch up. Polling and feedback tools automated within these platforms allow for quick decision-making and ensure every team member's opinion is considered, promoting a more inclusive work environment. Additionally, task automation can notify members of task dependencies, keeping everyone aligned with project milestones.

## [Automated Project Tracking and Management](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#automated-project-tracking-and-management)

### [Transparency and Accountability](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#transparency-and-accountability)

This transparency ensures that every stakeholder, from team members to clients, has access to the most current project information. Such visibility into the workflow allows for real-time adjustments, ensuring that the project remains on track. Moreover, accountability is heightened when team members can visualize their contributions to the project's progress. This not only motivates individuals to maintain their pace but also fosters a culture of ownership and responsibility.

![collaboration software](https://framerusercontent.com/images/OIGQDkFQJxF2iCSvWg7NMwPezA8.webp?width=1200&height=1200)

### [Improving Project Outcomes](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#improving-project-outcomes)

Employing automated management tools in project workflows directly contributes to enhanced project outcomes. By freeing up project managers and team members to concentrate on strategic decision-making and problem-solving, these tools not only streamline project execution but also improve the quality of the final deliverable. Automated tools also facilitate a deeper analysis of project data, allowing teams to identify trends, anticipate challenges, and implement improvements in future projects.

## [Balancing Automation with Human Expertise](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#balancing-automation-with-human-expertise)

While automation offers undeniable advantages in streamlining workflows and boosting efficiency, maintaining a healthy balance between automated processes and human input is essential for truly effective collaboration and sound decision-making. One key strategy is to define which tasks are best suited for automation clearly, typically those that are repetitive, rule-based, or data-driven, while reserving more complex, creative, or nuanced activities for human team members. Regularly reviewing and updating these boundaries ensures that automation remains a support tool rather than a replacement for human judgment. Another critical approach is to foster open communication channels, allowing team members to provide feedback on automated systems and flag areas where human oversight or intervention is needed. Encouraging cross-functional collaboration during the design and implementation of automation tools helps ensure that the technology aligns with real-world workflows and team needs.

## [Automation Strategies for Collaboration](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#automation-strategies-for-collaboration)

### [Best Practices and Guidelines for Automated Collaboration](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#best-practices-and-guidelines-for-automated-collaboration)

To optimize team collaboration with automation, it’s essential to establish a foundation of clear, intentional practices that keep teams aligned and processes running smoothly. Begin by setting explicit communication rules. Define which channels are used for different types of updates, establish protocols for urgent versus routine messages, and clarify expectations for response times. This structure reduces confusion and ensures that automation enhances, rather than complicates, team interactions. Next, prioritize thorough documentation of all automated workflows. Map out each process step-by-step, specifying triggers, handoff points, and responsibilities, so everyone understands how automation fits into their daily tasks. Centralize this documentation in an accessible location and keep it up to date as workflows evolve. Regularly review and refine these processes by gathering team feedback and analyzing performance data. Use key metrics—such as task completion times, error rates, and user satisfaction—to assess the impact of automation and identify areas for improvement. Schedule periodic check-ins or retrospectives to discuss what’s working and where adjustments are needed. By combining clear communication guidelines, robust workflow documentation, and consistent measurement of results, teams can ensure that automation truly supports collaboration, drives accountability, and adapts to changing needs. A proactive approach transforms automation from a simple timesaver into a strategic asset for high-performing, collaborative teams.

### [Training Teams](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#training-teams)

By equipping team members with the necessary skills and knowledge, organizations can ensure that their workforce is not only prepared to adopt new technologies but can also leverage these tools to enhance productivity and efficiency. A well-structured training program is essential for facilitating this transition and for fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Here's a detailed approach to creating an effective training framework:

1. **Begin with the Basics:** Initiate the training program by introducing the concept of automation, emphasizing its significance in improving the team's workflow and overall productivity. Every team member must grasp the basic functionalities and potential benefits of the automation tools being implemented. An understanding of how these tools can simplify tasks, reduce errors, and save time will motivate team members to embrace the technology and engage actively in the learning process.

2. **Hands-On Sessions:** After covering the theoretical aspects, proceed with practical, hands-on training sessions. These sessions should allow team members to interact directly with the automation tools in a controlled environment. By practicing tasks they will perform in their daily work, participants can gain confidence and competence in using the technology.

3. **Use Real-World Scenarios:** To reinforce learning and ensure the practical application of skills, integrate real-world scenarios into the training program. By simulating challenges and situations that team members are likely to face, the training becomes more relevant and engaging. This method helps in illustrating the practical benefits of automation tools, enabling team members to visualize how these technologies can be applied to streamline their specific tasks and workflows.

4. **Ongoing Support and Resources:** Recognize that learning is an ongoing process and provide continuous support and resources to team members. Establishing a help desk, dedicated support channels, or a knowledge base for automation-related queries encourages team members to seek assistance and guidance as they integrate these tools into their work routines. Maintaining the momentum of learning and adaptation, as well as quickly addressing obstacles, depends on this support system.

5. **Advanced Training for Power Users:** Identify and develop "power users" within the team through advanced training sessions. These individuals can play a key role in cascading knowledge throughout the team, assisting with more complex issues, and serving as in-house experts on automation technologies. By empowering these power users, organizations can foster a supportive learning environment and ensure that expertise is readily available to facilitate the broader adoption and effective use of automation tools


A comprehensive training program is the foundation of successful automation technology implementation. As team members become proficient with these tools, they are better positioned to contribute to the organization's strategic goals and to navigate the evolving technological landscape.

### [Measuring the Impact of Automation](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#measuring-the-impact-of-automation)

To measure the effectiveness of automation in enhancing team collaboration, it’s important to establish key performance indicators (KPIs) such as project completion times, error rates, and team satisfaction levels. Regularly monitoring these metrics before and after the implementation of automation technologies provides concrete evidence of their impact. Surveys from team members can also offer insights into how automation has affected their day-to-day work and collaboration.

## [Optimizing Remote Work Collaboration through Automation](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#optimizing-remote-work-collaboration-through-automation)

### [Tools and Techniques for Remote Team Management](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#tools-and-techniques-for-remote-team-management)

Automation tools that specialize in online calendar management and task automation for teams play a crucial role in keeping everyone on track. Additionally, digital collaboration platforms equipped with chatbots and AI can automate routine inquiries and tasks. Techniques such as regular automated check-ins and progress reports help maintain a rhythm of communication and accountability, ensuring that no team member feels isolated or out of the loop.

### [Enhance Team Efficiency in Remote Work](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#enhance-team-efficiency-in-remote-work)

By implementing workflow automation tools, teams can ensure that tasks flow smoothly from one stage to the next, with automatic updates keeping everyone informed. As emphasized before, automated reminders and notifications play a critical role in keeping deadlines in check and priorities aligned, mitigating the risk of tasks falling through the cracks. Furthermore, automation can help create a sense of community among remote team members through virtual icebreakers and team-building activities, enhancing team cohesion and morale.

## [Emerging Trends in Automation and Team Collaboration: AI, Hybrid Work, and Low-Code/No-Code Customization](https://cal.com/blog/bridging-the-gap-automation-as-a-tool-for-enhancing-team-collaboration\#emerging-trends-in-automation-and-team-collaboration-ai-hybrid-work-and-low-code-no-code-customization)

The landscape of team collaboration is rapidly evolving, driven by significant advances in automation technology and shifting workplace dynamics. One of the most transformative trends is the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into collaboration platforms. AI is no longer limited to automating simple, repetitive tasks; it now acts as a true teammate, capable of generating meeting summaries, analyzing communication sentiment, suggesting action items, and proactively surfacing project bottlenecks. This level of intelligent automation accelerates decision-making, boosts creativity, and ensures teams remain aligned—even as projects grow more complex and distributed.

Perhaps most notably, the democratization of automation through low-code and no-code customization is empowering a broader range of users to build, adapt, and scale their own workflows without deep technical expertise. With intuitive drag-and-drop interfaces, non-technical team members can quickly create custom forms, dashboards, and process automations tailored to their unique needs. This flexibility enables organizations to respond rapidly to evolving business requirements, eliminates bottlenecks associated with traditional IT development cycles, and fosters a culture of innovation at every level. As low-code/no-code platforms become more powerful and accessible, they are transforming collaboration software from static toolsets into dynamic ecosystems that grow and adapt alongside teams.

![online calendar management](https://framerusercontent.com/images/37E9O6ilc28wHsfzOT3ADd6U8G0.webp?width=1200&height=1200)

Embracing automation requires a shift in mindset and culture, recognizing the value of technology in enhancing team collaboration. The steps forward involve a commitment to continuous learning and adaptation, ensuring that teams are equipped to leverage the best automation tools and techniques. Organizations should focus on fostering a culture of innovation, where experimentation with new tools is encouraged, and feedback is actively sought to refine and improve processes. Training and development play a crucial role in this journey, ensuring that all team members have the skills and knowledge to make the most of automation technologies.

# Cal.com Event Not Showing Up on Your Public Profile? Here’s What to Do

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tpeg98OJZlhxXJBrzXd0dqMaRQ.png?width=1456&height=816)

## [Appointment scheduling should be simple](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-event-not-showing-up-on-your-public-profile-here-s-what-to-do\#appointment-scheduling-should-be-simple)

What does it mean to provide a calendar scheduling solution for everyone? Well, at Cal.com, it looks like customization, flexibility, security, and innovation.

We know that people come to us with a variety of needs. For some, it's a matter of taking back their time personally so they have more available to spend doing the things they love. For others, it's all about business, and our suite of tools helps them supercharge efficiency so that those resources can be reinvested.

## [Troubleshooting should be easy](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-event-not-showing-up-on-your-public-profile-here-s-what-to-do\#troubleshooting-should-be-easy)

Just like our users, Cal.com believes that your scheduling environment should reflect your needs. This is one of the key reasons we have so many easy plug-and-play options for customization. However, we know that sometimes what people need is a little bit of information, especially if they're trying to solve a problem.

Cal.com account holders create all sorts of appointment types, from [collective](https://cal.com/scheduling/feature/collective) and managed to [round-robin](https://cal.com/help/event-types/round-robin). However, sometimes these events don't show up where they're supposed to. This is the problem that this article is going to help you solve.

## [My appointment's not showing up on my public profile](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-event-not-showing-up-on-your-public-profile-here-s-what-to-do\#my-appointment-s-not-showing-up-on-my-public-profile)

By default, all of the bookable events you create are supposed to display on your public profile. However, there are a few simple scenarios that could change this. The first and most common reason that a bookable appointment wouldn't show up as available is if the [hidden event](https://cal.com/help/event-types/secret-events) setting has been accidentally activated.

In order to fix this, all you have to do is go to your event type dashboard and click on the hidden event setting, so it switches from the "on" position to the "off" position.

After this is done, simply refresh the page or open a new tab or window and visit your public booking page. You should see that the event which was previously not displaying is now there.

## [Are you a team subscriber?](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-event-not-showing-up-on-your-public-profile-here-s-what-to-do\#are-you-a-team-subscriber)

If you're part of a team, it means that you have two components to your event dashboard. One is personal, and the other is for specialized team event types. If an event isn't showing up on your personal booking page, it might make sense to double-check if it was accidentally created on your team booking page.

In this case, all you would need to do is recreate the appointment so it's assigned to the correct part of your profile.

If you're part of an organization or enterprise plan, and you are expecting a specific event type or template to be [assigned](https://cal.com/help/event-types/managed-events) to you and it's not showing up, just double-check with your team admin. There's always a chance that they might not have gotten around to doing it yet, or if there's anyone else in the company who has a similar name, it might have accidentally been assigned to them instead.

As you can see, troubleshooting your Cal.com account is super easy and straightforward. If you have more questions, please check out our help documentation, as well as our GitHub community. Also, please feel free to reach out to our customer service if you need any additional help. Thanks for reading, and happy scheduling!

Mar 14, 2025

# Cal.com v5.1

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/mdxRTPiOuFjdaSIQAijk9kF9o.png?width=1024&height=433)

We’re excited to bring you the latest updates to Cal.com. But first, a huge **thank you** for your incredible feedback on our routing improvements and for making us **#1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt!** 🚀 Your support drives our growth and continuous improvement. Here’s what’s new this month:

## [Advanced Round-Robin fairness enhancements](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#advanced-round-robin-fairness-enhancements)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/t9DIcckr3CThLlRmMNo1SLM2ppY.png?width=1144&height=588)

Fair scheduling just got smarter! Previously, fairness in round-robin scheduling only worked for simple setups. Now, it fully supports routing and weighted distribution, giving teams greater flexibility in assigning meetings. This update also improves how pre-qualification filters are applied and adds a fallback mechanism to prevent "no availability" situations.

A new team setting now allows admins to customize the round-robin reset interval, choosing between daily or monthly resets. By default, the system resets every month, but teams needing a more dynamic rotation can now opt for a daily reset. These improvements ensure balanced workloads, smarter meeting distribution, and no lost booking opportunities due to availability gaps.

## [Enhanced Out-of-Office (OOO) management](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#enhanced-out-of-office-(ooo)-management)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Ufh9VVSsHcUFmUMbvWFkHdtP5CQ.png?width=1144&height=588)

Managing team availability is now easier with multiple improvements to Out-of-Office (OOO) functionality. Non-admin users can now view team OOO schedules in a read-only format, ensuring transparency while preventing accidental changes. Searching for OOO entries has also been improved, making it faster and more accurate to find team members' availability. Additionally, admins now have better tools to manage and update team OOO statuses, streamlining coordination for teams with dynamic schedules. These updates help teams stay informed and organized, reducing scheduling conflicts and improving overall efficiency.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gWlzjA7zfNvtwjVj3mDQ2rsvqIQ.png?width=1080&height=540)

## [Continued performance improvements](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#continued-performance-improvements)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/KVwFOTYW6QrPq8Bf31E3tXX77kI.png?width=1144&height=588)

We're making **Cal.com** faster and more efficient with ongoing performance upgrades.

-   The **migration to App Router** is nearly complete, allowing us to focus on **caching and streaming optimizations** to keep the app as snappy as ever.

-   Our **Next.js 15 upgrade** is also in progress, bringing **Turbopack for local development**, already cutting startup times by **50%**.

-   Additionally, we've completed **major refactors** in both our **App Store** (now featuring 100+ apps) and **dependency management**, improving local dev speeds by **up to 25%**.


These efforts ensure a smoother, faster experience for all users and we don't stop here.

## [New apps to maximize your Cal.com experience](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#new-apps-to-maximize-your-cal-com-experience)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/GQlb5TnYTZ33mnVtirs0wGC0mmg.png?width=1144&height=588)

This month, we’re adding three powerful apps to our app store to enhance automation, AI, and customer interactions:

- **Eleven Labs**– Use AI-generated voice technology for personalized reminders, confirmations, and automated scheduling messages.

- **Monobot CX** – Automate customer interactions with an AI chatbot that handles scheduling, FAQs, and support inquiries.

- **Intercom App** – Seamlessly book meetings within Intercom chats, sync scheduling links, and enhance real-time customer engagement.


Discover these and many more integrations in our App Store to elevate your scheduling experience.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gWlzjA7zfNvtwjVj3mDQ2rsvqIQ.png?width=1080&height=540)

## [New features](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#new-features)

- Our UI gets a refresh with V3 of UI components and a cleaner layout. [#19136](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19136)

- We now auto-detect the user’s country from their IP address, automatically pre-filling the correct country code in the booking window for a faster and smoother mobile number entry. [#19788](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19788)

- Booking ID and links are now visible in insights, making data tracking easier. [#19697](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19697)

- We've added improved navigation and loading speed for large teams. [#19802](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19802)

- Stay on top of new instant bookings with sound-enabled push notifications in your browser. [#18548](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/18548)

- You can now select multiple durations when embedding Cal.com links via email. [#17432](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/17432)

- Users now get a warning before leaving or refreshing an in-progress booking. [#18932](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/18932)

- No-show confirmations will no longer pop up for single-attendee events, reducing unnecessary prompts. #19806


## [Improvements & fixes](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-1\#improvements-fixes)

- We've fixed an error where meeting URLs were missing from workflow emails, ensuring all calendar events now include the correct link. [#19790](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19790)

- We've resolved a bug causing date range filters on /bookings to display incorrect results, ensuring accurate scheduling. [#19785](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19785)

- We've fixed timezone selector bug – no more background scrolling when selecting timezones. [#19789](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19789)

- We've resolved a bug that caused an admin organization listing crash, allowing admins to view their organizations without errors. [#19825](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19825)

- We've fixed an issue with HubSpot integration, ensuring paid team events now sync correctly. [#19761](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19761), [#19609](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19609)

- We've resolved a bug where the wrong attendee was shown when canceling a seated event. [#19647](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19647)

- We've fixed an error where the "Add Guests" option appeared in the dropdown even when disabled in booking settings. [#19649](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19649)

- We've fixed an issue where user profile updates were not happening in real-time, ensuring instant attribute updates. [#19604](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19604)

- We've resolved a bug that incorrectly marked valid timeslots as unavailable, ensuring proper booking availability. [#19590](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19590)

- We've resolved a bug where timezone input text was not visible in dark mode, improving readability. [#19325](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19325)

- We've resolved a bug where "Scheduling by Cal.com" still appeared in workflow emails even when branding was disabled. [#18862](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/18862)

- We've resolved a bug causing phone input crashes on certain platforms, ensuring a smooth booking experience. [#19396](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19396)

- We've resolved a bug where timezone changes did not work properly if no end time was set, ensuring correct scheduling adjustments. [#19103](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19103)

- For more new features and fixes, visit our [GitHub page](https://go.cal.com/releases).

# Cal.com v5.3

Hello, welcome to this month’s feature update! This month, we’ve focused on a few key areas to improve your experience.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/vdLx4eY6a1ZWNzo1uSzNPKBOhw.png?width=2048&height=866)

## [SMS Workflows for ALL plans](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-3\#sms-workflows-for-all-plans)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/nBBoliK9pRC0IzBisQCmiZN4ps.png?width=1716&height=882)

We’re thrilled to announce that **SMS & WhatsApp Workflows** are now available on **every** [Cal.com](http://cal.com/) plan—yes, even free users! 🎉 Whether you’re sending a quick confirmation, a gentle reminder, or a friendly follow-up, you can now reach your invitees right where they are most responsive. Messages to the US and Canada remain completely **free**, and Organizations keep their **unlimited SMS** benefits just as before—no changes there! For everyone else, messages draw from a straightforward credits balance (1 credit = $0.01), and to help you hit the ground running, teams automatically receive free monthly credits. Ready to supercharge your scheduling? Top up your credits, craft your workflows, and let SMS and WhatsApp carry the conversation.

[Learn more about SMS pricing structure](https://cal.com/help/workflows/credits)

## [Cal.com](http://cal.com/) Routing v3.0

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/pUdeS2cPPq6hyQvQquR5qMeLeg.png?width=1716&height=882)

We’re excited to unveil **Routing Forms v3.0**, a **design revamp** that makes our existing routing features easier and more intuitive to use with a sleeker, more user-friendly interface. 💫 Now you can effortlessly configure **Salesforce ownership routing**, **attribute-based routing with weight controls**, and **fallback logic** using our redesigned header bar, slide-over settings panel, and move-up/down controls. Plus, you can **test your routing rules** in the new preview modal—see your round-robin order and queue behavior in action before you roll out. We’ve also refreshed the **Salesforce settings in event types**, so managing integrations is smoother than ever.

[Try our new and improved routing](https://cal.com/routing)

## [Performance improvements on the booking pages](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-3\#performance-improvements-on-the-booking-pages)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QmJDv7K4SmIXCwtjv6MCDH9tQY.png?width=1716&height=882)

We’re thrilled to share that we’ve rolled out major performance upgrades across our booking pages—load times for both team and organization events have been slashed by up to **90%**, dropping from an average of **20 seconds down to just 2 seconds**. ⚡️ You’ll notice a dramatic speed boost whether you’re scheduling a quick call or managing large-scale team events.

We’ve also supercharged the **Bookings Dashboard** by refactoring our backend and optimising SQL queries which resulted in noticeably faster data fetches and snappier dashboard load times when viewing or filtering your bookings.

Check out the before-and-after benchmark graph above to see the difference for yourself!

## [Cal.eu](http://cal.eu/) 🇪🇺

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/swBKA8GxuGEdLeaW2JgJFV4UvY.png?width=1716&height=882)

The wait is nearly over. After months of building, testing, and listening to what privacy-conscious teams actually need, we’re getting ready to launch [**Cal.eu**](http://cal.eu/) — a fully customizable scheduling platform hosted in Europe. This is [Cal.com](http://cal.com/) rebuilt for businesses that demand strict EU data residency and compliance without sacrificing flexibility or user experience. Whether you're a fast-moving startup or an enterprise with serious regulatory requirements, [Cal.eu](http://cal.eu/) is designed to meet you where you are. It's the same powerful scheduling infrastructure you love, now with all the safeguards European teams have been asking for.

We’re kicking things off with a waitlist — join now to be among the first to explore what [Cal.eu](http://cal.eu/) can do.

[Join the waitlist](https://cal.com/europe)

## [New features](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-3\#new-features)

- We’ve added autocomplete on the login and signup forms for faster account access. [#21065](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21065)

- We’ve introduced active managed-user billing (v1) to streamline team account invoicing. (Platform) [#20499](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20499)

- We’ve added `utm_params` field for for host on the booking pages for easier tracking. [#20733](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20733)

- We’ve added pagination to the V2 “get bookings” endpoints for smoother data fetching. [#21173](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21173)

- We implemented a “skip trial” feature for Teams users so they can access the paid features like custom workflows [#20753](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20753)

- We’ve added V2 membership attributes, letting you tag and filter members via API. [#21131](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21131)

- We’ve introduced a feature flag for sending workflow emails over SMTP [#21187](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21187)

- We implemented the dropdown to select and set a locked timezone for event type [#20425](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20425)

- We now let you include “no-shows” in round-robin calculation for more accurate assignment logic. [#21063](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21063)

- We’ve added a `handleSlotSelect` prop on the Booker Atom so you can fully customize how timeslot selection and reservations behave. (Platform) [#21133](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21133)

- We’ve added a feature to hide organizer's email address from the booking screen, email notifications, and calendar events [#20782](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20782)

- We’ve added a booking-references API filter, making it easier to query bookings by custom reference types. [#21179](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21179)

- We now prerender booking links and reuse them with our headless router for faster redirects. [#20720](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20720)


## [Improvements and fixes](https://cal.com/blog/cal-com-v5-3\#improvements-and-fixes)

- We fixed the **theme search param crashing** the booking page. [#21120](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21120)

- We resolved an issue where **disabled SMS calls were hanging** by ensuring the promise resolves correctly. [#21070](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21070)

- We tidied up several **mobile layout issues** in Routing Forms v3. [#21078](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21078)

- We corrected the **cancellation email content** to show accurate information. [#21085](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21085)

- We prevented **double-reserving** of already booked slots. [#21139](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21139)

- We fixed an issue where **attendees weren’t visible** to hosts in seated team bookings. [#21156](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21156)

- We addressed a bug that made it **impossible to change** certain workflow actions. [#21185](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21185)

- We restored the “And connect with specific team members” option for **non-org teams**. [#21083](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21083)

- We fixed the **delete-organization-user** endpoint in API v2 so it now works as expected. [#21136](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21136)

- We repaired **advanced text filters** in the V2 “get bookings” query using Kysely. [#21143](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21143)

- We fixed the **“advanced email and attendee” filters** in the get-bookings endpoint. [#21125](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21125)

- We improved the logic for **scheduling email reminders**, ensuring timing and triggers fire reliably. [#21129](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21129)

- We corrected the **ICS export** so the organizer’s email is included when the “hide organizer” setting is enabled. [#21212](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21212)

# Use Cal.com with Vimcal

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gEMWPIMIKUBuP6BJutaGRMvbJw.png?width=2432&height=1216)

# [Cal.com plus Vimcal = The perfect match](https://cal.com/blog/cal-plus-vimcal\#cal-com-plus-vimcal-the-perfect-match)

Today we’re thrilled to announce a partnership with Vimcal, which integrates with [Cal.com](https://cal.com/signup) via the Google Calendar Integration.

Vimcal is building the world’s fastest calendar, beautifully designed for remote teams. It comes fully featured with timezone conversion, keyboard shortcuts, and everything else a modern calendar app should have.

Co-founders John Li and Mikey Zhao came up with the idea for Vimcal while fundraising for another startup that they were working on.

Marketed as the “Superhuman for Calendars” Vimcal offers a variety of differentiators from other calendar products. One of the most notable of the bunch is the keyboard shortcuts and in-house timezone conversions.

Basically, anything that you could want in a calendar app, they’ve got it. I was totally blown away when I watched their video on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/vimcal?utm_source=badge-top-post-badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_souce=badge-vimcal). I would definitely recommend checking the video out.

What’s even cooler about Vimcal is that you can combine it with Cal.com. Together you have unlimited integrations and enough scheduling tools to power your entire workflow.

A lot of times we get the question _"Why should I use Cal.com in addition to my calendar app?”_ and of course, this is a valid question. We’ve made a graphic to help show the advantages of using Cal.com in addition to your Vimcal.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/yStNbJ7uC1Hxdfb4Wtv3NTyvoDQ.png?width=4944&height=2873)

While Vimcal provides its own scheduling link, Cal.com provides the infrastructure to integrate everything that you need to efficiently scale your day.

For enterprise/infrastructure customers that also means your users can use [Vimcal](https://app.cal.com/apps/vimcal) to join your hiring marketplace, telehealth marketplace, vaccine appointments, coaching platform, etc.

Long story short, we’re so excited to partner with Vimcal and improve the world of scheduling.

**How to get a personal Cal.com link/connect to Google Calendar**

- [Sign up](https://cal.com/signup) for an account at cal.com

- Login to your cal.com account

- Go to the [integrations](https://app.cal.com/apps) page

- Scroll down to “Calendars”

- Connect your Google Calendar


![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/nvchBS62gP4nDvjLuee8MdeJ2xA.png?width=1874&height=872)

**How to sign up for Vimcal**

- Go to vimcal.com

- Select “Start Free Trial”

- Connect your Google Calendar

# 5 cal.com and zapier integrations to save you 30min a day

Save time, eliminate repetitive tasks, and keep your calendar in sync with these powerful Cal.com and Zapier integrations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/67WSg2VnhWbzLCx2yg167iIOdM.png?width=1536&height=1024)

## [Save time with automation: Why Cal.com + Zapier is a productivity powerhouse](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#save-time-with-automation-why-cal-com-zapier-is-a-productivity-powerhouse)

Whether you’re managing a team, onboarding clients, or syncing calendars, here are five powerful Cal.com + Zapier automations that can save you at least 30 minutes daily.

### [1. Add new Cal.com bookings to Google Sheets](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#1-add-new-cal-com-bookings-to-google-sheets)

**Use case:** Track bookings in a centralized dashboard

**Time saved per day:** ~5-10 minutes

Instead of manually updating a spreadsheet every time someone books a meeting, use this automation

- Zap: _When a new booking is created in Cal.com → Create a new row in Google Sheets_


This is perfect for consultants, sales teams, or agencies who track leads, client meetings, or internal sessions in a sheet.

**Pro tip:** You can even create pivot tables or run analytics to track booking volume, cancellation rates, or average meeting types.

### [2. Send personalized Slack messages when a meeting is booked](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#2-send-personalized-slack-messages-when-a-meeting-is-booked)

**Use case:** Keep your team in the loop

**Time saved per day:** ~5 minutes

Notifications are helpful—but personalized, structured Slack messages are even better.

- Zap: _When a new event is booked → Send a custom message to a specific Slack channel_


You can customize the message to include:

- The name of the person who booked

- The type of meeting

- The time and date

- Any custom notes from the booking


### [3. Automatically send a follow-up email via Gmail](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#3-automatically-send-a-follow-up-email-via-gmail)

**Use case:** Improve meeting follow-up without forgetting

**Time saved per day:** ~10 minutes

No more forgetting to send follow-up emails or typing out the same message over and over again.

- Zap: _When a Cal.com event ends → Send a templated follow-up email via Gmail_


You can customize:

- The subject and message body

- Links to resources or recordings

- Post-call actions like booking a follow-up or filling out a form


This is ideal for customer success teams, coaches, and sales reps who want to keep momentum going without the manual legwork.

### [4. Create new CRM contacts automatically (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#4-create-new-crm-contacts-automatically-(hubspot-salesforce-etc-))

**Use case:** Keep your CRM updated effortlessly

**Time saved per day:** ~5–7 minutes

Stop entering new meeting participants into your CRM by hand. With this integration:

- Zap: _When a booking is made on Cal.com → Create or update contact in your CRM_


Supported CRMs include:

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Pipedrive

- Zoho CRM

- And many more


Why it matters: Keeping CRM records current ensures better reporting, automation, and personalization in outreach.

## [5. Send reminders or calendar invites via SMS (Twilio)](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#5-send-reminders-or-calendar-invites-via-sms-(twilio))

**Use case:** Reduce no-shows with timely reminders

**Time saved per day:** ~3–5 minutes

If you’re dealing with a high no-show rate or meeting attendees who prefer texts, automate SMS reminders.

- Zap: _When a booking is coming up in 1 hour → Send an SMS via Twilio_


This keeps your attendees prepared without needing to manually send texts. Bonus: it adds a personal touch that many appreciate. You can also use tools like ClickSend or SimpleTexting if Twilio isn’t your preferred provider.

## [Start saving time today](https://cal.com/blog/cal-zapier-integrations-save-time\#start-saving-time-today)

These Zapier integrations are just the beginning. You can combine multiple Zaps, chain workflows together, and build a fully automated scheduling system that saves you hours each week. If you’re looking to optimize your day, eliminate repetitive tasks, and keep your focus on what truly matters-Cal.com + Zapier is the way to go.

# From lead to loyalty: Using Cal.com across your customer lifecycle

Cal.com isn't just a scheduling tool. It's a powerful platform that supports every stage of your customer lifecycle - from lead generation and onboarding to support, retention, and renewal.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/DVKsQmB5PBlfhNZFQN6YrTog.png?width=1536&height=1024)

## [Why scheduling matters across the customer lifecycle](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#why-scheduling-matters-across-the-customer-lifecycle)

From the moment a prospect visits your site to the point where they become loyal customers, timing and accessibility are key. Cal.com enables your team to be proactive and responsive across every lifecycle stage. With customizable scheduling flows, routing logic, and integrations, it becomes more than a booking tool - it becomes a system for building better customer relationships. Let's take a deeper look into how cal.com's different products helps across the customer lifecycle.

### [Instant meetings: Convert interest into action](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#instant-meetings-convert-interest-into-action)

Speed-to-lead is critical. Cal.com's **instant meeting links** allow high-intent prospects to immediately jump into a call or video meeting without waiting for scheduling back-and-forth. This is particularly powerful in lead generation campaigns, live chat interactions, or product trial flows where the customer is ready to engage now.

By reducing the delay between interest and interaction, instant meetings help you increase conversion rates, close deals faster, and create a more responsive brand experience.

### [Routing forms: Qualify and match leads efficiently](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#routing-forms-qualify-and-match-leads-efficiently)

Cal.com’s **routing forms** collect data upfront such as role, company size, or region, and then directs the booking to the right person or calendar. This feature is ideal for sales teams trying to route inbound leads to the appropriate rep, or support teams managing technical inquiries.

With conditional logic, you can ensure VIP leads get prioritized, enterprise customers get matched to a senior rep, and meetings go to the team best suited to handle them. This reduces handoffs and boosts first-touch effectiveness.

### [Event types: Structure engagement across lifecycle stages](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#event-types-structure-engagement-across-lifecycle-stages)

Different customer lifecycle stages require different types of meetings. Cal.com’s **event types** let you create purpose-built booking flows for everything from sales demos and onboarding sessions to quarterly business reviews and support escalations.

Each event type can have its own duration, location, availability, and form fields. This means a new lead can book a short intro call while an existing customer schedules a deep-dive training session, all using the same platform.

### [Round robin scheduling: Balance team workload](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#round-robin-scheduling-balance-team-workload)

For teams managing high volumes of bookings, **round robin scheduling** ensures meetings are distributed fairly across available team members. This is essential for sales development reps (SDRs), support teams, or customer success managers.

It prevents overload, ensures fast response times, and keeps your team operating at peak performance—all while giving the customer the quickest available slot.

### [Buffer time: Improve focus and reduce burnout](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#buffer-time-improve-focus-and-reduce-burnout)

To maintain energy and performance during busy days, Cal.com’s **buffer time** lets you add space before and after each meeting. This feature supports better preparation, smoother follow-up, and helps avoid the fatigue that comes with back-to-back calls.

By building in breathing room, your team can deliver more thoughtful, higher-quality customer interactions.

### [Requires confirmation: Control your time and reduce noise](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#requires-confirmation-control-your-time-and-reduce-noise)

Not every booking should be automatically accepted. With **requires confirmation**, Cal.com gives you the ability to review and approve meetings before they’re finalized. This is useful for high-demand roles, limited office hours, or protecting your time from spam and low-priority requests.

This manual review step ensures your team focuses only on the meetings that matter most.

### [Reminders and integrations: Stay on track and aligned](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#reminders-and-integrations-stay-on-track-and-aligned)

Cal.com integrates with Slack, email, CRMs, and more to ensure meetings are never missed and context is always available. Automated **reminders** and **notifications** help both your team and your customers stay informed and prepared. You can sync events across Google Calendar, Outlook, and other tools—keeping all systems aligned and up to date.

### [One platform, every touchpoint](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-customer-lifecycle\#one-platform-every-touchpoint)

From capturing inbound leads to managing renewals and upsells, Cal.com provides flexible, customizable scheduling tools for every stage of the customer lifecycle. By leveraging instant meetings, routing logic, event types, and integrations, your team can create a seamless customer experience that builds trust and drives loyalty.

Cal.com isn’t just for booking meetings. It’s for managing relationships. Explore how each feature maps to your customer journey and unlock smarter engagement from day one.

# Add scheduling to your Framer site in seconds with Cal.com

[Framer](https://framer.com/) just got a whole lot more powerful for anyone looking to offer online bookings. Thanks to a new partnership with Cal.com, you can now embed a fully functional scheduling experience into your Framer site, no plugins, no coding, no friction.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/59k33V9MPgamHtKMQpqvqSNMG0.svg?width=508&height=248)

Framer is a modern, no-code website builder that empowers creators to design visually stunning and fully responsive websites. It’s popular among freelancers, agencies, and entrepreneurs who need a quick, customizable platform to showcase their work or products. With Framer, you can build everything from personal portfolios to business landing pages, all with ease and speed.

## [A new integration built into the Insert Panel](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#a-new-integration-built-into-the-insert-panel)

The Cal.com integration is available natively inside Framer’s Insert Panel, just head to Insert → Forms → Cal.com and drop it onto your canvas. There’s no need to install a separate plugin or write any custom code. You simply:

1. Drag and drop the Cal.com component onto your page

2. Paste your Cal.com booking link

3. Customize the layout and theming

4. Hit publish and you're live


This new workflow brings powerful scheduling capabilities to your site in less than a minute, enabling real-time booking from any Framer project.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ErirNotrIvw6eQhdNuwDKo9V0bc.png?width=3024&height=1628)

## [Why this matters for creators, freelancers, and teams](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#why-this-matters-for-creators-freelancers-and-teams)

Framer is already a favorite among indie builders, designers, agencies, and entrepreneurs for its speed, flexibility, and visual polish. But until now, adding booking functionality often meant using clunky third-party scripts or sending users away to external links.

With the Cal.com Insert Panel integration, you can:

- Keep visitors on your site while they book

- Match your scheduling UI to your site’s style with layout and light/dark mode options

- Simplify the booking experience with an embedded, distraction-free interface

- Stay privacy-first thanks to Cal.com’s open infrastructure


Whether you’re offering 1:1 coaching, client consults, team demos, or intro calls, this makes your site more functional and conversion-ready.

## [Use cases: who benefits from this integration?](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#use-cases-who-benefits-from-this-integration)

This integration is tailor-made for anyone who needs to turn site visitors into scheduled interactions. Here are a few real-world examples:

1. ### [Coaches and consultants](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#coaches-and-consultants)


Make it easy for potential clients to schedule intro calls or discovery sessions without ever leaving your site.

2. ### [Freelancers and creatives](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#freelancers-and-creatives)


Showcase your portfolio on Framer and let prospects instantly book a time to chat about a project.

3. ### [Agencies and product teams](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#agencies-and-product-teams)


Let visitors schedule demos, onboarding sessions, or sales calls from your marketing site or landing page.

4. ### [Creators and educators](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#creators-and-educators)


Offer live Q&A sessions, office hours, or 1:1 mentorship with a frictionless booking experience.

By removing the need for external booking flows, you increase the chances that a site visit turns into an actual meeting.

## [Why Cal.com is the ideal scheduling tool for Framer users](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-framer\#why-cal-com-is-the-ideal-scheduling-tool-for-framer-users)

While there are other scheduling tools out there, Cal.com stands out in several key ways, especially for the privacy-conscious, customization-focused builders who use Framer.

- **Open source**: Self-hostable and auditable, with full data ownership

- **API-first architecture**: Ideal for more advanced customizations and integrations

- **Design flexibility**: Customize layout and theme to fit your site

- **Built-in privacy and compliance**: HIPAA-ready, SOC2, and GDPR-compliant

- **Free to get started**: No paywall to use basic features or embeds


If you care about building a site that’s not just beautiful but also functional, private, and under your control, this is a perfect fit.

# Using Cal.com for recurring meetings: Tips and tricks

Recurring meetings are essential for team alignment, client check-ins, and project consistency. Cal.com makes it easy to manage them without the usual scheduling chaos. Here’s how to master recurring meetings using Cal.com.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jYIUYOBZcRZDVo6SfTT1zjToR0.png?width=1536&height=1024)

## [Why recurring meetings matter](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#why-recurring-meetings-matter)

Recurring meetings are the heartbeat of most modern workflows. Whether you're running weekly team syncs, monthly client reviews, or bi-weekly strategy sessions, these meetings build momentum and ensure alignment. However, setting them up manually each time or juggling different time zones can quickly lead to frustration.

That's where Cal.com comes in. Our platform supports seamless recurring scheduling, giving you more control, better automation, and less back-and-forth.

## [How Cal.com handles recurring meetings](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#how-cal-com-handles-recurring-meetings)

Cal.com offers one main ways to handle recurring meetings:

1. Recurring event types – A recurring time slot that’s always available (e.g., every Tuesday at 10am).


Here's how to set up recurring meetings—and some power-user tips to make them even better.

## [Set up a recurring event type](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#set-up-a-recurring-event-type)

If you want to make the same time slot available every week or month, use the event type settings in Cal.com to set it up:

### [Step-by-step:](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#step-by-step)

1. Navigate to your Cal.com dashboard

2. Click "Event types"

3. Choose an existing event type or create a new one

4. Under "Availability", select recurring days and times

5. Set buffer times and limits if needed

6. Save and publish


This setup is perfect for weekly team syncs or regular client coaching calls.

Pro Tip: Want to cap how many recurring meetings someone can book? Use booking limits to restrict how often the event can be booked per day or week.

## [Sync with your calendar to avoid conflicts](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#sync-with-your-calendar-to-avoid-conflicts)

Recurring meetings often collide with other commitments. That’s why Cal.com syncs with all major calendar platforms (Google Calendar, Outlook, [Apple Calendar](https://cal.com/de/blog/apple-calendar-a-complete-guide)). When setting up recurring availability, Cal.com automatically blocks times where you’re busy on connected calendars.

### [Calendar integrations include:](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#calendar-integrations-include)

- Google Calendar

- Microsoft Outlook

- Apple iCloud Calendar

- CalDAV-compatible tools


Pro Tip: Use calendar-specific availability rules to prioritize certain calendars for recurring event types.

## [Customize reminders for recurring meetings](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#customize-reminders-for-recurring-meetings)

No-shows and missed meetings? Not on your watch. Cal.com allows you to configure automated email and SMS reminders for every event type—including recurring ones.

### [Suggestions:](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#suggestions)

- Send a reminder 24 hours before and 1 hour before the meeting

- Include a custom message or meeting agenda


You can also use [Cal.com Workflows](https://cal.com/workflows) to automate follow-ups or integrate with tools like Slack or Zapier for even more control.

## [Considerations for teams and remote work](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#considerations-for-teams-and-remote-work)

Recurring meetings become more complex with distributed teams. Cal.com makes time zone handling automatic. When your team is spread across continents, each person sees event times in their own local time.

### [Extra tips for teams:](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#extra-tips-for-teams)

- Use team event types to allow round-robin or collective availability

- Use host selection to assign recurring meetings to the right team member

- Enable meeting buffers to avoid back-to-back fatigue


Pro Tip: Combine Cal.com with Slack or Notion integrations to embed booking links in your workspace.

## [Recurring meetings + Custom workflows](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#recurring-meetings-custom-workflows)

To go a step further, use custom workflows to:

- Send pre-meeting forms or questionnaires

- Trigger post-meeting thank you messages

- Add attendees to your CRM or email list


This is perfect for consultants, coaches, or sales teams running repeated sessions with new clients.

Would you like internal links to CRM integration docs or sales use cases?

## [Final thoughts](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-recurring-meetings-tips\#final-thoughts)

Recurring meetings don’t have to mean repetitive work. With Cal.com, you can set once and streamline forever. Whether you’re syncing with your team every Monday or onboarding new clients every week, our flexible options give you the tools you need. Tao take a deeper dive into Round Robin scheduling, you can view the video [here](https://cal.com/help/event-types/round-robin):

# Cal.com v5.5 - Phone-based bookings, restriction schedule, embed caching & more...

Hello, welcome to this month’s feature update! This month, we’ve focused on a few key areas to improve your experience:

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FTjkdVrF4bFwPzHVfptVocVE.png?width=2048&height=866)

## [Phone based bookings for everyone](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-v5-5\#phone-based-bookings-for-everyone)

Until now, the ability to book using just a phone number was only included in our Organization and Enterprise plan. However, we’ve listened to the feature requests and decided to open it up to all Cal.com users.

That means you no longer have to require an email address for someone to book with you. Whether you’re scheduling quick calls, handling mobile-first users, or just want a simpler flow, you can now switch between phone-based and email-based booking.

To set it up, head to your event type settings, open the advanced section, and choose your preferred method of collecting attendee info.

This update is part of our effort to make scheduling more flexible, and give you more control over how people book time with you.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/RyHeysi6aeMnVnKjalllcat4I.png?width=2288&height=1176)

## [Restriction schedule](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-v5-5\#restriction-schedule)

We’ve added a new way for Teams customers to control availability more precisely. With restriction schedules, you can now limit which booking slots are shown for a team event by setting specific timeframes, like business hours, shift windows, or any fixed schedule you need.

This feature doesn’t add new availability. It simply hides any slots that fall outside the restriction schedule. So even if a team member is available, they won’t appear in the booking flow unless their availability matches the restriction. You’ll find this option in the availability settings of your team event type. Just enable the restriction schedule and define the timeframes you want to allow bookings.

You can take it a step further by enabling the "Use Booker Timezone" option, which applies the restriction schedule based on the booker’s local time. This is especially valuable for ensuring **TCPA compliance.** For example, by restricting bookings to the8 AM to 9 PM window in the booker’s timezone, you can guarantee that no bookings occur outside of legally permitted hours, regardless of where your customers are located.

It’s a powerful way to maintain your team’s availability, consistency, and alignment with your workflow. Soon, you’ll find this option in the availability settings of your team event types.

This feature is currently in early access and will be available to all Teams and Organization plans. Stay tuned!

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/eUnynukR4yeMTmeeW7lHf9RwmM.png?width=2288&height=1176)

## [Embed caching & speed improvements](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-v5-5\#embed-caching-speed-improvements)

We’ve made major performance improvements to embedded booking pages. If you're embedding Cal.com on your website, you’ll notice a huge speed boost. Previously, embedded pages could take around 6 seconds to load. With recent caching and optimization upgrades, they now load in under 1 second.

This means smoother user experience, higher conversion rates, and less friction between your visitors and your booking flow, especially on mobile.

No changes needed on your end. It just works faster now ⚡️

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/JfE2hLK3afdIbDGJdLK2nVSG03w.png?width=2288&height=1176)

## [New features](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-v5-5\#new-features)

- We added the ability to download your credit expense log, allowing users to export and track credit usage more transparently. [#21771](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21771)

- We enabled Stripe invoices for credit purchases, offering better billing documentation for organizations purchasing credits. [#22096](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22096)

- We added a Zoom "waiting room" setting, giving hosts better control over who joins meetings and when. [#22256](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22256)

- We implemented expandable submenus in the sidebar navigation, so clicking on a parent item (like “Insights”) now shows sub-items in an expandable menu, improving navigation and UX. [#22268](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22268)

- We improved the self-hosted onboarding flow, allowing users to purchase a license key. [#22102](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22102)

- We created a new API endpoint to create a routing-forms response that returns available booking slots for the matched event type. [#22239](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22239)

- We made the "Booker Active Booking Limit" configurable for managed events by adding the ability to lock the setting, allowing admins to set limits for members. [#21892](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21892)

- We wrote the assignment reason from form routing and Salesforce routing to a dedicated field in Salesforce, making routing sources traceable within the CRM. [#22223](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22223)

- We added a "Canceled By" field to bookings, so it's now visible to both the host and attendees who initiated the cancellation. [#18521](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/18521)

- We added rerouting support to the `AssignmentReasonRecorder`, enabling more accurate tracking of assignment sources and transitions. [#19252](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/19252)


## [Improvements & fixes](https://cal.com/blog/calcom-v5-5\#improvements-fixes)

- We fixed the ability to submit a new list item in the editor using the Enter key, enhancing content creation workflows. [#22001](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22001)

- We fixed an issue preventing users from scrolling down on the payment page, improving mobile usability. [#22363](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22363)

- We have fixed the issue with canceling an already canceled booking via the API, preventing redundant calls. [#22128](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22128)

- We have fixed the “no available users found” error that occurred during recurring event creation. [#22033](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22033)

- We updated SMS reminder logic to exclude the opt-out message from the email body when sending fallback emails. [#22100](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22100)

- We fixed the request reschedule feature so users can now reschedule the cancelled booking itself(instead of asking them to create a new booking) when allowed by event settings.. [#22115](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22115)

- We have fixed the issue of duplicate calendar event creation when adding a guest, making calendar syncing more stable. [#22247](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22247)

- We fixed the inability to cancel a team event if any event host is an attendee and a cancellation email workflow is set. [#22233](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22233)

- We fixed the scroll to timeslots when user selects a date for the first time [#22313](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22313)

- We fixed a bug where recurring events would throw 'No available users found' error when the second slot isn't available. [#22033](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22033)

- We fixed a bug where workflow reminders were sent to the host instead of the attendee after reassignment [#22027](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22027)

- We fixed an issue where slots were available even after exceeding the booking limits for the team event. [#21801](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21801)

- We fixed an issue where attendee could not reschedule or cancel unconfirmed events directly from the email. [#21844](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/21844)

- We updated the members tab in settings to open in a new tab with an external link icon. [#22471](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22471)

- We removed the event types link from the team settings navigation sidebar. [#22472](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/22472)


Explore the latest updates and share your thoughts with us. Your feedback, as always, plays a crucial role in helping us improve Cal.com for everyone.
