## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com streamline executive scheduling for C-suite leaders?

Cal.com automates intake, qualification, and routing of executive meeting requests. Custom forms capture meeting context, then intelligent routing delivers requests to the right CEO, CFO, or COO—or their assistants—reducing manual back-and-forth and saving valuable executive time.

Can we ensure privacy and control over executive meeting data?

Yes, Cal.com supports both secure cloud and self-hosted deployments. Advanced access controls, authentication, and customizable permissions keep C-suite schedules and sensitive data protected.

How does delegation work for executive assistants or chiefs of staff?

Cal.com allows delegation of booking requests to executive assistants or other trusted team members. Assistants can manage, approve, or reschedule meetings on behalf of executives with full visibility and audit trails.

Can Cal.com integrate with our enterprise systems and calendars?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports integrations with Google, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Slack, CRMs, and more. The API-first approach enables seamless connection with custom enterprise workflows.

What kind of routing logic can we use for executive meetings?

Attribute-based routing lets you direct meetings by department, urgency, executive role, or custom fields. You can create advanced workflows to accommodate approvals, handoffs, or department-specific requirements.

Is it possible to restrict who can book meetings with our executives?

Yes. Cal.com provides authentication, invite-only booking links, and granular access controls so only approved stakeholders can request meetings with C-suite leaders.

How do we track meeting requests and ensure compliance for executives?

Cal.com offers detailed audit trails, reporting dashboards, and exportable logs so you can monitor all activity, ensure compliance, and generate insights into executive scheduling patterns.

## Features built for channel and partner sales

Everything your partner program needs for seamless scheduling and routing

### Attribute-based lead routing

Assign leads using custom rules based on geography, partner status, product line, or deal size for precision matching.

### Multi-step partner forms

Create custom multi-step forms to collect all necessary partner or lead details before routing, improving qualification and reducing back-and-forth.

### Analytics and insights

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help automate channel and partner lead routing?

Cal.com enables you to set up custom routing forms and logic, so every partner-submitted lead is automatically matched to the right sales rep or channel partner based on your business rules, geography, and partner tier.

Can Cal.com integrate with our existing CRM for partner ownership assignment?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with leading CRMs like Salesforce to ensure leads are routed to the correct account or partner owner, keeping your data in sync and reducing manual intervention.

What types of routing logic can we use for partner sales?

You can route leads by partner tier, territory, product offering, deal size, or any custom attribute. Cal.com supports advanced, attribute-based and ownership-driven routing for flexible partner assignment.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for enterprise partner programs?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers enterprise-grade security, data privacy, and the option for self-hosting, so your partner and customer data stays secure and compliant with industry standards.

Can we customize the partner intake and routing forms?

Yes, you can fully customize forms to capture the exact information you need from partners or leads, including multi-step forms and custom fields.

How does Cal.com improve the efficiency of partner sales programs?

By automating lead intake, qualification, and routing, Cal.com reduces manual work, ensures faster response times, and increases transparency across all partner channels.

What is the cost structure for using Cal.com for partner sales routing?

Cal.com’s partner routing features are available as part of our Organizations suite, with simple per-user pricing and options for enterprise deployment. Contact us for detailed pricing.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help automate campus recruiting scheduling?

Cal.com enables campus recruiting teams to automate interview scheduling, collect candidate information up front, and route applicants to the right recruiters or interviewers based on customizable rules. This saves time and delivers a better candidate experience.

Can Cal.com integrate with our applicant tracking system (ATS)?

Yes, Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular ATS platforms, allowing candidate data and interviewer assignments to sync automatically for a seamless workflow.

Is it possible to customize the routing logic for different roles or programs?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s routing forms let you define logic based on candidate attributes such as program, major, graduation year, or role, ensuring every candidate is matched with the right recruiter or interviewer.

Does Cal.com support self-hosting for compliance with university or corporate policies?

Yes, Cal.com is fully open source and supports self-hosting, giving you full control over your data and compliance with institutional requirements.

How can we ensure a branded candidate experience with Cal.com?

You can fully customize and embed Cal.com scheduling forms on your website or career portal, ensuring a seamless and branded experience for every candidate.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for recruiting teams?

Cal.com provides real-time analytics on scheduling volume, candidate engagement, routing efficiency, and no-show rates, helping you optimize your campus recruiting process.

Can Cal.com handle high-volume recruiting events or career fairs?

Yes. Cal.com is designed to support high-volume scheduling, automated routing, and bulk candidate management, making it ideal for career fairs, university events, and seasonal recruiting.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What makes Cal.com ideal for commercial real estate brokerages?

Cal.com offers open-source flexibility, robust API integrations, and customizable routing forms—giving CRE teams total control over their lead and client workflows. Our platform adapts to your unique brokerage structure, property specialties, and regional teams.

Can Cal.com integrate with our existing CRM or property database?

Yes, Cal.com connects with leading CRMs and property databases. This allows you to sync client data, assign leads based on existing ownership, and keep all information up to date automatically.

How does attribute-based routing work for CRE teams?

Attribute-based routing lets you assign inquiries to brokers based on specific criteria like property type (office, retail, industrial), region, language, or experience. You can easily customize these attributes to match your team's structure.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling sensitive client data?

Absolutely. Cal.com is built with enterprise-grade security and privacy controls. You can choose self-hosting for complete data control or use our cloud platform, both with strong encryption and compliance features.

Can I customize the scheduling forms for different property types or client segments?

Yes. Easily build branded, no-code forms with custom fields for each property category, client type, or specialization. This ensures tailored experiences for every prospect and client.

Do brokers receive real-time notifications and calendar updates?

Yes. Brokers receive instant notifications for new assignments, and bookings are automatically synced with their calendars, reducing double bookings and missed opportunities.

How do I get started with Cal.com for my brokerage?

Sign up for a free trial or book a personalized demo. Our team will help you set up routing forms, integrations, and workflows tailored for your CRE operations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help conference centers manage multiple event spaces?

Cal.com’s routing forms and attribute-based logic automatically assign bookings to available rooms or spaces based on event size, type, and specific requirements. This minimizes manual intervention and maximizes space utilization.

Can we customize intake forms to meet our event requirements?

Absolutely. Cal.com lets you build customizable routing forms, allowing you to gather all the details you need from organizers or attendees during the booking process.

Is it possible to route bookings to dedicated staff or teams?

Yes. You can set up routing rules that assign bookings to specific staff, teams, or service providers based on event criteria or organizer preferences.

How does Cal.com prevent double-bookings or scheduling conflicts?

Cal.com integrates with your existing calendars and uses real-time availability checks to ensure rooms and resources are never double-booked.

Can we self-host Cal.com for data privacy or compliance needs?

Yes. Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted, giving you full control over your data and infrastructure.

Does Cal.com integrate with our event management or CRM tools?

Cal.com offers robust integrations and APIs, making it easy to connect with popular event management platforms, CRMs, and internal systems.

What support does Cal.com provide for large-scale conferences or multi-venue events?

Cal.com is built to scale, supporting complex booking flows, high volumes of attendees, and multi-venue routing with advanced customization and automation options.

# Smarter routing for content marketing teams

Transform how your content team connects with stakeholders, clients, and partners using open scheduling infrastructure from Cal.com.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Cal.com content marketing routing form with questions tailored for campaign objectives, content type, and deadlines, helping route requests to the right marketing team specialist.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/7AtAc90M8lJJtCAOU7VoyTdRMk.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to optimize content marketing scheduling

Effortlessly connect stakeholders to the right content team member with intelligent routing forms.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Design your routing workflow

Map out how incoming requests—be it from internal teams, clients, or collaborators—should be routed to content strategists, copywriters, editors, or designers.

![Content marketing routing form template in Cal.com, showcasing customizable intake fields for campaign details and stakeholder information.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/KafNepiAt9pUmnbZ87HhJztFQs.png)

02

### Let stakeholders provide details

Collect key information like content type, campaign goals, or urgency through customizable booking forms, ensuring requests go to the right specialist.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign and schedule

Based on responses, Cal.com routes each request to the most suitable team member or group, syncing with calendars and project management tools.

![Automated routing assignment for content marketing requests in Cal.com, showing team members from strategy, copywriting, and editorial.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/n1eBBO0FJ8aj0uqujHQXrB8QE.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Boost productivity and collaboration

Unlock new levels of efficiency and communication for marketing teams.

01

### Accelerate campaign delivery

Automate stakeholder assignment and meeting scheduling to reduce bottlenecks and enable faster turnarounds.

02

### Improve stakeholder experience

Route requests to the right expert every time, minimizing confusion and ensuring stakeholders connect with the right content professional.

![Ownership assignment for content marketing clients in Cal.com, showing automatic routing to account or campaign leads.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/NEq6j4Jn8dgtLCZnMng25IBBs.png)

![Enhanced analytics for content marketing routing in Cal.com, visualizing requests and team workload across campaigns.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/2cSUqJv7l2OtEYLA772ret2oE0.png)

03

### Scale content operations

Handle more requests and campaigns without increasing manual coordination, thanks to flexible, API-driven routing and integrations.

04

### Maintain full control and compliance

Choose open-source self-hosting or secure cloud deployment, ensuring your content data and workflows remain in your hands.

## Essential features for content marketing teams

Purpose-built tools to power content campaign collaboration and scheduling.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Assign requests based on campaign type, content format, or stakeholder priorities—no more generic queues.

### Client ownership assignment

Automatically connect returning clients or partners to their designated content lead, keeping relationships seamless.

### Collaborative scheduling

Enable team-wide visibility and coordination on campaigns with shared calendars and round robin booking.

### Customizable intake forms

Collect relevant information with flexible, no-code forms tailored to your content marketing workflows.

### Integrations with your stack

Connect Cal.com to Slack, Google Calendar, Notion, HubSpot, and more for a unified workflow.

### Actionable analytics

Track campaign requests, stakeholder engagement, and routing efficiency with built-in reporting.

FAQ

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com routing forms help content marketing teams?

Cal.com routing forms automatically assign incoming requests or meeting bookings to the right team member based on criteria such as content type, campaign, or stakeholder needs. This eliminates manual triage and ensures every request gets timely attention.

Can we customize routing forms for different content workflows?

Yes, Cal.com’s forms are fully customizable. You can tailor questions, input types, and routing logic for different stakeholders—whether they are requesting blog copy, video scripts, or strategy sessions.

Does Cal.com support integrations with project management or CRM tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com integrates with tools like Slack, HubSpot, Notion, Google Calendar, and more. This helps content teams centralize requests and automate task creation or notifications.

Is it possible to assign returning clients to their usual content strategist?

Yes. Cal.com allows for ownership assignment, so returning clients or partners are automatically routed to their dedicated strategist or account manager.

Can we embed the routing form on our website or internal portal?

Definitely. Cal.com routing forms can be embedded directly on your website, intranet, or campaign landing pages, making it easy for stakeholders to submit requests.

How does Cal.com ensure data privacy for sensitive content projects?

Cal.com is open-source and supports self-hosting, giving you full control over your data. You can also opt for secure cloud hosting with robust access controls.

Is Cal.com suitable for agencies managing multiple clients and campaigns?

Yes. Cal.com’s flexible routing and organizational features make it ideal for agencies juggling multiple brands, clients, or content streams—ensuring each request lands with the right specialist.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help content agencies automate client intake?

Cal.com provides customizable routing forms that collect client briefs, segment projects, and automatically assign them to the right team or specialist, reducing manual admin work.

Can I integrate Cal.com with our existing project management tools?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with popular project management and CRM tools, so your team can manage projects and communication from a single source of truth.

Does Cal.com support round robin scheduling for project assignments?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s routing logic supports both round robin and attribute-based assignments, making it easy to distribute projects or match them to specialists.

Is Cal.com suitable for agencies with complex multi-step intake processes?

Yes. You can design multi-step routing forms to capture all necessary client details, ensuring projects are routed accurately and efficiently.

Can clients schedule meetings directly with the assigned project manager?

Once a project is routed, Cal.com enables clients to book meetings with the assigned manager or team, eliminating scheduling friction.

Is Cal.com open source and can we self-host?

Cal.com is fully open source and supports self-hosting, giving agencies complete control over data, branding, and integrations.

What kind of analytics does Cal.com provide for agencies?

Cal.com offers detailed insights into project routing, team load, and scheduling efficiency, helping agencies optimize their operations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help us manage high volumes of adult learner inquiries?

Cal.com automates the intake and scheduling process by routing each inquiry to the appropriate advisor or session based on customizable criteria. This reduces manual triage and ensures that every prospective student receives timely, relevant guidance.

Can we tailor the intake forms for our diverse programs and learners?

Yes, Cal.com’s forms are fully customizable with a no-code builder. Collect the exact data your programs need, from learning objectives to preferred formats or schedules.

Does Cal.com integrate with our student information system (SIS) or CRM?

Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular SIS and CRM platforms, allowing seamless syncing of learner data and advisor assignments for streamlined operations.

Is it possible to route learners based on their availability and interests?

Absolutely. Attribute-based routing allows you to match learners to courses, instructors, or support staff based on any custom field, including availability, interests, or prior experience.

How does Cal.com support self-hosting and data privacy for educational institutions?

Cal.com can be fully self-hosted, giving your organization full control over data and compliance with education sector privacy requirements.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for continuing education teams?

Track key metrics like form completions, advisor assignments, and enrollment trends. Use insights to improve program offerings and learner conversion.

How quickly can we implement Cal.com for our continuing education programs?

Deployment is fast, especially with our open-source and API-first approach. Most teams can launch their first routing forms and scheduling workflows in days, not weeks.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help streamline client intake for a corporate law firm?

Cal.com automates the process of capturing client needs and routes inquiries directly to the most relevant attorney or team. This reduces intake friction, accelerates the client journey, and frees up valuable time for your lawyers.

Can we customize routing forms to reflect different legal practice areas?

Yes. You can fully tailor intake forms to capture practice area, case type, urgency, and other relevant details, ensuring each inquiry is matched to the right expert.

How does Cal.com handle confidentiality and data security for legal clients?

Cal.com offers enterprise-grade security, including self-hosted deployment options. This allows your firm to maintain full control over client data and comply with legal confidentiality requirements.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing legal tech stack?

Cal.com integrates with popular CRMs, case management systems, and communication tools. Our open API and Zapier integration make connecting to your current workflow easy.

Can we assign repeat clients to their dedicated attorney automatically?

Yes. Cal.com’s ownership assignment feature recognizes existing client relationships and ensures returning clients are routed to their dedicated lawyer or team.

What reporting and analytics are available for law firms?

Cal.com provides insights into intake volume, routing efficiency, and team performance so you can optimize your processes and staffing.

Is Cal.com suitable for international firms with multi-jurisdictional practice groups?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s attribute-based routing handles complex requirements, including jurisdiction, language, and practice area, making it ideal for international and multi-disciplinary law firms.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve scheduling for corporate strategy sessions?

Cal.com automates the process of assigning the right executives and stakeholders to each strategy session. This ensures no critical stakeholder is missed and reduces manual coordination, resulting in more effective and timely meetings.

Can Cal.com route bookings based on executive roles or departments?

Yes, attribute-based routing allows you to match bookings with executives by department, region, or specific roles, ensuring the right participants are always included.

How does Cal.com integrate with enterprise calendars and productivity tools?

Cal.com connects seamlessly with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms to sync invites, reminders, and session updates automatically.

Is it possible to collect strategy session requirements before confirming bookings?

Absolutely. You can create custom multi-step forms to collect project details, topics, or participant priorities during the booking process, ensuring every meeting is tailored to your goals.

Can we self-host Cal.com for compliance and data privacy?

Yes, Cal.com offers self-hosting options so you can deploy scheduling infrastructure on your preferred cloud or on-premise environment, meeting even the strictest enterprise compliance standards.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for strategy session management?

Track participation rates, booking trends, departmental engagement, and time-to-meeting metrics with Cal.com’s built-in analytics. Insights help you optimize your strategic planning process.

Is Cal.com suitable for large, global enterprise teams?

Definitely. Cal.com’s scalable, API-first architecture supports organizations of any size, with advanced routing, localization, and role-based access for distributed teams.

# Efficient scheduling and routing for court reporters

Connect clients, attorneys, and legal teams with the right court reporters instantly using smart, automated scheduling and routing.

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How automated scheduling for court reporters works

A modern approach to legal scheduling: connect, qualify, and route appointments with ease.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create tailored routing forms

Build custom forms to gather essential case details, jurisdiction, and language needs from clients or attorneys requesting a court reporter.

![Create form template for legal case scheduling, showing questions tailored for court reporting needs.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jpzCW5OiFXvRNYw3Fa8hJrho6Ew.png)

02

### Collect case and client information

Clients or legal teams fill out your form online, providing relevant information for precise routing and scheduling.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign the right court reporter

Based on case type, location, expertise, and availability, Cal.com instantly routes the booking to the most suitable court reporter on your team.

![Automated routing interface showing court reporters being assigned to legal cases or depositions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/kOUWJPxRhS195VLGnPVA1uJ2U.png)

### Faster case assignments

Instantly connect each legal request to the right court reporter, eliminating manual coordination and delays.

02

### Accurate reporter matching

Automatically match clients or attorneys with reporters based on language, certification, or specialty for every assignment.

Keep all parties in the loop with integrated notifications, reminders, and calendar syncs.

04

### Flexible self-hosting and compliance

Operate on your infrastructure with open-source flexibility and maintain strict control over sensitive legal data.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help court reporting agencies reduce scheduling workload?

Cal.com automates the entire booking and assignment process. Agencies can collect all necessary case details up front, then instantly match and route requests to available court reporters, saving hours of manual coordination.

Can I route cases to court reporters based on specialty or certification?

Yes. Cal.com’s attribute-based routing lets you assign bookings by specialty, certification, language fluency, or jurisdiction, ensuring the right match for every case.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for legal data?

Cal.com offers self-hosting and strict data controls, so legal teams can manage data on their infrastructure and meet compliance requirements. Our platform is open source and designed with privacy in mind.

What integrations does Cal.com offer for legal workflows?

Cal.com integrates with major calendar providers, case management tools like Clio, video conferencing platforms, and more, enabling seamless communication and workflow automation.

How does automated routing improve client experience?

Clients and legal teams receive instant confirmation and reminders, experience fewer scheduling errors, and connect with reporters who best fit their needs, leading to higher satisfaction.

Can I customize the booking forms for different case types or jurisdictions?

Absolutely. You can build custom routing forms for each case type, jurisdiction, or service variation, and adjust questions to capture all required details.

What is the cost for legal agencies to use Cal.com’s advanced routing features?

Cal.com’s routing features are available as part of our Organizations plan, with transparent pricing and no hidden fees. See our pricing page for details or contact us for a custom quote.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help creative agencies manage new client requests?

Cal.com's routing forms let agencies collect key project details up front and automatically assign inquiries to the right team or specialist, reducing manual handoff and speeding up response times.

Can we customize intake forms to fit our agency's services?

Yes, you can fully customize routing forms with fields for project type, budget, preferred timelines, and more. Tailor forms for each service or team within your agency.

Does Cal.com support team-based scheduling for agencies with multiple departments?

Absolutely. You can set up routing logic that directs clients to the most appropriate department—whether it's design, branding, video, or digital marketing—based on their responses.

How does Cal.com handle returning clients?

Cal.com can automatically recognize repeat clients and route them to their existing account manager or creative lead, ensuring continuity and a personalized experience.

Is it possible to qualify leads before booking a discovery call?

Yes, use form questions to qualify leads based on project size, budget, or timeline. Only qualified leads are routed to your team for follow-up or meetings.

Can we embed the scheduling and routing forms on our agency website?

Definitely. Cal.com forms can be embedded directly on your website, allowing prospects to start the intake process seamlessly from your site.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling client data?

Cal.com is open source, privacy-focused, and can be self-hosted for full control. All data is encrypted and you can choose where it's stored to meet your compliance needs.

# Flexible scheduling and smart routing for creative teams

Automate client bookings and project matching for agencies, studios, and creative professionals with open scheduling infrastructure.

How it works

## How automated routing works for creative industries

Effortlessly connect clients to the right creative talent or service using Cal.com’s advanced routing forms.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create your custom routing forms

Design forms to capture client needs, project details, and preferred creative services before booking.

![Create form template for creative industry: fields for client project details and preferences.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/f8BOthsrTNS1m2x9ub0vnqfmRP8.png)

02

### Let clients share their project vision

Clients answer tailored questions about their creative goals, ensuring every inquiry is qualified.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Match clients to the right creative talent

Based on responses, route clients to the most suitable designer, developer, or project manager for a seamless booking experience.

![Automated routing for creative teams: assign bookings to design, development, PM, copy, or illustration.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/v6wm7kkNREJePjqTJknZuvChxgg.png)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help creative agencies automate project bookings?

Cal.com lets agencies automate client intake with routing forms, qualifying leads and instantly matching them to the right creative team member based on project type, skills, or availability.

Can I customize the booking process to reflect my agency’s brand?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers extensive customization options, including branded forms, custom fields, and embeddable schedulers that match your agency’s identity.

How does Cal.com handle team-based project assignments?

Attribute-based routing enables you to assign client projects to the right designer, developer, or project manager automatically, reducing manual hand-offs and response times.

Is Cal.com suitable for freelancers and small studios as well as large creative teams?

Yes. Cal.com scales from solo professionals to large agencies, offering flexibility for any team size and the option to self-host or use our managed cloud.

What integrations does Cal.com offer for creative workflows?

Cal.com integrates with tools like Slack, Notion, HubSpot, and Google Workspace, streamlining scheduling, communication, and project tracking in your creative stack.

How does Cal.com ensure data privacy for client projects?

With self-hosting options and secure cloud deployment, Cal.com gives you full control over your data and complies with industry-leading privacy standards.

Can Cal.com forms qualify creative project leads before booking?

Yes. Cal.com's routing forms can ask screening questions about project scope, budget, deadlines, and creative preferences to ensure every inquiry is relevant before a meeting is booked.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help automate talent-client matching in creative marketplaces?

Cal.com uses intelligent routing forms that gather project details and creative profiles, then automatically matches and schedules the right talent for each client request—eliminating manual review and speeding up placements.

Can I customize the routing forms to fit my creative marketplace’s needs?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing forms are fully customizable and code-free, allowing you to tailor questions, workflows, and routing logic to match the unique requirements of your platform.

Does Cal.com integrate with talent management or CRM software?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers robust integrations with major CRMs, applicant tracking systems, and other tools, ensuring a seamless flow of data for ownership assignment and follow-up.

Is Cal.com suitable for both small and large creative marketplaces?

Yes, Cal.com scales with your needs, supporting everything from boutique agencies to large talent platforms, offering self-hosting and open-source flexibility for full control.

How does Cal.com improve the client and creative experience?

By automating the matching and booking process, Cal.com eliminates scheduling friction, ensures faster responses, and enables creatives and clients to focus on collaboration, not admin.

Can I embed Cal.com scheduling directly into my platform?

Definitely. Cal.com provides easy embedding options and branded experiences, so your users never have to leave your marketplace to schedule a call or meeting.

What kind of analytics does Cal.com provide for marketplace operators?

Cal.com delivers detailed insights on routing effectiveness, conversion rates, booking completion, and user satisfaction, helping you continuously optimize your platform’s performance.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help customer support teams route inquiries more efficiently?

Cal.com lets you set up custom routing forms and rules, ensuring each customer request is matched to the right support agent or success manager based on criteria like issue type, customer tier, or location. This reduces manual assignment, speeds up resolutions, and improves team productivity.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our existing CRM or helpdesk?

Yes, Cal.com offers robust integrations with leading platforms like Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot, and more. You can sync customer data, route based on account ownership, and embed scheduling directly into your support workflows.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling sensitive customer data?

Absolutely. Cal.com is designed with security and privacy in mind. You can choose to self-host for maximum control, and the platform is compliant with industry standards such as GDPR and SOC 2.

How customizable are the routing rules for our specific support structure?

Cal.com's routing logic is highly flexible. You can define rules based on any customer attribute, support tier, or team specialization, and adapt workflows as your organization grows or changes.

Can we use Cal.com for both customer support and success teams?

Definitely. Cal.com supports multi-team routing, so you can use it to assign inquiries for both support and success departments, ensuring every customer gets the right level of service.

What analytics does Cal.com provide to improve our support operations?

You can track key metrics like response times, assignment patterns, and customer satisfaction. Cal.com's insights help you optimize routing logic, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement.

How easy is it to get started with Cal.com for support routing?

Getting started is simple. You can build routing forms, set up team assignments, and integrate with your existing systems in just a few steps. Cal.com's documentation and support make onboarding smooth for teams of any size.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help automate trial class bookings for new students?

Cal.com lets you create custom booking forms where prospective students or parents select their preferred style, age group, and times. The system then automatically routes them to the best-fit trial class and sends confirmations, freeing your staff from manual coordination.

Can I use Cal.com to match students to instructors based on their experience or style?

Yes, with attribute-based routing, Cal.com can assign students to specific instructors or classes according to their skill level, dance style interests, and availability, ensuring every student gets the right fit.

Does Cal.com support recurring class schedules and multi-week courses?

Absolutely. Cal.com handles one-off bookings, recurring classes, and multi-session courses. Students can book series or ongoing classes, and the system manages all reminders and updates automatically.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with my dance school's existing CRM or communication tools?

Yes, Cal.com offers an API-first architecture and integrates with popular CRMs, email marketing platforms, and student management systems, so all your data stays connected.

How does Cal.com help reduce no-shows and keep classes full?

Automated reminders and confirmations via email and SMS help students remember their classes. The routing engine also fills open spots efficiently, so your schedule stays optimized.

Can I customize the intake forms to collect waivers or special requirements?

Definitely. Cal.com forms are fully customizable, allowing you to gather waivers, medical notes, or any other information required for your classes during the booking process.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant with student privacy regulations?

Yes, Cal.com can be self-hosted for complete control over your data, and it supports compliance with privacy regulations relevant to educational institutions.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help DEI consultants match clients to the right expert?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you collect detailed intake information and automatically assign each request to the consultant whose skills and experience best fit the client’s needs.

Can I create custom intake questions for organizations seeking DEI services?

Yes, you can fully customize intake forms to ask about the organization’s DEI priorities, location, industry, and more, ensuring accurate match-making.

Does Cal.com support scheduling for team-based DEI workshops or training?

Absolutely. Cal.com makes it easy to schedule individual or group sessions, recurring training, and multi-consultant events.

Is Cal.com secure enough for sensitive DEI consulting data?

Cal.com offers robust security features, including self-hosting, role-based access, and compliance with privacy standards, so you can manage sensitive client data with confidence.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my CRM or workflow tools?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with popular CRMs and productivity tools, streamlining your client intake and follow-up processes.

How does Cal.com support scaling my DEI consulting practice?

You can add new consultants, manage complex availability, and automate routing for increased intake volume, making it easy to grow your practice.

What makes Cal.com better than other scheduling platforms for DEI consultants?

Cal.com stands out with its open-source flexibility, API-first design, self-hosting options, and advanced routing features tailored for consulting workflows.

How it works

## How automated demo scheduling works

Route hardware and IoT demo requests to the best specialist in three simple steps.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Configure your routing logic

Set up smart forms to capture prospect details, requirements, and region. Use attribute-based routing to assign each demo to the right technical expert or sales engineer.

![Create form template for hardware and IoT demo scheduling, highlighting key qualifying questions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tUG2QvlxCdLa8pWuEJkpEDGTA0.png)

02

### Prospects submit demo requests

Embed the customized routing form on your site or landing page. Prospects provide information such as company size, industry, device type, or integration needs.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Instantly assign and schedule demos

Based on responses, Cal.com routes each request to the most qualified team member and instantly schedules a demo, reducing manual triage and speeding up the sales cycle.

![Automated routing example for hardware and IoT demo requests, assigning prospects to technical team members.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Or3sVbc8uzdeEqDpqaMkGdbsow.png)

## Key features for hardware and IoT demo routing

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve demo scheduling for hardware and IoT teams?

Cal.com streamlines demo scheduling by using smart routing forms to capture prospect details and automatically match them with the right hardware or IoT specialist. This removes manual triage, reduces response times, and improves the customer experience.

Can I route demo requests based on device type or technical requirements?

Yes, Cal.com's attribute-based routing allows you to route demo requests based on device type, integration needs, region, or any custom field relevant to your hardware or IoT product.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM or support tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers deep integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, and other CRMs to sync demo requests, assign ownership, and keep your sales pipeline organized.

Can I embed the routing form on our website or product page?

Yes, you can easily embed Cal.com routing forms on your website, landing pages, or support portals. The forms are fully customizable and can match your branding.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for enterprise hardware companies?

Cal.com supports self-hosting, SSO, and granular permissions, making it ideal for enterprises with strict data, privacy, and compliance requirements. You can deploy on your own infrastructure or use Cal.com Cloud.

How does ownership assignment work for existing customers or accounts?

If a prospect is already assigned to an account executive or technical resource in your CRM, Cal.com will automatically route the demo to the correct owner, ensuring continuity and personalization.

What level of customization is possible for routing logic?

Cal.com is API-first and open source, allowing you to customize routing logic for complex hardware and IoT workflows, including multi-step qualification, regional assignment, and integration with internal systems.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do routing forms help dental and orthodontic offices?

Cal.com's routing forms gather key patient details during booking and automatically assign the right provider or service, reducing manual work and ensuring every appointment is matched accurately.

Is patient data secure and compliant with HIPAA?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted and is designed with robust security in mind. This allows practices to maintain control over sensitive patient data and meet HIPAA requirements.

Can we route patients across multiple dental locations?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports multi-location practices, ensuring patients are routed to the nearest or most appropriate provider based on location, specialty, and availability.

How do customizable forms improve patient experience?

Tailored intake forms let you collect relevant info up front, such as insurance and dental history, so appointments are faster and more productive for both patients and staff.

Can existing patients be matched with their regular dentist or orthodontist?

Yes. Cal.com supports ownership assignment, so returning patients are automatically routed to their primary provider, ensuring continuity of care.

How does Cal.com integrate with our existing dental software?

Cal.com offers an API-first platform and can integrate with major EHR, calendar, and communication tools to keep your workflow seamless and up to date.

What does onboarding and support look like for dental offices?

We provide detailed documentation, dedicated support, and migration guidance to ensure a smooth transition and ongoing success for your practice.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help design agencies qualify and route new clients?

Cal.com’s routing forms let agencies collect detailed project requirements and client preferences upfront. The platform then uses this data to match each client with the most suitable designer or team automatically, eliminating manual triage and saving valuable time.

Can we customize the intake forms for different design services or project types?

Yes, Cal.com’s intake forms are fully customizable. You can create separate forms or add conditional logic to tailor questions for branding, web, UX/UI, or other design services, ensuring you gather the right information for each.

Does Cal.com support assigning returning clients to their previous designer?

Absolutely. With ownership assignment, returning clients are automatically recognized and routed to their previous designer, providing a personalized and consistent experience.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com routing with our CRM and project management tools?

Yes. Cal.com’s API-first architecture and wide range of integrations allow you to connect your routing workflows to popular CRMs, Slack, Trello, Asana, and more, keeping your agency’s operations seamless.

Can we embed these routing forms directly on our website or client portals?

Definitely. Cal.com routing forms are easy to embed on your agency website, landing pages, or client portals, and you can customize them to match your branding.

How does Cal.com ensure the right designer is assigned to each project?

Using attribute-based routing, Cal.com evaluates project details and client responses, then matches each inquiry to designers based on specialty, availability, or other criteria you define.

Is Cal.com secure and suitable for agencies with sensitive client data?

Yes. Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted, giving agencies control over their data. The platform also follows robust security best practices to protect client information.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my agency qualify leads before booking?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you ask screening questions about marketing goals, budget, target audience, and preferred services. Based on responses, only qualified leads are routed to your team, saving time and boosting win rates.

What integrations are available for digital marketing agencies?

Cal.com connects with popular CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce, project management tools, Google Calendar, Slack, and more. This keeps your pipeline, campaigns, and communications in sync.

Can I assign leads to specialists based on campaign type or expertise?

Yes. Use attribute-based routing to automatically direct inquiries to the right strategist, account manager, or creative expert depending on the campaign’s needs or client profile.

Is it possible to embed Cal.com forms on my agency’s website or landing pages?

Absolutely. You can embed routing and scheduling forms directly on your website, microsites, or client portals for a seamless branded experience.

How does Cal.com support agencies working in multiple regions or time zones?

Cal.com automatically detects client time zones and can route inquiries to regional teams, ensuring every lead is matched with the right local expert and available time slots.

Can Cal.com automate recurring campaign review or client check-in meetings?

Yes. Set up recurring event types or group bookings for campaign reviews, reporting calls, or client check-ins. Cal.com handles reminders and team assignments automatically.

What’s the difference between Cal.com and other agency scheduling tools?

Cal.com is open source, API-first, and fully customizable. Unlike closed platforms, you can self-host, brand the experience, build custom integrations, and adapt routing logic to fit your exact agency processes.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com’s routing help marketing agencies manage leads?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you segment and qualify leads automatically, assigning each new inquiry to the right campaign specialist or strategist. This reduces manual triage and ensures prospects quickly connect with the team member best suited to their goals.

Can I integrate Cal.com with HubSpot or Salesforce for marketing workflows?

Yes, Cal.com offers direct integrations with major CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce. You can sync contacts, track lead journeys, and automate assignment based on ownership or campaign.

Can I route based on campaign type, budget, or industry?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s attribute-based logic lets you create routing rules using any field you specify, such as campaign type, client budget, or vertical. This ensures every prospect meets the right expert.

Are routing forms easy to customize for different marketing services?

Yes. Cal.com’s no-code form builder lets you design and update forms for any campaign or service, from SEO consults to paid media audits, without technical help.

How does ownership assignment work for returning clients?

Cal.com detects existing client relationships in your CRM and automatically assigns meetings to their dedicated account manager or strategist, providing seamless continuity.

Is it possible to embed scheduling and routing forms on our agency website?

Yes, you can embed Cal.com forms directly into your website or landing pages, offering a seamless branded booking and routing experience for your prospects.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for marketing teams?

Cal.com provides real-time insights into form completions, lead routing, and meeting outcomes, helping you optimize conversion and track campaign performance.

Routing for DJ/music booking

# Effortless routing for DJ and music bookings

Connect event planners and venues with the perfect DJ or music act using Cal.com's intelligent routing forms. Automate the booking process, match clients with the right talent, and streamline scheduling for entertainment professionals.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![DJ/music booking routing form with event-specific questions and performer matching.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Uo9Wi3wLUivR9cPh6dHXvzJP4Fo.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to smarter music act routing

Guide clients from inquiry to booking the best DJ or music act for their event in just a few steps.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create your music act routes

Set up customizable routing forms to capture event details and preferences from clients and venues.

![Creating custom event fields for DJ/music booking forms.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/6F0eD6WbDj3C6xIgnhmplmASqHg.png)

02

### Let clients share event info

Clients fill in key event information, such as event type, date, location, and music preferences, before booking.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Match with the right performer

Based on their responses, Cal.com automatically routes the booking to DJs or music acts that best fit the event's requirements.

![Automated performer routing for DJ and music bookings.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/pTNGloUg64fOpwUMqpTrgDaZA8.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Boost event bookings with intelligent routing

Cal.com automates the DJ and music act assignment process, ensuring every client is connected with the right talent for their event, improving satisfaction and saving time.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Faster talent assignment

Instantly match clients with available DJs or music acts based on event type, genre, and location. Reduce delays and manual coordination for seamless bookings.

02

### Custom experiences for every event

Personalize the booking journey by collecting client preferences and event details. Ensure every event gets the right music vibe and performer.

![Insights on DJ/music act bookings and routing.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QfdVTfPdpw8HZ0JlayfiMrxHHM.png)

03

### Open-source flexibility and control

Cal.com's open-source platform gives entertainment agencies and booking managers the freedom to self-host, customize workflows, and integrate with existing tools for complete control.

04

### Seamless collaboration and integrations

Collaborate effortlessly with teams, performers, and clients. Integrate Cal.com with your CRM, ticketing, or communication tools to keep everyone in sync.

## All the tools you need for music booking automation

Modern routing features designed for entertainment professionals and agencies.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Advanced routing forms

Capture detailed event requirements and client preferences through customizable, no-code forms.

### Attribute-based performer matching

Assign bookings to DJs or music acts based on genre, availability, location, or experience level.

### Ownership assignment for repeat clients

Automatically route returning clients to their preferred or previously booked performers for a personalized experience.

### Analytics and insights

Track booking patterns, client preferences, and performer assignments to optimize your process and maximize event success.

### Multi-step forms for complex events

Break down booking into easy steps, gathering all necessary details for large or multi-act events.

### Embedded forms and white-labeling

Embed routing forms on your agency or venue website, fully branded for your business.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve the DJ and music booking process?

Cal.com automates the matching of clients to DJs or music acts based on their event details and preferences. This eliminates manual back-and-forth, reduces errors, and speeds up the booking process for agencies, venues, and clients alike.

Can I customize routing forms for different event types or music genres?

Yes, Cal.com lets you fully customize routing forms to capture specifics like event type, preferred genres, budget, and more, ensuring clients are always matched with the right performer.

Does Cal.com support team collaboration for agencies or talent managers?

Absolutely. Cal.com makes it easy for teams to manage multiple performers, track bookings, and coordinate schedules from a single dashboard, improving efficiency for agencies and promoters.

Is it possible to assign bookings to preferred or returning DJs and acts?

Yes. Cal.com’s ownership assignment feature can automatically route repeat clients to their preferred or previous performers, creating a seamless experience for both sides.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my existing booking or CRM tools?

Cal.com offers native integrations and an API-first approach so you can connect with popular CRM, ticketing, and communication platforms. Learn more in our App Store or Help Center.

How secure is client and performer data on Cal.com?

Cal.com is built with enterprise-grade security in mind. You can self-host for maximum control, and all data is protected with modern encryption and privacy standards.

What does it cost to use Cal.com for DJ and music booking automation?

Cal.com offers flexible plans for individuals, agencies, and enterprises. Visit our pricing page for details or contact us for a demo tailored to your needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support privacy and compliance for educational institutions?

Cal.com lets you self-host or use compliant cloud infrastructure, supporting FERPA and other data privacy requirements for schools and universities.

Can Cal.com route bookings between multiple departments or campuses?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing forms and attribute-based logic allow you to route meetings based on department, campus, grade, or any custom field.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with our student information system (SIS)?

Cal.com offers an API-first approach and supports integrations with popular SIS and LMS platforms, making it easy to connect to your existing systems.

Can staff customize the booking forms for different use cases?

Absolutely. Create custom forms for academic advising, counseling, parent-teacher conferences, or administrative meetings, each with relevant questions.

How does Cal.com handle group sessions like workshops or office hours?

Set up group events that allow multiple students to book into a single session, perfect for workshops, seminars, or open office hours.

Does Cal.com support notifications for students and staff?

Yes, automated email and calendar notifications keep all parties informed of bookings, reschedules, or cancellations.

Is there a way to track and analyze scheduling trends across the institution?

Cal.com provides analytics dashboards so you can monitor meeting volumes, response times, and overall engagement to optimize resource allocation.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com routing forms help email marketing agencies qualify demo requests?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you ask targeted questions upfront, such as campaign goals, company size, or email list volume. This information is used to segment, qualify, and direct each booking to the specialist best equipped to close the deal, saving time and improving conversion rates.

Can Cal.com assign meetings based on account ownership in our CRM?

Yes. Cal.com integrates with major CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce, automatically assigning bookings to the appropriate account owner or sales rep, ensuring continuity and a personalized client experience.

Is it possible to embed routing forms on our agency website or SaaS product landing pages?

Absolutely. Cal.com routing forms are easy to embed, fully customizable, and can be styled to match your branding. This allows you to capture leads directly from your site and route them instantly to the right team member.

How does Cal.com support agencies with multiple service lines or products?

You can create multiple routing forms or logic paths within one form to segment leads by service line, product interest, or campaign type. Each path can be assigned to different specialists or teams for tailored follow-up.

Does Cal.com offer advanced analytics to track lead quality and booking outcomes?

Yes. Cal.com provides insights on form submissions, booking rates, lead quality, and routing efficiency, giving you the data you need to optimize your marketing and sales operations.

Can we self-host Cal.com to keep client data private and compliant?

Yes, Cal.com is open source and self-hostable. This gives your agency full control over data residency, security, and compliance, with robust SSO and permission management.

What integrations are available for marketing automation and communication?

Cal.com supports integrations with popular tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace, and many more, enabling automated notifications, record updates, and streamlined workflows.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help estate planners qualify and route new clients?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you ask screening questions up front—like estate size, service needs, or urgency. Based on responses, clients are matched to the right attorney or specialist, ensuring faster and more effective client intake.

Can we customize the intake forms for different estate planning services?

Yes. You can create different forms for wills, trusts, probate, or tax planning, each with custom questions and routing logic relevant to that service.

Does Cal.com integrate with our legal CRM or case management software?

Cal.com offers powerful integrations and APIs, including support for popular legal CRMs. This ensures booked clients are automatically routed to their assigned attorney or team.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for legal client data?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers self-hosting and open-source options, giving you full control over your client data and helping you meet legal and privacy requirements.

Can our team assign urgent or VIP clients to specific attorneys?

Yes. Attribute-based routing lets you prioritize and direct high-value or urgent cases to senior partners or specialists.

How do analytics help improve our intake process?

Built-in analytics let you track form responses, booking rates, and attorney workloads. This insight helps optimize your intake, routing, and team allocation over time.

Can Cal.com forms be embedded on our firm’s website?

Yes. You can embed routing forms directly onto your firm’s website, ensuring a seamless client experience that matches your branding.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my event agency manage high lead volumes?

Cal.com’s routing forms automatically qualify and direct incoming leads to the right event specialist, ensuring no opportunity is missed and preventing bottlenecks during busy seasons.

Can we customize forms for different event types like weddings or corporate events?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s no-code form builder lets you tailor questions and routing logic for any event type your agency handles, from private celebrations to large corporate gatherings.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing CRM or event management tools?

Yes, Cal.com offers integrations with popular CRMs and project management platforms. You can sync client data and bookings to keep your workflow seamless and organized.

How secure is client and event information on Cal.com?

Cal.com is committed to privacy and security. With self-hosting options and robust encryption, your agency’s and clients’ data stays protected and under your control.

Can we assign repeat clients to the same event manager automatically?

Yes, Cal.com’s ownership assignment ensures returning clients are always routed to their dedicated manager, enhancing client relationships and continuity.

Is Cal.com suitable for agencies with remote or distributed teams?

Definitely. Cal.com’s cloud-based and API-first infrastructure makes it easy for agencies of any size or structure to automate scheduling and routing wherever your team works.

What support is available if we need help setting up routing for our agency?

Our expert support team is ready to help you configure routing forms, integrations, and workflows. You can also access detailed guides in the Cal.com Help Center.

## How event venue routing works

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help event venues manage bookings?

Cal.com automates the entire booking workflow for venues, from inquiry to space assignment. With customizable routing forms and integrations, you can ensure every request reaches the right team member quickly and accurately.

Can Cal.com handle different event types and requirements?

Yes. Cal.com’s attribute-based routing lets you match clients to the perfect space or specialist based on event type, size, and other custom criteria.

Is Cal.com easy to integrate with existing venue software?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers robust API access and pre-built integrations with major CRMs and calendars, making it easy to fit into your current tech stack.

Can we brand Cal.com to match our venue’s identity?

Yes. With Cal.com’s open-source and white-label options, you can fully customize the booking experience to reflect your venue’s brand.

How does Cal.com help reduce booking errors or double-booking?

Automated routing and real-time calendar sync prevent double bookings and ensure every event is assigned correctly. Notifications keep your team and clients informed at every step.

What if we have multiple locations or event spaces?

Cal.com supports complex routing logic, so you can manage multiple venues or spaces from a single dashboard, routing requests to the right place based on client input.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling client data?

Yes. Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted for maximum data control, supporting compliance with privacy standards relevant to the event industry.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help manage complex event schedules with multiple sessions or tracks?

Cal.com lets you create dynamic routing forms that assign attendees to the correct sessions based on their preferences or ticket types. This ensures accurate scheduling and prevents overbooking, even for large multi-track events.

Can I customize booking forms for different types of events or attendee segments?

Yes, you can fully customize forms to gather any information needed, such as session interests, dietary restrictions, or networking goals. This flexibility allows you to personalize the attendee experience for every event.

How does automated attendee routing work in Cal.com?

Attendees answer questions during booking, and Cal.com's routing logic directs them to the right sessions, hosts, or event teams based on their responses. This removes manual work and creates a seamless booking flow.

Does Cal.com integrate with event registration platforms and CRMs?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers integrations with leading event registration tools, CRMs, and marketing platforms, making it easy to sync attendee data and communications across your event tech stack.

Is Cal.com suitable for both virtual and in-person events?

Yes, Cal.com supports scheduling and routing for both virtual and in-person events, allowing you to manage bookings, hosts, and attendee communications in any format.

Can I embed Cal.com booking and routing forms on my event website?

You can easily embed Cal.com forms on your website or landing pages, matching your branding and streamlining the registration and scheduling experience for attendees.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for event organizers?

Cal.com delivers real-time insights on attendee bookings, session popularity, and routing efficiency, helping you make data-driven decisions and improve future events.

# Smarter scheduling and routing for executive assistants

Effortlessly coordinate meetings and priorities with advanced routing forms

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Routing form for executive assistants with key questions about executive selection, priority, and meeting topic.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fzTQgLB3J9CJ0xVH2TFfZMxxlrE.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com routing empowers executive assistants

Simplify scheduling and keep executives focused with intelligent routing workflows designed for fast-paced business environments.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create tailored routing forms

Build custom intake forms that collect details about meeting type, urgency, and executive preference, ensuring every request lands in the right hands.

![Executive assistant routing form creation interface, with prompts to add questions for meeting details and executive selection.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/m4IjS1QhGYCT7gChIC1nWdJKbg.png)

02

### Let requesters provide key information

Internal and external stakeholders can answer your preset questions, making it easy to route requests based on priority, department, or individual executive.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically direct requests to the right executive

Based on responses, Cal.com routes each booking to the correct executive or team member, optimizing calendars and reducing manual coordination.

![Automated routing table displaying executive assistants and executive office teams.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/k5GtVWTQ16BdbgrstNQt8hkeLc.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

Experience seamless scheduling, improved productivity, and fewer interruptions for your executives.

### Enhance executive productivity

### Increase accuracy and accountability

04

### Scale across teams and departments

Handle high volumes of requests for multiple executives with customizable forms and scalable workflows.

## Features designed for executive assistants

Built for flexibility, privacy, and enterprise-grade efficiency.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Match requests to executives based on department, project, or priority using powerful attribute-based logic.

### Ownership assignment

Automatically route requests to the executive or assistant who owns the relationship, syncing with tools like Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.

### Customizable multi-step forms

Gather the right information up front with branded, multi-step intake forms tailored to your organization's needs.

### Workflow automation and integrations

Connect Cal.com with Slack, Microsoft Teams, CRMs, and more to automate notifications, approvals, and calendar updates.

### Privacy and access controls

Define who can book with which executive, and manage permission levels for sensitive schedules.

### Actionable analytics

Gain insights into request volume, routing efficiency, and assistant workload to continuously improve scheduling processes.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help executive assistants manage multiple executives' calendars?

Cal.com enables executive assistants to build routing forms that intelligently assign meetings to the right executive based on criteria like department, urgency, or custom attributes. This centralizes scheduling and reduces manual coordination across multiple calendars.

Can I customize intake forms for different executives or departments?

Yes, you can create unique routing forms for each executive, department, or use case. This allows you to tailor questions and routing logic to fit the specific needs of your organization and its leaders.

Does Cal.com integrate with Microsoft Outlook and Google Workspace?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports direct integrations with both Outlook and Google Workspace, allowing for seamless two-way syncing and real-time calendar updates.

How does Cal.com ensure privacy for executive schedules?

You have full control over who can view and book meetings with each executive. Cal.com offers permission management, access controls, and data privacy features to protect sensitive schedules.

Can I automate approval workflows for meeting requests?

Yes. Cal.com allows you to configure workflows that require approval from the executive or assistant before a booking is confirmed, ensuring full control over the calendar.

Is it possible to track scheduling analytics and workload?

Cal.com provides analytics dashboards that show request volumes, routing outcomes, and time spent on coordination, helping assistants and organizations optimize efficiency.

Can Cal.com be self-hosted for extra security?

Yes, Cal.com offers self-hosting options, giving your organization total control over data, compliance, and integration with internal systems.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help executive coaches match clients to the right coach?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you collect client goals, areas of focus, or seniority level during booking, then automatically assign each new client to the coach best equipped to meet their needs.

Can I customize intake forms for different coaching specialties?

Yes. You can fully customize routing and intake forms to include questions tailored to leadership, team, or performance coaching, ensuring every client is matched appropriately.

Does Cal.com integrate with video conferencing and CRM tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com connects with popular video platforms like Zoom and Google Meet, as well as leading CRM systems and productivity tools, streamlining your entire coaching workflow.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for privacy and compliance?

Yes. Cal.com is open-source and allows self-hosting, giving you complete control over your client data and compliance with industry regulations.

How does Cal.com handle team-based scheduling for multiple coaches?

Cal.com supports multi-coach organizations, round robin and attribute-based routing, so clients are always matched with the right coach based on your defined criteria.

Can I automate reminders and follow-ups for coaching sessions?

Yes, Cal.com automates reminders and follow-ups, reducing no-shows and helping you and your clients stay on track.

What kind of analytics does Cal.com provide for coaching businesses?

You get detailed insights into bookings, client preferences, and coach performance, allowing you to improve operations and client experience.

How does Cal.com help family law firms manage client intake?

Cal.com allows firms to create custom intake forms that gather all essential client information upfront. This helps qualify leads, route inquiries to the best-suited attorney, and streamline follow-up, reducing time spent on manual data entry and screening.

Can Cal.com route clients based on case type or urgency?

Yes. With attribute-based routing, Cal.com intelligently matches clients to attorneys or paralegals based on case attributes such as divorce, custody, mediation, or urgency, ensuring each inquiry is handled by the right professional.

Is Cal.com secure enough for sensitive client information?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports self-hosting and offers robust privacy and compliance features, including GDPR compliance, to protect your clients’ sensitive information.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our existing legal CRM or practice management tools?

Yes. Cal.com offers integrations with popular legal CRMs like Clio and Salesforce, as well as Zapier and other automation tools, so your intake and scheduling data flows seamlessly into your existing workflows.

How does automated routing improve our firm’s responsiveness?

Automated routing eliminates the need for manual assignment, connecting clients to available attorneys quickly. This leads to faster response times, improved client satisfaction, and more efficient use of staff resources.

Can Cal.com handle multi-step intake processes for complex family law cases?

Yes. You can design multi-step forms that guide clients through detailed intake questions relevant to their case, ensuring you have all the information needed for effective routing and consultation.

Does Cal.com support different scheduling options for attorneys with varying availability?

Cal.com lets each attorney set their own availability, so clients can only book with attorneys who are truly available for new consultations, reducing scheduling conflicts and administrative overhead.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help florists and caterers manage event bookings?

Cal.com eliminates manual coordination by automating client routing and event scheduling. It ensures every inquiry is matched with the right team member, saving time and reducing errors.

Can I customize the routing forms for different event types?

Yes, you can easily create and customize routing forms for weddings, corporate events, private parties, and more. Tailor questions to capture every detail you need from clients.

Does Cal.com integrate with my existing business tools?

Cal.com integrates with major calendar platforms, CRMs, and payment processors. You can connect your preferred tools to streamline workflow and communications.

Is it possible to set availability for specific florists or caterers?

Absolutely. Each team member can set their own availability, ensuring bookings only occur when they are free and avoiding scheduling conflicts.

How does Cal.com handle high volumes of inquiries during peak seasons?

Cal.com’s automated routing and round-robin assignment efficiently distribute leads among available team members, ensuring timely responses even during your busiest times.

Can I track and analyze my booking data?

Yes, Cal.com provides analytics on bookings, team performance, and client preferences. Use these insights to optimize services and grow your business.

Is Cal.com secure and does it protect client data?

Cal.com is built with security in mind, offering robust data protection whether you use the cloud or self-hosted options. Your client information remains safe and compliant.
