## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help startups and accelerators streamline founder meetings?

Cal.com automates the intake, routing, and scheduling of meetings between founders and relevant advisors, investors, or mentors. This eliminates manual coordination and ensures every founder connects with the right stakeholder quickly.

Can I customize routing logic for different founder needs or programs?

Yes. Cal.com allows you to set custom routing rules based on any attribute, such as company stage, industry, or funding round. This lets you tailor the experience for accelerators, pitch days, or mentorship sessions.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM and Slack workspace?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers native integrations with popular CRMs and Slack. All meeting data is synced, and notifications can be automated within your workspace.

Is Cal.com secure for handling sensitive founder and company data?

Yes. Cal.com provides robust security features, including self-hosting, role-based access, and GDPR compliance, giving you full control over data privacy.

How does Cal.com scale for demo days or large networking events?

Cal.com’s routing forms and automated scheduling can handle high volumes of meetings simultaneously. This makes it perfect for demo days, large-scale networking, or accelerator cohorts.

Can founders book different types of meetings, such as group sessions or one-on-ones?

Yes. Cal.com supports a range of event types, including one-on-ones, group meetings, and round robins, so founders can book the format that fits their goals.

What does it take to get started with Cal.com for founder meeting routing?

You can start with our hosted solution or deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure. Set up is simple, and you can tailor routing forms and integrations to your community’s needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help franchise sales teams streamline lead routing?

Cal.com allows you to automate the entire process from lead capture to assignment. With dynamic forms, you can screen leads and instantly route them to the right sales representative, eliminating manual triage and reducing response times.

Can I assign franchise leads based on region or territory?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing logic supports territory-based assignments. Leads are automatically matched with the appropriate sales rep based on their location or other criteria you define.

Does Cal.com integrate with popular CRMs for franchise management?

Absolutely. Cal.com connects with Salesforce, HubSpot, and many other CRMs, ensuring seamless lead handoff and data consistency throughout your sales workflow.

Can I customize the qualifying questions for prospective franchisees?

Yes, you can fully tailor your routing forms with custom questions, multi-step flows, and conditional logic to fit your franchise’s unique qualification process.

Is Cal.com suitable for large, multi-location franchise organizations?

Definitely. Cal.com’s open-source, API-first platform is designed to scale, enabling centralized control and local flexibility for enterprise franchisors.

How does Cal.com ensure data privacy and compliance for franchise sales?

With self-hosting options and robust access controls, Cal.com helps you maintain compliance with industry regulations and your organization’s data policies.

What makes Cal.com different from other scheduling or routing tools for franchise sales?

Cal.com stands out with its open-source flexibility, deep customization, API-first architecture, and the ability to self-host—giving franchise organizations unmatched control and integration capabilities.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve freelancer-client matching?

Cal.com uses customizable Routing Forms to collect client requirements, then routes projects to the most qualified freelancers based on skills, experience, and availability, ensuring the right match every time.

Can Cal.com handle high volumes of bookings?

Yes. Cal.com’s scalable infrastructure supports thousands of bookings and complex routing logic, making it ideal for large or growing freelance platforms.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with my existing freelance marketplace?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers robust APIs and webhooks, enabling seamless integration with your platform’s backend, CRM, or custom workflows.

How does Cal.com manage freelancer availability?

Freelancers can sync their calendars with Cal.com, so only those available are shown to clients. This reduces scheduling conflicts and increases booking reliability.

Can I self-host Cal.com for data privacy?

Yes. Cal.com is fully open source and can be self-hosted, giving you complete control over your data and platform security.

What kinds of projects can be routed?

Any project type—short-term gigs, long-term contracts, consultations, or creative work—can be routed using custom forms and attributes tailored to your platform’s categories.

Does Cal.com support multiple languages or time zones?

Yes. Cal.com is built for global platforms, supporting multilingual forms and automatic time zone conversions for both clients and freelancers.

# Efficient scheduling and routing for gig economy apps

Connect gig workers and customers seamlessly with powerful, automated routing and scheduling infrastructure.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Cal.com routing form showcasing the creation of a customizable form for gig economy job requests. The form allows customers to specify service type, location, and timing, demonstrating flexible job-matching for on-demand platforms.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xBMjanq3jWOfz7pjF8Y5NGIEFYQ.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to automate gig worker assignments

See how Cal.com empowers gig economy platforms to connect workers with customers instantly.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up intelligent routing forms

Capture essential job and location details from customers with customizable, no-code forms tailored for your services.

![Create form template for gig economy job request, allowing platforms to tailor booking questions to service types and customer needs.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/v7Kd690BlVQspNL7JwVF5mw4.png)

02

### Match workers to jobs automatically

Use attribute-based routing to automatically assign the best available gig worker based on skills, proximity, and availability.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Track, analyze, and optimize assignments

Monitor real-time routing performance and worker utilization with integrated analytics tools.

![Automated routing interface for assigning gig economy jobs to workers in transportation, delivery, and home services teams.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/vJZFC8ZGa0MuuYyzmPbD2p2WeY.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for gig economy platforms

Unlock operational efficiency and deliver seamless user experiences for your marketplace.

01

### Automated job assignment

Reduce manual intervention and eliminate scheduling bottlenecks by connecting the right worker to the right job every time.

02

### Faster customer fulfillment

Minimize wait times and improve customer satisfaction with instant, intelligent matching of requests to available workers.

### Customizable open-source flexibility

04

### Deep integration capabilities

## Feature-rich infrastructure for on-demand scheduling

Power your gig economy app with a complete suite of scheduling and routing tools.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Match jobs to workers using custom attributes such as skills, location, or certifications for precise assignments.

### Multi-step request forms

Guide customers through dynamic, multi-step booking forms to collect all relevant details before assignment.

### Automated round robin and priority logic

Distribute jobs fairly or prioritize workers based on experience, ratings, or availability.

### Real-time availability sync

Connect with worker calendars and status to ensure only available gig workers receive assignments.

### Embedded and white-labeled booking flows

Seamlessly embed booking forms into your app or website and customize to reflect your brand.

### Workforce insights and analytics

Gain visibility into job routing, worker performance, and fulfillment speed to optimize operations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help match gig workers to customer requests?

Cal.com’s attribute-based routing forms allow you to automatically match each customer request with the most suitable available gig worker, considering location, skills, and availability in real-time.

Can I customize the booking and routing workflows for my marketplace?

Yes. Cal.com’s open-source infrastructure lets you fully customize booking flows, routing logic, and form fields to align with your gig platform’s unique requirements.

Does Cal.com support integration with workforce management and payment systems?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers robust API and webhook support so you can connect with your workforce management, payroll, and payment tools for end-to-end automation.

Is Cal.com scalable for high-volume on-demand platforms?

Yes. Cal.com is built for scalability, supporting thousands of concurrent bookings and worker assignments, making it ideal for fast-growing gig economy businesses.

Can gig workers manage their own schedules and availability?

Gig workers can sync their calendars, set their working hours, and update their availability directly through Cal.com, ensuring assignments are always up to date.

How does analytics work for gig worker assignments?

Cal.com provides detailed analytics on job routing, worker utilization, and response times, helping you identify bottlenecks and optimize your marketplace operations.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling worker and customer data?

Yes. Cal.com supports secure data handling and offers options for self-hosting, giving you full control over privacy and compliance with regulatory requirements.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support compliance and data privacy for government agencies?

Cal.com offers on-premises deployment and open-source code, giving government IT teams full control over data storage, privacy, and compliance with regulations like GDPR or local mandates.

Can Cal.com integrate with existing government systems?

Yes. Cal.com’s API-first architecture allows integration with government CRMs, communication platforms, and authentication systems, supporting smooth adoption without disrupting legacy workflows.

Is Cal.com accessible for citizens with disabilities or limited digital literacy?

Cal.com follows accessibility best practices and provides intuitive, easy-to-use interfaces that support diverse citizen needs, including screen readers and mobile devices.

How customizable are routing forms for different government services?

Routing forms can be tailored for any public service, such as licensing, social support, or public health, allowing departments to collect specific information and automate assignments.

What security features does Cal.com offer for sensitive government information?

Cal.com supports encryption, role-based access, and audit logs, and can be self-hosted to ensure sensitive data never leaves your infrastructure.

Can Cal.com handle high-volume appointment booking for events like elections or public health drives?

Yes. Cal.com is built to scale, supporting high-volume concurrent bookings and routing, making it ideal for mass public services or events.

Does Cal.com offer support and training for government teams?

Cal.com provides documentation, onboarding resources, and customer support to ensure smooth implementation and ongoing success for public sector organizations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support compliance in healthcare hiring?

Cal.com enables you to add compliance checks directly to your routing forms, including required certifications, background checks, or document uploads, ensuring every candidate meets your healthcare organization’s standards.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our ATS or HR software?

Yes, Cal.com offers robust integrations with leading ATS and HRIS platforms, allowing seamless data flow and automation from candidate intake to hire.

How does attribute-based routing benefit healthcare recruitment?

Attribute-based routing ensures that candidates are matched with recruiters or hiring managers specializing in their qualifications or location, reducing time wasted on manual reviews and improving placement accuracy.

Is Cal.com secure and HIPAA-ready for healthcare data?

Cal.com is built with security and privacy in mind. You can self-host for full data control, and we offer features to help you meet HIPAA and other healthcare data requirements.

How can we customize the candidate experience?

Easily tailor forms, questions, and workflows to reflect your organization’s branding and unique candidate journey, ensuring a consistent and professional experience.

Does Cal.com support high-volume or multi-location healthcare hiring?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s scalable infrastructure supports enterprise-level hiring, including multiple locations, teams, and complex routing logic for large healthcare organizations.

What makes Cal.com better than traditional scheduling tools for healthcare hiring?

Cal.com’s open-source flexibility, API-first architecture, and advanced routing features are purpose-built for healthcare recruitment, giving you full control and automation that legacy scheduling tools cannot match.

Create customized routing forms to collect key details from job seekers, such as desired roles, skills, and availability.

### Let candidates submit their information

### Automatically match candidates to employers

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help automate candidate routing for hiring marketplaces?

Cal.com uses customizable routing forms to collect candidate information and automatically match them with the most relevant employers, recruiters, or job listings based on predefined criteria.

Can I customize routing logic for different hiring use cases?

Yes, Cal.com supports complex, attribute-based routing logic. You can tailor rules to match candidates with employers by skills, location, availability, or any custom field relevant to your marketplace.

Does Cal.com integrate with popular ATS or CRM systems?

Cal.com offers integration with leading ATS and CRM platforms, enabling seamless candidate ownership assignment and synchronized workflows for recruiters and hiring managers.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling candidate data?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers self-hosting options and robust privacy controls, helping your marketplace stay compliant with data protection standards such as GDPR.

Can I embed Cal.com’s routing forms directly into my hiring platform?

Yes. Cal.com’s forms can be embedded seamlessly into your website or app, maintaining your brand experience and keeping candidates within your platform.

Does Cal.com support time zone management for global hiring?

Cal.com automatically detects and manages time zones to ensure interviews and meetings are scheduled at convenient times for both candidates and employers, reducing no-shows and improving engagement.

What makes Cal.com different from other scheduling solutions for hiring marketplaces?

Cal.com is open-source, API-first, and offers deep customization. You have full control to adapt routing logic, integrate with your tech stack, and scale as your hiring marketplace grows.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support HIPAA compliance for home healthcare organizations?

Cal.com offers self-hosting and enterprise deployment options, so you can maintain complete control over patient data and meet HIPAA requirements. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access controls can be customized for your team.

Can Cal.com integrate with our existing EMR or EHR systems?

Yes. Cal.com provides robust API integrations, webhooks, and pre-built connectors to many leading EMR and EHR platforms, enabling seamless data exchange and reducing double entry.

How does automated routing improve care delivery in home healthcare?

Automated routing accelerates patient intake, reduces manual triage, and ensures patients are matched with the most appropriate provider based on clinical criteria, geography, and availability. This leads to faster care and improved outcomes.

Can we customize intake forms for different types of care or patient populations?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s no-code form builder allows you to design custom intake forms for various services, conditions, or patient groups, collecting exactly the information your team needs.

Is Cal.com secure for handling sensitive patient information?

Cal.com is built with privacy and security as a foundation, offering role-based permissions, audit logs, and optional self-hosting to keep sensitive patient data under your control.

Can Cal.com support multi-disciplinary care team scheduling?

Yes. Cal.com enables coordinated scheduling across nurses, aides, therapists, and case managers, supporting both individual and team visits for complex care needs.

How quickly can our home healthcare organization get started with Cal.com?

Most teams can deploy Cal.com within days. You can start with cloud hosting or set up a private instance for full control. Our onboarding and support teams are ready to help you go live smoothly.

### Let clients tell you what they need

Clients fill out your form, specifying their service needs and preferred times.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Route requests to the best-matched pro

Based on client answers, Cal.com automatically matches and assigns the right team member or contractor, ensuring fast, reliable service.

Transform your booking workflow and customer satisfaction.

### Accelerate response times

Assign jobs instantly to the right technician or specialist, minimizing delays and missed opportunities.

### Reduce administrative overhead

Automate manual coordination, freeing up your team to focus on service delivery.

### Flexible and scalable

Adapt routing logic for any team size or specialty—from plumbers and electricians to cleaning crews and landscapers.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help home service teams route requests?

Cal.com uses customizable routing forms and smart assignment logic to automatically match each client with the best-suited service professional based on skill set, location, and availability.

Can I set up different booking forms for each type of home service?

Yes, you can create separate forms for services like plumbing, electrical, landscaping, and cleaning. Each form can include specific questions and routing rules.

Does Cal.com support team-based and individual contractor assignments?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s routing supports both team-based dispatch (round robin or attribute-based) and direct assignment to individual contractors or specialists.

How can I ensure repeat customers are routed to the same technician?

With ownership assignment, Cal.com routes returning clients to their previous service provider whenever possible, creating personalized and consistent experiences.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my existing CRM or job management tools?

Yes, Cal.com offers a range of integrations and an API-first approach so you can connect with popular CRMs, invoicing, or field service management software.

Is Cal.com suitable for franchise or multi-location home service businesses?

Definitely. Cal.com’s scalable infrastructure and customizable routing make it easy to support multiple branches, locations, or franchisees under a single platform.

How quickly can I get started with Cal.com for my home service company?

Most teams can launch tailored routing forms and automated scheduling within a day, thanks to Cal.com’s intuitive interface and extensive documentation.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my home staging company route client inquiries to the right expert?

Cal.com uses attribute-based routing forms, allowing you to assign inquiries to staging specialists based on criteria like property type, location, and project urgency. This ensures every client is matched with the most suitable team member for their project.

Can I customize the intake questions for different staging services?

Yes, Cal.com lets you create fully customizable forms, so you can collect all the information you need for different staging projects, whether residential, commercial, or vacant properties.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing CRM and calendar tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com integrates with leading CRMs and calendar platforms. Sync client bookings and team schedules automatically for seamless management.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling client data?

Cal.com is open-source and offers self-hosting options, giving you total control over your data and compliance with industry standards.

How quickly can my team get started with automated routing?

Set up only takes minutes. You can launch a custom routing form and begin automating bookings right away, with no coding required.

Can the routing logic handle multiple locations or teams?

Yes, Cal.com supports advanced logic to route inquiries based on location, team specialty, or any attribute relevant to your business.

What support is available if we need help setting up?

Cal.com provides detailed documentation, a dedicated help center, and responsive support to assist with onboarding and customization.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help immigration lawyers route clients effectively?

Cal.com enables law firms to build tailored intake forms that automatically assign clients to the most suitable attorney based on case type, language, and availability. This reduces manual work and ensures every client is matched with the right expert.

Can we customize intake forms for different visa types or legal services?

Yes, you can fully customize your routing forms to gather relevant details for each visa category or immigration service, ensuring precise and efficient assignment.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing practice management and CRM tools?

Cal.com offers robust integrations with leading CRMs, calendars, and practice management platforms, allowing data to flow seamlessly and reducing duplicated effort.

How does Cal.com ensure client data privacy and legal compliance?

Cal.com supports self-hosting, so you can keep all sensitive data on your own servers. Our platform is designed with privacy and compliance in mind, helping you meet legal obligations.

Can we route clients to attorneys based on language or regional expertise?

Absolutely. Attribute-based routing lets you assign clients to lawyers with specific language skills, regional experience, or other relevant attributes.

Is Cal.com suitable for multi-location or remote immigration law firms?

Yes, Cal.com is built for distributed teams and multi-office law firms. Automated routing ensures every client is connected to the right attorney, regardless of location.

How does analytics help us improve our client intake process?

Cal.com's analytics dashboard provides insights into client inquiries, conversion rates, and team workloads, helping you make data-driven improvements.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help influencer agencies match brands with the right creators?

Cal.com’s routing forms let agencies collect detailed brand requirements and then automatically route inquiries to the most suitable creators based on custom criteria like audience, niche, or previous collaborations.

Can we embed Cal.com’s booking forms on our agency website?

Yes, Cal.com’s forms can be embedded directly on your agency’s website or client portal, providing a seamless booking experience for brands and creators alike.

Does Cal.com support integrations with our CRM or influencer marketing platforms?

Absolutely. Cal.com integrates with popular CRM systems and marketing tools, enabling your agency to sync brand and creator data across your workflow.

How does Cal.com handle repeat brand clients or ongoing campaigns?

With ownership assignment, Cal.com recognizes returning clients and can automatically route them to their original account manager or preferred creator, maintaining continuity and personalized service.

Is Cal.com suitable for both boutique and large influencer agencies?

Yes, Cal.com is designed to scale with your agency, whether you manage a handful of creators or a global roster. Its flexible architecture adapts to your needs.

Can we self-host Cal.com to meet client privacy requirements?

Definitely. Cal.com offers full self-hosting, giving your agency total control over data residency, privacy, and compliance needs.

How easy is it to customize routing logic for unique campaigns?

Cal.com uses an intuitive, no-code interface for building complex routing logic, so you can tailor the booking process to each campaign’s unique requirements without technical barriers.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help influencer marketing agencies automate lead routing?

Cal.com lets agencies set up dynamic routing forms that collect detailed campaign and brand requirements. Using attribute-based logic, bookings are automatically matched to the most suitable influencers or account managers, reducing manual effort and speeding up the campaign setup process.

Can I customize the intake forms for different types of brand campaigns?

Yes, Cal.com's no-code routing forms are fully customizable. You can tailor forms to collect essential information for various campaign types, ensuring every booking is routed to the right influencer or team member.

Does Cal.com integrate with influencer management platforms or CRMs?

Cal.com offers direct integrations and an open API for connecting with popular CRM and influencer management platforms. This keeps your team’s data in sync and streamlines campaign scheduling.

How does Cal.com ensure brands are matched with the right influencers?

Cal.com's attribute-based routing logic uses details such as campaign category, audience demographics, and influencer expertise to match brand requests to the ideal influencer or account manager.

Can we automate scheduling for kick-off calls and campaign check-ins?

Absolutely. Once routing assigns the brand to the correct influencer or manager, Cal.com handles all scheduling, sending invites, calendar holds, and reminders automatically.

Is Cal.com secure and suitable for handling sensitive brand and influencer data?

Yes, Cal.com is enterprise-ready, GDPR-compliant, and offers self-hosting options. Agencies can manage sensitive data securely, with robust permissions and access controls.

What advantages does Cal.com offer over other scheduling tools for influencer marketing?

Unlike closed platforms, Cal.com provides open source flexibility, deep customization, and robust integrations tailored to influencer marketing workflows. You get full control, scalability, and the ability to adapt as your agency grows.

# Smart client routing for insurance agents and brokers

Automate, qualify, and route leads instantly to the right insurance agent with Cal.com’s open scheduling infrastructure.

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How automated routing transforms insurance agencies

Connect insurance prospects and clients with the right agent every time using dynamic routing forms and automated workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create custom routing forms

Capture key client details up front, such as insurance needs, location, and policy type, using intuitive, customizable forms.

![Create form template for insurance routing, displaying fields for client insurance needs and region.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3WYILND4qtCjvM0kE8fr76eBHo.png)

02

### Qualify and match clients instantly

Leverage Cal.com’s attribute-based routing to match each inquiry with the most suitable agent or broker in real time.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automate scheduling and notifications

Once matched, clients can instantly book with the right agent, while both parties receive real-time notifications and calendar invites.

![Automated routing table for insurance agents by specialty and team.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tiVWdDKzu7SXtOtJuRGG87XoHWc.png)

## Powerful features for insurance agencies and brokers

Cal.com delivers the flexibility and control insurance businesses need to scale their scheduling workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Customizable intake forms

Collect crucial client information such as insurance type, coverage needs, and region to personalize routing.

### Attribute-based agent matching

Automatically assign leads to agents based on license, product expertise, or territory.

### CRM and InsurTech integrations

Sync with your CRM or agency management system for up-to-date owner assignment and data consistency.

### Self-hosting and security controls

Deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure to meet strict data privacy and regulatory requirements.

### Analytics and routing insights

Track conversion rates, routing performance, and agent workloads to optimize your client journey.

### Multi-step and embedded forms

Guide clients through a clear, step-by-step booking process that can be embedded anywhere your prospects engage.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help insurance agencies qualify and route leads?

Cal.com’s routing forms collect client details like insurance needs, location, and policy type. Attribute-based routing then matches each lead to the right agent or broker, ensuring fast, accurate assignments.

Can I ensure that leads are routed to licensed agents only?

Yes, you can set routing logic based on agent licenses, product expertise, or region, so only qualified agents receive specific leads or appointments.

Does Cal.com integrate with agency management or CRM systems?

Cal.com connects with leading CRMs and agency management tools, enabling owner assignment, syncing client data, and automating follow-ups.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for compliance?

Absolutely. Cal.com is open source and can be self-hosted, providing full control over data storage and compliance with industry regulations.

How do automated notifications work for agents and clients?

Both agents and clients receive instant notifications and calendar invites when a booking is confirmed, reducing no-shows and keeping everyone informed.

Can I customize the intake forms for different insurance products?

Yes. Cal.com’s no-code form builder lets you tailor questions for life, health, auto, or commercial insurance—ensuring you gather the right information every time.

How does Cal.com help track and improve routing performance?

Built-in analytics provide insights into routing efficiency, agent workloads, and conversion rates, so you can continuously optimize your process.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve scheduling for IT consulting firms?

Cal.com automates intake by routing client requests to the right consultant based on project type, urgency, and expertise, reducing manual coordination and speeding up project starts.

Can I set up custom routing rules for different IT services or specializations?

Yes. Cal.com lets you create advanced routing forms and logic, ensuring each client is matched to the right team member or specialist based on their needs.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM, ticketing, or communication tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers native integrations with major CRMs, ticketing systems, and collaboration platforms, so your workflow stays connected and up to date.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for enterprise IT consulting?

Cal.com is built with enterprise-grade security, supports self-hosting, and complies with leading data protection standards for peace of mind.

How does Cal.com handle complex, multi-step client onboarding?

You can design multi-step routing forms to gather all necessary client information, then automatically direct them to the right consultant or team for follow-up.

What if our team has unique intake or scheduling requirements?

Cal.com's open-source and API-first platform allows you to customize forms, routing logic, and integrations to fit your firm’s unique workflows.

How quickly can we get started with Cal.com?

IT consulting teams can be up and running in minutes with pre-built templates, or customize your setup with our robust documentation and support.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve parent-teacher conference scheduling at my school?

Cal.com allows you to automate the entire parent-teacher conference process. Parents receive a secure link to book slots, answer intake questions, and are routed to the correct teacher—eliminating back-and-forth and manual scheduling.

Can Cal.com help manage student support services, like counseling or IEP meetings?

Yes. Cal.com's routing forms can collect information from students or families and direct them to the appropriate counselor, specialist, or educator based on their needs and availability.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant with student privacy requirements?

Cal.com offers robust privacy features, including self-hosting, role-based permissions, and granular access controls. This helps schools meet FERPA and other privacy standards.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing school calendars and systems?

Cal.com integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft Outlook, and can connect with many student information systems via API, ensuring schedules are always up to date.

How flexible is Cal.com for different school scheduling needs?

Cal.com supports custom forms, multiple event types, recurring meetings, and team booking. You can adapt it for everything from classroom sign-ups to district-wide events.

Is it easy for parents and guardians to use Cal.com?

Absolutely. Parents access a simple, mobile-friendly booking page, answer a few questions, and are instantly shown available times—no account required.

Can we customize booking forms for different school events or requirements?

Yes. Cal.com lets you create unique forms for any event type, collecting only the information you need for each meeting or program.

Connect students to the right language instructors and programs instantly with intelligent, automated scheduling and routing.

How it works

## Simple steps to smarter student and class routing

Easily match students with the right language instructors or programs using Cal.com's routing forms and automation.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up your routing logic

Define criteria such as language, proficiency, and availability to ensure students are matched to the best-fit classes or instructors.

![Custom language school intake form creation interface, highlighting fields for language preference, level, and scheduling.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/e9ZreId24wjXBvNXj7S9JnDvIWs.png)

02

### Collect student information

Students fill out custom forms with details about their language goals, level, and preferred schedule, making placement effortless.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Route students automatically

Based on responses, students are routed to the right class or instructor, reducing manual coordination and saving admin time.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help language schools improve student placement?

Cal.com automates the intake and routing process, ensuring students are matched with the right classes and instructors based on their preferences, proficiency, and schedule. This reduces manual work and increases placement accuracy.

Can we customize the intake forms for different language programs?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing forms are fully customizable. You can create unique forms for each program or intake scenario, collecting relevant information such as language interests, skill level, and availability.

What integrations does Cal.com offer for language schools?

Cal.com integrates with learning management systems, student CRMs, and communication platforms. This streamlines your workflow and keeps all student and class data in sync.

Is it possible to assign students to the same instructor for repeat bookings?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s ownership assignment feature ensures that returning students can be routed directly to their previous instructor, creating a consistent and personalized learning experience.

Can our administrative team track placement metrics and optimize our process?

Yes, Cal.com provides robust analytics and insights, allowing your team to monitor placement rates, booking trends, and instructor utilization to continually refine your intake process.

How does Cal.com handle scheduling across multiple locations or online classes?

Cal.com supports multi-location and hybrid setups. Students can be routed according to their preferred location or online options, ensuring flexible scheduling for any program format.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for educational institutions?

Cal.com can be self-hosted, giving you full control over data privacy and compliance. Our platform adheres to industry best practices for security and access management.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help organize leadership offsite scheduling?

Cal.com automates the process of collecting availability, preferences, and logistical needs from executive attendees. Routing logic ensures each leader is assigned to the right agenda tracks, sessions, and accommodations without manual coordination.

Can we customize intake forms to capture executive-specific requirements?

Yes, Cal.com offers fully customizable forms. You can tailor questions to capture dietary restrictions, room preferences, travel details, and unique session interests.

Is our executive data secure with Cal.com?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports enterprise-grade security, self-hosting options, and GDPR compliance, so your sensitive executive data remains protected.

How does Cal.com integrate with our existing HR and communication tools?

Cal.com provides open APIs and native integrations with popular platforms such as Slack, Google Workspace, and HRIS tools, enabling seamless data flow and automated notifications.

Can we assign breakout groups or activities dynamically based on responses?

Yes. Cal.com's routing logic lets you automatically assign executives to groups, tracks, or activities based on their form responses and availability.

What happens if our offsite has last-minute changes?

Cal.com enables real-time updates and notifications. Attendees can be automatically rerouted, and organizers can update sessions or assignments instantly.

Is Cal.com suitable for global leadership teams with varied schedules?

Definitely. Cal.com supports multiple time zones, languages, and complex scheduling scenarios, making it ideal for coordinating global executive offsites.

# Simplify legal aid scheduling with advanced routing

Transform how legal aid organizations connect clients and attorneys with Cal.com’s open scheduling and smart routing infrastructure.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![A Cal.com routing form for legal aid organizations, showing intake questions about legal needs, jurisdiction, and language preference.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/1VFeYozl19lvZhb2y7KNfvMsmtM.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How legal aid routing works

Streamline client intake and schedule legal consultations faster

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up routing forms for legal aid

Build custom intake forms to collect client needs, location, and case type, ensuring all relevant details are captured at the start.

![Customizing a Cal.com legal aid intake form, focusing on gathering essential client information for routing.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aLFdWJAIbUTC5wxgiwDn1zVhc.png)

02

### Let clients submit their information

Clients fill out intake forms on your website, sharing their legal issue, urgency, and preferred language.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically match clients with the right legal expert

Based on responses, Cal.com routes each client to the most qualified attorney or advocate, reducing wait times and manual triage.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help legal aid organizations streamline intake?

Cal.com automates client intake by letting you create custom routing forms that capture critical information. Clients are then matched to the best legal expert, reducing manual triage and speeding up the process.

Can we route clients based on legal issue or jurisdiction?

Yes. Cal.com’s attribute-based routing allows you to match clients to attorneys or advocates based on case type, location, language, urgency, and other relevant attributes.

Does Cal.com support integration with legal case management systems?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers API-first architecture and can integrate with popular case management tools, CRM systems, and internal databases for seamless workflow automation.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for privacy compliance?

Yes. Legal aid organizations can self-host Cal.com to maintain full control over client data, meeting privacy and regional compliance requirements.

How does Cal.com ensure fair distribution of cases to legal staff?

The platform supports round robin and attribute-weighted routing, ensuring equitable and transparent assignment of clients among legal professionals.

Can clients book appointments in their preferred language?

Yes. Cal.com supports multilingual intake forms and routing, letting clients specify their preferred language for better accessibility.

What analytics are available to track intake and scheduling performance?

Cal.com provides detailed analytics on form submissions, routing efficiency, response times, and team workload, helping you optimize service delivery.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help with legal client intake and routing?

Cal.com enables law firms and professional service providers to automate client intake by gathering key information through custom forms, then routing each inquiry to the right expert based on their needs and your team’s availability.

Can I customize intake forms for different legal services or practice areas?

Yes. Cal.com’s drag-and-drop form builder lets you create tailored intake forms for areas like family law, corporate, immigration, or consulting—ensuring clients answer relevant questions before booking.

Is client data secure and compliant with industry regulations?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers enterprise-grade security, encryption, self-hosting, and GDPR-ready features to help you meet legal industry compliance requirements.

Can Cal.com recognize and route returning clients to their existing attorneys?

Yes. With CRM integration, Cal.com can identify returning clients and automatically assign them to their primary attorney or case manager for a seamless experience.

Does Cal.com integrate with case management and CRM platforms?

Cal.com offers robust API and native integrations with leading legal CRM and case management solutions, so your scheduling and client intake processes stay connected.

How does smart routing improve efficiency for legal teams?

Smart routing eliminates manual assignment by directing clients to the best-suited expert or department based on their responses, resulting in faster intake and better client service.

Can I self-host Cal.com for maximum data control?

Yes. Cal.com is open-source and enterprise-ready, allowing you to self-host and maintain full control over sensitive client data and workflows.

# Smarter client routing for life coaching teams

Automate client bookings and match clients to the right life coach with Cal.com's open scheduling platform.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to smarter client-coach matching

Guide clients from inquiry to the best-fit coach with these easy steps.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create your intake routes

Set up routing forms to capture client goals and preferences, ensuring every booker is matched with the right coach.

![Cal.com form builder interface for life coaching, showing setup of client intake questions for better coach matching.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ZaKBIvxsE3rBPQksDNx9UJhUQ.png)

02

### Collect client information

Clients complete a brief intake form before booking, sharing their goals, challenges, and preferences.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Route clients to the right coach

Based on responses, clients are automatically routed to the coach most aligned with their needs and expertise.

![Automated client routing for life coaching teams, assigning bookings to the right coach based on expertise and availability.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Bg2UUwrF08toWeVcmf6hmQ4jIaw.png)

## Powerful features for life coach scheduling

Tools and integrations designed to help coaching teams grow and deliver exceptional client experiences.

### Customizable intake forms

Build forms that capture the insights you need to match clients and coaches effectively.

### Attribute-based routing

Route bookings based on client goals, language, coach expertise, or other attributes.

### CRM and calendar integrations

Sync with your favorite platforms like Google Calendar, Outlook, and coaching CRMs.

### Self-hosting and data privacy

Host Cal.com on your own infrastructure to maintain full control and ensure data privacy.

### Multi-coach round robin

Distribute client bookings evenly across your team to maximize availability and reduce burnout.

### Actionable analytics

Track routing performance, coach utilization, and client satisfaction to optimize your processes.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my coaching practice match clients to the right coach?

Cal.com’s routing forms allow you to collect client goals, preferences, and availability upfront. Using attribute-based logic, clients are automatically matched to the most suitable coach, saving you admin time and improving the coaching experience.

Can I customize the intake forms for my coaching team?

Absolutely. You can add custom questions, required fields, and conditional logic to your routing forms, tailoring them to your specific coaching methodologies and practice needs.

Does Cal.com integrate with my existing calendar and CRM?

Yes. Cal.com integrates seamlessly with popular calendars like Google and Outlook, as well as coaching CRMs and other workflow tools, so your team stays organized and bookings always stay in sync.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant with data privacy regulations?

Cal.com is open-source and offers self-hosting options, allowing you to manage client data securely and comply with industry privacy standards.

How does round robin booking work for multiple coaches?

With round robin logic, client bookings are distributed evenly among your coaching team. This ensures fair workload distribution and maximizes availability.

Can I use Cal.com for group coaching sessions?

Yes. Cal.com supports both one-on-one and group bookings, so you can offer individual or group coaching sessions with ease.

How quickly can I set up routing forms for my coaching business?

Most teams can get started in minutes. Simply sign up, create your routing forms, and connect your calendars. Our help center and support team are ready to assist if you need guidance.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

How does Cal.com help managed service providers automate client intake?

Cal.com provides customizable intake forms and intelligent routing, automatically assigning client requests to the most suitable expert or team based on collected data and availability.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my CRM or helpdesk systems?

Yes, Cal.com offers integrations with major CRMs, helpdesks, and other business tools, ensuring seamless data flow and ownership assignment.

Is Cal.com secure and suitable for handling sensitive client information?

Cal.com is built with enterprise-grade security, compliance controls, and self-hosting options, making it ideal for managed service providers handling confidential data.

Does Cal.com support multi-team or multi-department routing?

Absolutely. Cal.com allows you to set up routing across multiple teams or departments, so each request is assigned to the right group based on your rules.

How flexible are Cal.com's routing forms for different service offerings?

You can fully customize routing forms to match your service offerings, business rules, and information requirements, all without code.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for managed service providers?

Cal.com includes detailed analytics on routing outcomes, team workloads, response times, and client satisfaction to help you optimize performance.

How do I get started with Cal.com for my managed services business?

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help marketing teams qualify leads before meetings?

Cal.com's routing forms allow you to ask custom qualification questions, such as marketing goals, budget, or company size. Based on responses, leads are automatically routed to the right team member or campaign workflow, streamlining qualification and reducing manual review.

Does Cal.com integrate with my marketing CRM or automation platform?

Yes, Cal.com offers native integrations and API access for popular CRMs and marketing automation tools, ensuring lead data syncs seamlessly and ownership assignments remain accurate.

Can I customize the routing logic for different marketing campaigns?

Absolutely. You can create unique routing rules for each campaign, event, or channel, allowing leads to be assigned based on campaign type, region, or other attributes.

How does automated routing improve lead response times for marketing?

Automated routing removes manual assignment, connecting prospects to the appropriate marketing specialist instantly. This results in faster follow-ups and higher conversion rates.

Is Cal.com’s scheduling infrastructure secure and compliant for marketing teams?

Yes, Cal.com offers self-hosting options and robust security features, ensuring your lead and customer data remain protected and compliant with privacy regulations.

Can I embed Cal.com routing forms on my marketing website or landing pages?

Yes, embedding is simple with Cal.com. You can add routing forms and booking flows directly to your website or campaign landing pages, matching your brand and optimizing the lead journey.

How do I measure the performance of my marketing routing and scheduling workflows?

Cal.com provides analytics and reporting on routing form responses, meeting outcomes, and lead conversion rates, helping you refine your marketing processes and drive better results.

# Smart scheduling and lead routing for martial arts academies

Automate class bookings and route new inquiries to the right instructor with Cal.com’s open scheduling infrastructure.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Routing form for martial arts academy booking, collecting information on discipline, age, schedule, and student skill level.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/6nLxMCIRhfvd88zOtMTtrLDbY0I.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works for martial arts academies

Effortlessly connect students to the right classes and instructors

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create tailored routing forms

Design booking forms that capture student interests, age groups, and experience levels, ensuring every inquiry or booking is matched to the ideal class or instructor.

![Form builder for martial arts academies showing custom fields for student discipline, age, and skill level.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/CujsbaWSte2HBuki4mYN4QF04h4.png)

02

### Collect student information

Prospective students answer custom questions before booking, such as preferred martial art style, skill level, or schedule preferences.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign to the right instructor or class

Based on responses, Cal.com automatically routes bookings to the appropriate coach or class, reducing manual work for your staff.

![Automated routing of martial arts academy bookings to instructors by program or class type.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/HWnjX5RC5HCeM0jUBrB2pWpTSY.png)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help automate class bookings for martial arts academies?

Cal.com enables academies to set up automated booking flows that collect relevant student information and route each inquiry to the right class or instructor, eliminating manual scheduling and reducing errors.

Can I customize booking forms for different martial arts programs or age groups?

Yes. You can create unique routing and booking forms for each program, age group, or skill level, ensuring every student is matched appropriately.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling student and parent data?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers self-hosting options for full data control and adheres to strict security standards, making it suitable for academies focused on privacy and compliance.

How does Cal.com integrate with my existing CRM or member management software?

Cal.com integrates with leading CRMs and membership platforms, allowing student booking and profile data to sync automatically. You can also use APIs for custom integrations.

Can instructors manage their own schedules and availability?

Yes. Instructors can set their own availability, block out times, and manage bookings directly, giving them control and improving operational efficiency.

Does Cal.com support multi-location martial arts academies?

Yes. Easily manage schedules, staff, and classes across multiple academy branches in one unified platform.

How easy is it to get started with Cal.com for my academy?

Getting started is simple. Sign up, configure your booking forms and routing rules, and integrate Cal.com with your website or apps. Our help center and support team are ready to assist.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve scheduling for massage therapy clinics?

Cal.com eliminates manual back-and-forth by letting clients enter their preferences and needs up front. The platform automatically matches clients with the ideal therapist, reducing administrative workload and improving the client experience.

Is the intake form customizable for different massage treatments?

Yes. You can tailor routing forms to capture specific information such as treatment type, therapist gender preference, health concerns, or goals for the session. This ensures every client is matched to the right service and therapist.

Can Cal.com assign clients to their preferred therapist?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports ownership assignment, so returning clients can be automatically routed to their previous or chosen therapist, streamlining rebooking and strengthening client relationships.

Does automated routing help balance therapist workloads?

Yes. Attribute-based routing and round-robin logic help evenly distribute bookings, prevent burnout, and maximize calendar utilization for your team.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my practice management tools?

Cal.com offers robust API access and integrations with popular EHR, CRM, and payment systems. This keeps your data in sync and your workflow efficient.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant with privacy regulations?

Cal.com provides self-hosting options, giving you full control of sensitive client data. The platform supports industry best practices for privacy and data security, making it a fit for regulated health businesses.

How quickly can I get started with Cal.com routing forms?

You can set up and launch custom routing forms in minutes with our no-code builder. Cal.com’s help center and support team are available to assist every step of the way.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help medical equipment vendors qualify leads more efficiently?

Cal.com routing forms allow vendors to ask targeted questions up front—such as equipment type, facility size, and urgency—so only qualified, relevant leads are routed to sales reps. This eliminates manual triage and ensures teams focus on high-value opportunities.

Can we route leads based on hospital type or region?

Yes. With attribute-based routing, you can assign leads based on hospital type (private, public, specialty), region, or even department. Cal.com supports complex logic for territory management.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM or EHR system?

Cal.com integrates with major CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. Custom integrations can be built using our API. For EHR, integrations depend on API access and security needs.

How secure is patient and lead data with Cal.com?

Cal.com offers self-hosting, end-to-end encryption, and fine-grained access controls. This enables compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and other healthcare regulations.

Can we customize routing forms for different product lines?

Absolutely. You can create and manage multiple forms for different equipment categories, sales teams, or market segments—all with unique questions and routing logic.

Is it possible to assign leads to the account owner in our CRM?

Yes. Cal.com can check CRM ownership and automatically route existing customers or accounts to their assigned representative, ensuring continuity and personalized service.

How does Cal.com help us measure sales team performance?

The platform provides analytics dashboards showing routing efficiency, response times, booking rates, and individual rep performance—helping you identify bottlenecks and optimize sales operations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What makes Cal.com secure for mental health practices?

Cal.com offers HIPAA-ready options, self-hosting for full data control, encrypted communications, and granular privacy settings to protect client information.

Can intake forms be customized for different therapy types?

Yes, you can fully customize intake forms to collect any information needed for your practice, including clinical needs, insurance details, or language preferences.

How does Cal.com match clients to the right therapist?

Cal.com uses attribute-based routing to match clients with therapists based on specialty, insurance, language, availability, and other criteria you define.

Does Cal.com integrate with EHR or practice management software?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s API-first design allows seamless integration with EHR systems, practice management tools, and CRMs commonly used in mental health.

Is Cal.com suitable for group practices or clinics?

Yes. Cal.com supports multi-provider organizations with scalable routing, team scheduling, and organizational controls.

Can I offer virtual and in-person appointments through Cal.com?

Yes, Cal.com supports both virtual and in-person sessions, including integrations with popular video platforms like Zoom and Google Meet.

How does Cal.com handle appointment reminders and follow-ups?

Cal.com automates appointment reminders and follow-ups via email or SMS, helping reduce no-shows and improve client engagement.

## Essential features for mortgage routing

Everything you need to automate and optimize lead distribution across your mortgage team.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Route leads using borrower attributes like loan type, property location, and credit profile to ensure every inquiry reaches the right expert.

### CRM and LOS integrations

Connect Cal.com with your mortgage CRM or LOS to synchronize lead data and track assignment outcomes.

### Custom intake forms

Design dynamic, multi-step forms to pre-qualify borrowers and gather essential information upfront.

### Round-robin and ownership assignment

Assign leads to brokers based on territory, expertise, or account ownership for fair and effective distribution.

### Analytics and reporting

Monitor routing performance, team availability, and borrower engagement with real-time insights.

### Self-hosting and white-labeling

Deploy Cal.com on your infrastructure, maintain data control, and fully brand the scheduling experience.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve lead distribution for mortgage brokers?

Cal.com automates borrower intake and lead routing, matching each inquiry with the most suitable broker based on borrower needs, location, and preferences. This streamlines the process, reduces manual errors, and accelerates response times.

Can Cal.com integrate with our mortgage CRM or LOS?

Yes, Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular mortgage CRMs and loan origination systems (LOS). Sync borrower data, trigger workflows, and maintain a seamless lead management process.

Is borrower data secure and compliant with industry standards?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports self-hosting, role-based permissions, and encryption to help mortgage teams comply with privacy regulations and protect sensitive financial information.

Can we customize the intake forms for our mortgage workflow?

Yes. Cal.com lets you create fully customizable, multi-step intake forms that capture borrower details such as loan type, property value, and timeline. This ensures only qualified leads book appointments with your team.

How do routing rules work for multiple branches or specialties?

You can set up attribute-based routing logic to assign leads by branch, loan product, language, or any custom field. Cal.com handles complex routing scenarios without manual intervention.

Does Cal.com support round-robin and ownership-based assignment?

Yes. Cal.com provides round-robin distribution and account ownership routing, letting you balance workloads and respect broker-client relationships within your team.

What does onboarding look like for mortgage teams?

Onboarding is straightforward. Our team will guide you through setup, integration with your existing tools, and best practices for routing and scheduling. You can be fully operational in days.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help moving companies manage client bookings?

Cal.com automates the intake process by letting you design custom forms and routing logic that instantly assign each client to the best crew for their needs, reducing manual coordination and missed opportunities.

Can I customize the booking forms for different moving services?

Yes, you can build multi-step forms to gather precise details about local moves, long-distance jobs, packing, storage, and more, ensuring the right team and resources are booked every time.

Does Cal.com integrate with my CRM or dispatch software?

Cal.com offers powerful integrations and an API-first approach, so you can connect with leading CRM and workforce management tools, keeping schedules and client data in sync.

How does attribute-based routing work for moving services?

Attribute-based routing lets you match client requests to crews based on specific factors like location, truck availability, crew expertise, or previous assignments, ensuring efficient and accurate job assignments.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for more control?

Absolutely. Cal.com is open source and enterprise-ready, enabling you to self-host the platform and maintain full control over your data and scheduling logic.

Can I track bookings and team performance with Cal.com?

Yes, Cal.com’s analytics dashboard provides insights into booking volumes, crew assignments, response times, and client feedback, helping you optimize your operations.

How do I get started with Cal.com for my moving company?

Sign up for a free trial or book a personalized demo to see how Cal.com’s routing and scheduling tools can transform your moving business. Visit our product and help center pages for more details.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help music and art schools streamline scheduling?

Cal.com automates the process of matching students with instructors and booking lessons or classes, eliminating manual coordination and saving staff valuable time.

Can I customize routing forms for different types of music and art programs?

Yes, you can fully customize forms to capture information unique to band, orchestra, private lessons, group art classes, workshops, and more.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing student databases or CRMs?

Cal.com offers robust integrations and an API-first approach, so you can sync with popular CRMs, student management systems, or your own custom tools.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant with student privacy requirements?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports self-hosting and advanced privacy controls, allowing you to meet FERPA and other compliance standards.

How does attribute-based routing work for arts education?

Routing forms can assign students to specific instructors or classes based on skills, experience, or preferences, ensuring optimal placements every time.

Can we embed the booking and routing forms on our school's website?

Yes, Cal.com forms are easily embeddable and can be branded to match your school's website for a seamless user experience.

What support is available for onboarding and setup?

Cal.com provides detailed documentation, a help center, and responsive support to ensure your school is up and running smoothly.

# Smart scheduling and routing for nonprofits and community organizations

Connect volunteers, staff, and community members with the right resources using automated scheduling and intelligent routing from Cal.com.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Cal.com routing form for nonprofits and community organizations, showing custom fields for volunteer programs and community services.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bzx7iC7uika8iN0ahUuAYa8hk0k.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com routing works for nonprofits

Simplify community engagement and resource management with automated routing and scheduling.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up your custom routing forms

Tailor forms to capture volunteer interests, client needs, or event preferences. Ensure every participant is matched with the right team or service.

![Create form template for nonprofits and community organizations, highlighting fields for capturing volunteer skills or service requests.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/lgWDFU398k7Bdmz3RtkTv1vuwaY.png)

02

### Let your community fill in their details

Volunteers, clients, or members answer your custom questions before booking, providing context for better support.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Route people to the right resource

Cal.com automatically assigns each booking to the most appropriate staff member, volunteer, or service based on responses.

![Automated routing for nonprofit team members, assigning bookings to volunteer coordinators, outreach staff, client support, and event planners.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/2LHt2OBJzTj2WOf7CaP3gN8feU.png)

## Key features for nonprofits and community orgs

Flexible tools for every engagement scenario: volunteers, programs, services, and more.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Route bookings by volunteer skills, language, location, or program type.

### Ownership assignment

Automatically assign repeat clients to their dedicated case manager or program lead.

### Routing insights

Monitor engagement, optimize workflows, and track outcomes with in-depth analytics.

### Customizable routing logic

Set rules to ensure everyone is connected to the right program, staff, or event.

### Multi-step forms

Gather detailed information from volunteers or clients to ensure proper matching and reporting.

### Seamless integrations

Connect Cal.com with your CRM, communication, or donor management tools for unified workflows.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com routing for nonprofits?

Cal.com’s routing forms allow nonprofits to collect key information from volunteers, staff, or clients and automatically direct them to the right person, resource, or program—no manual coordination needed.

Can we customize routing forms for different programs or services?

Yes. You can tailor routing forms to gather information relevant to any program, event, or audience, such as volunteer shifts, service needs, or intake questions.

How does Cal.com handle recurring volunteers or clients?

Cal.com recognizes returning bookers and can automatically route them to their assigned contact or program lead, ensuring continuity and better support.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for sensitive data?

Cal.com offers self-hosting, granular permissions, and robust security features. Your data stays private and compliant with your organization’s policies.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our CRM or donor management system?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s API-first approach and pre-built integrations make it easy to connect with CRMs, communication platforms, or other nonprofit tools.

Does Cal.com support multi-language forms for diverse communities?

Yes, you can create forms and booking pages in multiple languages to serve your entire community effectively.

What does it cost for nonprofits to use Cal.com?

Cal.com offers flexible pricing and special nonprofit discounts. Explore our pricing page or contact us to discuss your organization’s needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help notary businesses automate scheduling?

Cal.com uses customizable routing forms to collect intake details and automatically assign clients to the right notary, saving time and reducing manual coordination.

Can I route clients to notaries based on specialization or location?

Yes, Cal.com allows attribute-based routing so clients are matched with notaries by specialization, language, jurisdiction, or office location.

How does Cal.com support compliance in the notary industry?

Cal.com enables you to require specific intake fields, track audit trails, and maintain secure records to meet industry compliance standards.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with e-signature or document management tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports integrations with leading e-signature and document management platforms for a seamless notary workflow.

Does Cal.com offer self-hosting for sensitive client data?

Yes, notary practices and enterprises can self-host Cal.com, ensuring full control over sensitive client and appointment data.

How can remote or mobile notaries use Cal.com?

Cal.com provides flexible, location-aware scheduling and routing, supporting remote and traveling notaries with up-to-date availability and mobile access.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for notary businesses?

You can track bookings, routing efficiency, client types, and compliance metrics with Cal.com's built-in insights and reporting tools.

## Frequently asked questions

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do routing forms improve intake for nutritionists and dietitians?

Cal.com routing forms let you collect detailed client information up front, such as dietary history and goals, then automatically route each client to the appropriate nutritionist or dietitian based on expertise, availability, or client preference. This removes manual triage and ensures clients get matched quickly and accurately.

Can I customize intake questions for my practice?

Yes, Cal.com allows you to fully customize intake forms with questions tailored to your nutrition specialty. You can ask about allergies, medical conditions, current diets, and more, ensuring you gather the exact information you need from every client.

Is client data secure and compliant with privacy laws?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers secure data collection and storage, with options for HIPAA compliance for healthcare providers. You can self-host Cal.com or use our cloud infrastructure, maintaining full control over sensitive client data.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my EHR or electronic health record system?

Yes, Cal.com supports integration with EHRs, practice management software, and popular telehealth tools. This enables seamless syncing of appointments, forms, and client data to your existing workflows.

Does Cal.com support multi-location or group practices?

It does. Cal.com is built to support solo practitioners, group practices, or large organizations. Easily manage multiple nutritionists, specialties, and locations from a single platform.

How does attribute-based routing work for nutrition professionals?

Attribute-based routing uses client intake answers to automatically match them with the right nutritionist or dietitian, factoring in specialties like sports nutrition, pediatric, or plant-based diets, as well as language and availability.

What does it cost for nutrition teams to use Cal.com routing?

Cal.com routing forms are included in team and organization plans. For the latest pricing and to see what fits your practice best, visit our pricing page or book a demo with our team.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve consultant-candidate matching for outplacement agencies?

Cal.com uses dynamic routing forms to collect candidate preferences and background, then automatically matches them to the most suitable consultant or service based on predefined rules and consultant attributes.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our existing HR or CRM software?

Yes. Cal.com offers robust API-first architecture and direct integrations, so you can connect with leading HRIS and CRM platforms to sync candidate data and streamline workflows.

Is it possible to route candidates to group workshops as well as individual consultants?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports both individual and group event types, making it easy to automatically assign candidates to workshops, webinars, or one-on-one sessions based on their needs.

How customizable are the intake and routing forms for our agency’s processes?

Intake and routing forms on Cal.com are fully customizable. You can add fields, set required questions, use conditional logic, and tailor the routing flow to reflect your agency’s unique process.

Does Cal.com support ownership assignment for ongoing candidate relationships?

Yes. Cal.com can assign candidates to their previous consultant for continuity, or use round robin logic to distribute new candidates among available consultants.

What reporting or analytics are available for tracking our placement efficiency?

Cal.com provides in-depth insights into candidate routing, consultant workloads, and booking metrics, helping agencies identify bottlenecks and optimize performance.

Can we self-host Cal.com to meet our data security requirements?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and can be self-hosted, giving your agency full control over data privacy and compliance.
