![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help paralegal services manage client intake?

Cal.com enables paralegal teams to create customizable intake forms that gather key details from clients before they book. The system then routes each inquiry to the most appropriate paralegal based on expertise, availability, or prior relationship, streamlining the entire intake and scheduling process.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my legal CRM or case management system?

Yes. Cal.com offers robust API access and native integrations, allowing you to connect with leading legal CRMs and case management tools for seamless client data flow and assignment tracking.

Is Cal.com secure enough for legal industry compliance?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports self-hosting, role-based permissions, and encrypted data handling, helping you meet strict privacy requirements and maintain compliance with legal industry standards.

How does attribute-based routing work for paralegal teams?

You can configure routing rules that match clients to paralegals based on attributes like area of law, language, location, or even workload. This ensures each client is connected to the best-suited team member instantly.

Can returning clients be automatically assigned to their previous paralegal?

Yes. Cal.com’s ownership assignment feature can identify repeat clients and route them directly to the paralegal they have previously worked with, ensuring continuity and stronger client relationships.

Are routing forms and workflows customizable for different legal practice areas?

Definitely. Cal.com’s no-code form builder and flexible routing engine allow you to tailor questions, logic, and assignment rules for specific practice areas, from immigration to family law and beyond.

Does Cal.com provide analytics to improve my intake process?

Yes. You can access detailed insights on form completion rates, routing decisions, team utilization, and more to optimize your client intake and service delivery.

# Smarter client routing for patent and trademark attorneys

How it works

## How automated routing works for IP law firms

Guide every client to the right patent or trademark attorney with a seamless, automated workflow.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create your custom routing forms

Design intake forms that collect critical details about intellectual property type, jurisdiction, or urgency, helping qualify and segment new client inquiries.

![Patent and trademark attorney routing form creation interface](https://framerusercontent.com/images/1lUa0SyKvxaxjiODy48mn8TGrs.png)

02

### Clients complete intake details

Prospective clients answer tailored questions about their IP case, such as invention type or trademark class, before booking.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Route clients to the right attorney

Based on intake responses, Cal.com automatically assigns the client to the most qualified attorney or team, ensuring expertise and efficiency.

![Automated routing interface for intellectual property law firm team members](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xUEArYwWkKST4uABkOWQ2ZaFa6A.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why leading IP firms choose Cal.com

Unlock productivity, reduce admin overhead, and improve client experience with purpose-built routing for patent and trademark law.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Attribute-based routing visual for patent/trademark attorneys](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bZLJLsJ6CIU4U4CdyiMOj6EeU0.png)

01

### Faster case assignment

Route new inquiries to the ideal attorney without manual triage, reducing response times and eliminating bottlenecks.

02

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help patent and trademark law firms qualify new clients?

Cal.com’s customizable routing forms collect detailed client information up front, such as type of IP, jurisdiction, and urgency. This enables firms to assess and triage inquiries efficiently, reducing time spent on manual qualification.

Can Cal.com assign clients to attorneys based on expertise or availability?

Yes, Cal.com supports attribute-based routing, allowing firms to assign clients to attorneys by specialty, jurisdiction, or current workload. This ensures that every inquiry is matched with the most suitable attorney.

Is Cal.com secure enough for sensitive legal data?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers strong security features, including self-hosting, role-based permissions, and audit logs, so you can control access and comply with privacy regulations for legal practices.

Does Cal.com integrate with legal CRMs or practice management software?

Yes, Cal.com provides integrations and an open API for connecting with leading legal CRMs and practice management systems, keeping your client and matter data in sync.

Can we embed the intake and routing forms on our law firm website?

Yes, you can easily embed Cal.com routing forms on your website or landing pages, ensuring a seamless experience for prospective clients from first contact to booked consultation.

How customizable are Cal.com’s workflows for different IP case types?

Cal.com’s routing logic is fully customizable, so you can create different workflows for patents, trademarks, or international filings and update them as your firm’s needs evolve.

What are the main benefits for patent/trademark law firms choosing Cal.com over other solutions?

Cal.com offers open-source flexibility, deep customization, attribute-based routing, and secure self-hosting options not found in most proprietary platforms—making it ideal for IP law firms that need control, compliance, and efficiency.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do routing forms help personal trainers manage new client bookings?

Routing forms let trainers collect client goals, experience, and preferences upfront. This information is used to automatically assign clients to the best-fit trainer or program, saving time and improving outcomes.

Can I route clients based on specific fitness goals or experience level?

Yes. With Cal.com, you can create custom fields for goals, skill level, or health considerations. Clients are routed to trainers with the most relevant expertise.

Does Cal.com support recurring or group sessions for trainers?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports recurring bookings and can route clients to group classes, semi-private sessions, or individual appointments based on your setup.

Can trainers be assigned to clients they have worked with before?

Yes. Cal.com recognizes returning clients and can automatically assign them to their previous trainer, maintaining continuity and a personal touch.

How does Cal.com integrate with my website or fitness app?

You can embed Cal.com's routing forms directly into your website or app. With open API access and no-code options, integration is simple and customizable.

Is the booking process mobile-friendly for clients?

Definitely. All routing and booking forms are fully responsive, ensuring a seamless experience on any device.

How secure is client data collected through Cal.com?

Cal.com prioritizes data security and privacy. All client data is encrypted, and you can self-host if you require additional control over sensitive health information.

Based on client responses, Cal.com automatically routes the booking to the team member best suited for the project.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com routing for photographers and videographers?

Cal.com’s routing enables creative teams to collect client details at booking and automatically direct each inquiry to the right photographer or videographer based on session type, location, or expertise.

Can I customize booking forms for different photo or video services?

Yes, you can fully tailor booking forms to include questions about event type, duration, style, and special requirements, ensuring you gather all relevant details up front.

Does Cal.com support team-based bookings for studios?

Absolutely. Studios can add multiple team members, set specialties, and use attribute-based routing to assign bookings to the best-fit professional automatically.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my calendar and workflow tools?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with popular tools like Google Calendar, Zoom, and editing apps, keeping your schedules and workflows in sync.

How does Cal.com help reduce no-shows?

Automated reminders and calendar sync ensure clients have all session details, minimizing missed appointments and keeping your schedule on track.

Is my client data secure with Cal.com?

Cal.com is open source and offers self-hosted options, giving you control over data privacy and compliance.

Can I embed Cal.com booking forms on my website?

Yes, you can easily embed branded booking forms on your website or landing pages for a seamless client experience.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help PR agencies qualify and route client leads?

Cal.com lets you build forms that capture inquiry details, then automatically routes leads to the right PR specialist based on topic, urgency, or campaign type. This reduces manual triage and ensures every lead is handled by the best team member.

Can Cal.com route media inquiries to subject matter experts?

Yes. You can configure routing logic to direct journalists and media requests to the appropriate spokesperson or subject matter expert within your agency.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling confidential client communications?

Cal.com is open-source, can be self-hosted, and offers robust security controls to protect sensitive client and media data. Compliance with privacy standards is built in.

Can I integrate Cal.com with our PR agency’s CRM and email tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers integrations with leading CRMs, email platforms, and Slack, so all inquiries and bookings sync with your existing workflow.

How does Cal.com support agencies with multiple service lines or offices?

You can define custom routing rules for each service, region, or office location, ensuring inquiries always reach the right team or consultant.

How customizable are the routing forms for agency branding?

Cal.com forms are fully customizable. You can add your logo, adjust colors, and include specific questions that reflect your agency’s brand and services.

What does implementation look like for a mid-sized PR agency?

Setup is fast and straightforward. You can launch routing forms and integrate with your website or CRM in minutes. Support and documentation are available to guide your team.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help private practices manage scheduling?

Cal.com lets private practices automate patient intake, appointment requests, and provider routing. With customizable forms and smart routing, front desk staff spend less time on manual scheduling and more time on patient care.

Can Cal.com support HIPAA compliance?

Yes. Cal.com offers self-hosting options and granular access controls that help private practices meet HIPAA requirements and keep sensitive patient data secure.

Can patients select their preferred provider or location?

Absolutely. Intake forms can include provider and location preferences, and Cal.com's routing engine will direct patients accordingly based on availability and your rules.

Does Cal.com integrate with electronic health record (EHR) systems?

Cal.com offers open APIs and webhooks so you can connect with your EHR, telehealth, billing, or patient communication systems, ensuring seamless data flow.

Can I customize intake forms for different types of appointments?

Yes. You can build multi-step forms tailored for new patient visits, follow-ups, telehealth, or specialty consultations, collecting all relevant info up front.

How does attribute-based routing work for healthcare teams?

Cal.com allows you to define routing logic based on specialty, insurance, language, or any attribute, so patients are always matched to the best-fit provider automatically.

What is the setup process for private practices?

Sign up for Cal.com, install the Routing Forms app, and create your first intake form. Define routing logic based on your practice’s needs, connect calendars and integrations, and you are ready to automate scheduling.

Routing for real estate

# Smarter scheduling and lead routing for real estate teams

Connect home buyers, sellers, and prospects instantly to the right real estate agent with automated, flexible routing powered by Cal.com.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Cal.com routing form showcasing a customizable intake form for real estate clients, including questions about property type, location, and budget.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/rBG5dBdyBCpCmZ2EHaY6Pv6nKQ.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com routing works for real estate

Effortlessly guide prospects from inquiry to the perfect agent or property specialist with these simple steps.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up custom routing rules

Define routing logic based on buyer preferences, property type, location, or agent expertise to ensure every lead is matched to the right agent.

![Cal.com create form template showing a question builder tailored for real estate client needs.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ROzTPcoYJ9t1CptNAwwtlylTgV4.png)

02

### Let clients share their needs

Prospective buyers and sellers complete a quick pre-booking form outlining their preferences and requirements.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign to the best-fit agent

Based on form responses, Cal.com routes each client to the right agent or property manager, triggering a seamless scheduling experience.

![Automated routing interface featuring real estate team members and their specialized divisions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3hhkqXV28ecnc9eknyuEh7xiKvU.png)

## Powerful features for real estate professionals

Unlock scheduling flexibility and automation designed for the dynamic needs of real estate teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based lead routing

Automatically assign clients based on location, property type, language preference, or budget range.

### CRM and calendar integration

Sync with your existing CRM and team calendars to ensure up-to-date availability and contact ownership.

### Ownership assignment

Always route returning clients to their dedicated agent using CRM ownership data.

### Customizable pre-booking forms

Collect information on property interests, budget, or desired viewing times to personalize each interaction.

### Multi-agent and team scheduling

Enable round robin, pooled availability, or direct bookings for buyer tours and open houses.

### Actionable analytics

Track lead routing, agent bookings, and response times to continually improve team performance.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com’s routing improve lead response times for real estate teams?

Cal.com instantly matches new inquiries to available agents based on custom rules, eliminating manual assignment and ensuring prospects hear back quickly—often within minutes.

Can I assign leads to agents based on property location or specialization?

Yes. Cal.com lets you set routing logic by location, property type, agent expertise, language, or other attributes to ensure clients are connected to the most suitable team member.

Is Cal.com compatible with our CRM and real estate software?

Cal.com integrates with popular CRMs and calendar platforms, making it easy to sync client data and maintain accurate agent assignments.

How does Cal.com support team-based property tours or open houses?

With pooled and round robin scheduling, Cal.com makes it simple for teams to share availability and assign group events like property tours or open houses to the right agents.

Can I customize the pre-booking questions for buyers and sellers?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s routing forms are fully customizable, so you can ask clients about budget, location, property preferences, or any other criteria relevant to your agency.

What security and privacy features does Cal.com offer for sensitive client data?

Cal.com is open source and can be self-hosted, giving you complete control over your data. All information is encrypted and managed according to industry best practices.

How do I get started with routing for my real estate team?

Sign up for a free Cal.com account, install the Routing Forms app from our marketplace, and follow the intuitive setup to tailor routing logic for your agency’s needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can routing automation help my recruitment agency?

Cal.com automates candidate scheduling and assignment, reducing manual work and ensuring candidates connect with the right recruiter based on skills, roles, or availability. This improves efficiency and delivers a better experience for both candidates and recruiters.

Can I integrate Cal.com with our ATS or HR tools?

Yes, Cal.com supports integrations with leading ATS and HR platforms. You can sync candidate data, automate workflows, and keep your systems aligned. Visit our Integrations page for more details.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for recruitment data?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers self-hosting, granular permission controls, and data residency options. This allows recruitment agencies to comply with GDPR and other data privacy regulations while keeping candidate data secure.

How customizable is the candidate intake form?

Cal.com’s intake forms are fully customizable and no-code, letting you collect exactly the information you need for each role or client. You can add custom fields, conditional logic, and branding to match your agency’s workflow.

What routing logic can I set up for candidate assignment?

You can use attribute-based and round robin routing, or set up custom logic based on recruiter expertise, candidate location, job type, and more. This ensures optimal match-making between candidates and recruiters.

Can I embed the scheduling process in our website or job portal?

Yes, Cal.com allows you to embed branded booking and intake forms directly into your website or job pages, creating a seamless candidate journey from application to interview.

What support do you offer for agencies with complex needs?

Cal.com provides extensive documentation, a help center, and dedicated support for agencies. For advanced needs, you can explore our API, custom integrations, and enterprise solutions. See our Help Center for more information.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help remote mental health clinics route new patients to the right provider?

Cal.com’s routing forms allow you to create tailored intake workflows, so each patient is guided to the most appropriate clinician based on their needs. This ensures patients receive specialized care quickly, reducing manual sorting and administrative work.

Is Cal.com HIPAA-compliant and secure for sensitive mental health data?

Cal.com is privacy-focused and offers HIPAA-ready deployment options, including self-hosting. Sensitive data collected through scheduling and intake forms can be handled securely and in compliance with healthcare regulations.

Can I customize routing logic for different mental health specialties or therapy types?

Yes. You can easily configure routing forms to match patients with providers based on specialty, therapy type, language, or other relevant attributes. Routing logic is fully customizable to your clinic’s workflow.

How does Cal.com integrate with telehealth platforms or EHR systems?

Cal.com is API-first and offers integrations with leading telehealth and EHR platforms, allowing you to seamlessly embed scheduling and routing into your existing systems.

Can patients schedule virtual group or family sessions?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports multi-participant scheduling, so patients can book individual, group, or family therapy sessions online, with automated routing to the right provider.

Does Cal.com support self-hosting for healthcare organizations?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted, giving your organization complete control over data, compliance, and customization, which is ideal for healthcare providers with strict data privacy requirements.

How do analytics help improve mental health care delivery?

Cal.com’s analytics dashboard provides insights on patient flow, provider utilization, and routing outcomes, so you can optimize staffing, reduce wait times, and continuously improve your scheduling and care delivery processes.

Automate tenant inquiries, property tours, and maintenance appointments with advanced scheduling infrastructure.

How it works

## Simple steps to smarter scheduling for rental agencies

Automatically route tenant inquiries and property bookings to the right team member in just a few clicks.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up routing forms for tenant needs

Create custom forms to capture tenant details, property preferences, and service requests before booking.

![User interface for creating a question on a booking form tailored to rental property management. The prompt 'Create your first question' is displayed with additional text for essential tenant or owner information.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/yDoN8LqckbgtbBhtbzn5L6kxW2s.png)

02

### Collect tenant and property information

Have tenants or owners provide necessary information, such as property address, type of service, or preferred viewing times.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign to the right agent or specialist

Based on responses, Cal.com routes bookings to the appropriate property manager, leasing agent, or maintenance team member.

![Table displaying team members for a rental agency, including Leasing, Maintenance, Inspections, and Owner Services teams.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/qD9BdJwk0NhvVgLZp2BlGr0qQE.png)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help rental agencies automate scheduling?

Cal.com lets rental agencies build custom booking flows that automatically assign tenant inquiries and appointments to the right property manager, leasing agent, or maintenance team member based on property, location, or service type.

Can I route maintenance requests directly to the right team?

Yes. With attribute-based routing, Cal.com can direct maintenance requests to the correct team or contractor, reducing response times and eliminating manual triage.

Does Cal.com integrate with our property management software?

Cal.com offers an API-first architecture and supports integrations with leading property management tools and CRMs. Explore our integrations or contact us for custom solutions.

Is it possible to assign inquiries based on property ownership or portfolio?

Absolutely. Cal.com can match bookings to the designated property manager or leasing agent for each property, ensuring continuity and personalized service.

Can tenants book viewings or inspections online?

Yes. Tenants and prospects can select available times and book viewings, inspections, or meetings directly through your Cal.com-powered forms.

How secure is Cal.com for managing sensitive tenant and property data?

Cal.com is designed with security in mind, offering self-hosting options and GDPR compliance. You control your data and can tailor privacy settings to meet your agency’s requirements.

What does it cost to deploy Cal.com for my rental agency team?

Cal.com offers transparent pricing based on your team size and needs. Visit our pricing page or book a demo for a custom quote.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help retailers manage high appointment volumes?

Cal.com’s robust routing engine handles high-traffic environments, automatically distributing appointments among available staff and locations to prevent bottlenecks and minimize wait times.

Can customers book both in-store and virtual retail appointments?

Yes, Cal.com supports seamless scheduling for both in-person and virtual consultations, allowing retailers to offer omnichannel appointment experiences.

How does attribute-based routing improve retail customer service?

Attribute-based routing directs customers to associates based on expertise, language, or product knowledge, ensuring each customer connects with the most suitable staff member.

What integrations are available for retail systems?

Cal.com integrates with leading retail CRM, POS, and communication tools. You can synchronize scheduling data with your existing systems for a unified customer journey.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for retail operations?

Yes. With self-hosting options and enterprise-grade security, Cal.com empowers retailers to maintain full control over data privacy and regional compliance.

Can I customize the booking process for specific retail campaigns or services?

Absolutely. Cal.com lets you create tailored routing forms and workflows to support seasonal promotions, VIP events, or specialized services.

What is the onboarding process like for retail teams?

Retail teams can get started quickly using Cal.com’s intuitive setup, with dedicated support and extensive documentation to ensure a smooth rollout across locations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com routing help SaaS sales teams improve demo bookings?

Cal.com’s routing automatically assigns demo requests to the most relevant sales reps based on prospect data, reducing manual triage and enabling faster responses. This boosts conversion rates and ensures every lead is handled efficiently.

Can I route onboarding or support requests by product, tier, or region?

Yes, Cal.com’s attribute-based routing allows you to define rules using any data point—such as product interest, subscription level, or geography—so every customer connects with the right specialist.

How does Cal.com integrate with SaaS CRMs and data enrichment tools?

Cal.com integrates directly with Salesforce, HubSpot, and enrichment providers. This allows meeting routing based on account ownership, lead score, or any custom field in your CRM, ensuring seamless workflows.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for SaaS companies with strict requirements?

Cal.com supports self-hosting and robust API controls, meeting enterprise security and compliance needs. Sensitive data stays within your infrastructure, and you control all routing logic.

How customizable are the routing forms and booking flows?

Routing forms are fully customizable and no-code friendly. SaaS teams can build multi-step forms with conditional logic, ensuring every prospect or customer is qualified and routed appropriately before booking.

Can Cal.com support both inbound and outbound SaaS scheduling use cases?

Absolutely. Use Cal.com for inbound demo or support bookings via your website, or for outbound prospecting and customer outreach by sending personalized links with embedded routing logic.

What’s the process for migrating from a legacy scheduling tool to Cal.com?

Cal.com offers migration guides and white-glove onboarding for SaaS teams switching from legacy tools. Our support team assists with mapping workflows, integrating CRMs, and replicating existing routing logic for a smooth transition.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help SaaS sales teams qualify and route leads?

Cal.com lets your team build custom qualification forms that capture key sales data up front. Based on responses, leads are automatically routed to the most appropriate sales rep, using criteria like company size, industry, territory, and CRM ownership. This ensures every inquiry gets the right attention, faster.

Can Cal.com integrate with our CRM and sales tools?

Yes. Cal.com has robust integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and more. This allows you to route leads based on real-time CRM data, assign by account owner, and keep your sales pipeline organized.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for SaaS companies?

Absolutely. Cal.com is SOC 2 Type II compliant, offers self-hosted deployment, and provides enterprise-grade security features. Your lead and customer data stays secure and private.

Does Cal.com support round robin and territory-based routing?

Yes. You can set up round robin, territory, or attribute-based routing logic to match your sales team's structure. Cal.com makes it easy to assign leads fairly or strategically, based on your business rules.

How customizable are Cal.com's routing forms?

Cal.com's routing forms are fully no-code and highly customizable. Add as many fields, steps, and logic conditions as you need to qualify SaaS prospects and capture the data that matters to your team.

Can we embed the routing and booking process on our SaaS website?

Yes. You can embed branded routing and scheduling forms directly onto your SaaS website or landing pages, creating a seamless experience for prospects and increasing conversion rates.

What does it take to get started with Cal.com for SaaS sales routing?

Getting started is simple. Sign up for a Cal.com account, install the Routing Forms app, and connect your CRM. From there, you can create your custom forms and routing logic in minutes. For advanced needs, our team is happy to provide a live demo or help with setup.

# Intelligent routing for sales and business development

Accelerate deals with seamless lead routing and scheduling for sales teams

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Sales and business development routing form showing industry-specific questions for qualifying and segmenting leads.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/WxuaaMxDZOHmnPYtRyukelsfU.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to smarter sales routing

Effortlessly match prospects to the right sales or business development rep with easy automation.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Define your sales routing rules

Set up logic to assign leads based on region, company size, product interest, or existing account ownership.

![Sales qualification form template creation for sales and business development use case.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/m9DaF74lA6qOQVBuweOIa6WueTI.png)

02

### Let prospects share their details

Capture key information from leads with customizable forms, qualifying and segmenting them instantly.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign and schedule

Cal.com routes each prospect to the best-fit rep and offers instant meeting booking, reducing delays and manual work.

![Automated routing for sales representatives and business development team assignments.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/4JkxJYDIw2jaGlWbuDPVIszn0S4.png)

## Advanced features for sales and business development teams

Designed to streamline lead management, qualification, and scheduling for revenue-focused organizations.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based routing

Assign leads to reps based on territory, product line, or expertise, using flexible logic that adapts to your sales process.

### Account ownership detection

Automatically route repeat or existing customers to their dedicated account owner for a personalized experience.

### CRM and tool integrations

Sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, and other sales tools to keep data flowing and assignments accurate.

### Customizable qualification forms

Collect key information from prospects up front to pre-qualify leads and match them to the right rep or team.

### Multi-step forms for complex sales

Guide prospects through tailored questions and workflows, gathering all the data you need to route efficiently.

### Actionable routing analytics

Track lead distribution, booking rates, and conversion data to optimize your sales workflows over time.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help sales teams qualify and route leads?

Cal.com lets you create custom qualification forms that collect essential lead details, then uses attribute-based logic to instantly route each lead to the right sales or business development representative. This eliminates manual assignment and ensures that prospects are always connected with the most appropriate contact.

Can Cal.com integrate with our CRM and sales tools?

Yes, Cal.com offers native integrations with popular CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot, as well as email and calendar tools. This ensures your lead data and meeting assignments are always up to date and synced across your sales stack.

How does ownership assignment work for existing accounts?

Cal.com detects if a prospect is already assigned to a sales rep in your CRM. If so, the system automatically routes the booking to that account owner, ensuring continuity and a personalized experience.

Can we customize the qualification questions and routing logic?

Absolutely. You can fully tailor the forms and routing logic to match your sales workflow, including multi-step forms, conditional fields, and advanced assignment rules based on any captured data point.

Is Cal.com suitable for both inbound and outbound sales workflows?

Yes, Cal.com supports both inbound lead capture and outbound prospecting, making it easy for any sales workflow to automate scheduling and assignment, no matter the channel.

How do routing analytics help improve our sales process?

Cal.com provides detailed analytics on lead routing, booking rates, and rep performance. This insight helps you identify bottlenecks, optimize routing rules, and improve conversion rates over time.

What are the hosting and security options for enterprise sales teams?

Cal.com is open-source and supports both cloud and self-hosted deployments. This gives sales organizations full control over data, security, and compliance, while ensuring scalability for any team size.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help short-term rental hosts manage guest bookings more efficiently?

Cal.com automates the process from inquiry to booking, qualifying guests, routing them to the appropriate property or host, and enabling instant scheduling. This saves time and reduces manual effort for hosts and property managers.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my property management system (PMS)?

Yes, Cal.com’s open API and Zapier integrations make it easy to connect with leading PMS solutions and automate data sync between tools.

Is it possible to customize guest inquiry forms to match my brand?

Absolutely. Cal.com allows you to fully customize forms, add your branding, and tailor questions to capture the details you need from guests.

How does routing work if I have multiple properties or hosts?

You can set up rules to route inquiries based on guest preferences, property availability, location, or even ownership. Cal.com supports both round-robin and direct assignment.

Does Cal.com support automated guest communications such as confirmations and reminders?

Yes, automated messages can be triggered based on booking events, ensuring guests receive timely confirmations, reminders, or instructions.

Can I self-host Cal.com to keep guest data private?

Yes, Cal.com is fully open-source and can be self-hosted, giving you control over your guest and booking data.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for short-term rental managers?

You can track inquiry volume, booking conversion rates, response speed, and team assignment metrics to optimize your operations and guest experience.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help software implementation teams reduce scheduling friction?

Cal.com automates client intake and routes bookings to the right specialists based on project needs, reducing manual coordination and speeding up kickoff timelines.

Can we customize routing forms for different implementation scenarios?

Yes, you can fully customize forms to capture project-specific details such as industry, rollout phase, technical stack, and more, ensuring every booking is routed correctly.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM and project management tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers native integrations with leading CRMs like Salesforce and project tools such as Jira or Asana, syncing client data and ensuring seamless workflows.

How does attribute-based routing work for implementation teams?

You can define routing logic based on any client attribute—such as project type, region, or preferred technology—so every booking reaches the most qualified specialist.

Is Cal.com secure enough for enterprise software teams?

Yes. Cal.com supports SSO, granular permissions, audit logs, and offers self-hosting options, so you maintain full control over your data and meet compliance requirements.

Can we track and optimize our implementation routing performance?

Yes. Cal.com provides detailed analytics on form responses, routing patterns, and team workloads, helping you identify bottlenecks and improve service delivery.

What support does Cal.com offer for complex enterprise rollouts?

Cal.com offers onboarding support, advanced integrations, and custom configuration to ensure large-scale implementation teams have everything they need for success.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my sports coaching organization automate athlete intake and session assignment?

Cal.com lets you create customizable routing forms that collect athlete information upfront. Based on their responses, the platform automatically assigns bookings to the most suitable coach or session type, eliminating manual coordination and ensuring every athlete is matched for success.

Can I route athletes to coaches based on sport, skill level, or certification?

Yes, attribute-based routing in Cal.com allows you to assign athletes to coaches based on criteria like sport, experience level, certifications, or even team preferences. This helps ensure optimal coach-athlete pairing every time.

Is Cal.com suitable for group clinics, team practices, and recurring training sessions?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports individual, group, and recurring bookings. You can set up regular practice slots, manage team clinics, and even automate reminders for participants—all from a single platform.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing calendars and communication tools?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with all major calendar providers (Google, Outlook, iCloud) and offers notifications, reminders, and webhooks for seamless communication with athletes and coaches.

Can I self-host Cal.com to meet my organization’s privacy and security requirements?

Cal.com is fully open source and can be self-hosted, giving you complete control over athlete and team data. This is ideal for organizations with strict compliance or data privacy needs.

How do I customize intake forms and routing logic for our specific coaching workflows?

Cal.com’s no-code form builder lets you tailor every booking form to your coaching process. You can set required fields, add dropdowns for sport/skill, and define routing rules for automatic coach assignment—no technical expertise needed.

What support and resources are available for onboarding my coaching team to Cal.com?

Cal.com provides extensive help center articles, step-by-step guides, and live support to ensure your team is set up quickly. Explore our \[Help Center\](https://help.cal.com) or \[book a demo\](https://cal.com/demo) for personalized onboarding.

Streamline lesson bookings with automated routing and scheduling tailored for swim schools, instructors, and aquatic teams.

## Simple steps to smarter swim lesson scheduling

Easily match swimmers with the right instructor using Cal.com’s automated routing forms and advanced scheduling tools.

01

### Create your swim lesson routing forms

Set up custom forms to gather important details from swimmers or parents, such as skill level, age, and preferred lesson times.

02

### Collect swimmer details and preferences

Swimmers or parents answer tailored questions before booking, ensuring you capture essential information for lesson assignment.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically route to the right instructor

Based on responses, Cal.com’s logic assigns each booking to the most suitable swim instructor, optimizing lesson fit and pool schedules.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help our swim school schedule lessons more efficiently?

Cal.com automates the entire scheduling process by collecting swimmer information and routing bookings to the most suitable available instructor. This reduces manual coordination and helps maximize pool and instructor utilization.

Can I customize the booking form for different lesson types or swimmer skill levels?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing forms are fully customizable. You can create different forms for group lessons, private sessions, or skill-specific classes, ensuring swimmers are matched to the right instructor every time.

Does Cal.com support multiple locations or pools?

Absolutely. Cal.com can manage bookings and instructor assignments across multiple pools, locations, or branches, giving you centralized control and visibility.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with our existing swim school management software?

Yes, Cal.com offers a robust API and native integrations that make it easy to connect with popular swim school management tools and CRMs.

Can we assign swimmers to instructors based on certifications or specialties?

Definitely. Cal.com’s attribute-based routing allows you to tag instructors with certifications (e.g., CPR, adaptive aquatics) or specialties (e.g., infants, adults), automatically pairing bookings with the best-qualified staff.

How does Cal.com handle schedule changes or cancellations?

Cal.com provides automated notifications for schedule changes or cancellations. Swimmers and instructors receive instant updates, and the system can reroute bookings to other available instructors as needed.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for managing sensitive swimmer information?

Yes, Cal.com is designed with privacy and security in mind. You can self-host or use our secure cloud, ensuring compliance with data protection standards relevant for swim schools and organizations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help talent agencies automate candidate-to-client matching?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you collect key details from candidates and clients, then automatically route them to the right recruiter or agent based on your agency’s criteria. This automation streamlines placements and saves your team time.

Can Cal.com integrate with my applicant tracking system (ATS) or CRM?

Yes, Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular ATS and CRM platforms, ensuring your candidate and client data stays in sync throughout the entire placement process.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com to comply with data privacy requirements?

Absolutely. Cal.com’s open-source architecture supports self-hosting, giving your agency full control over sensitive candidate and client data.

How customizable are the routing forms for unique agency workflows?

Routing forms are highly customizable: you can add fields, create conditional logic, and adapt the flow to fit your agency’s specific processes, specialties, and client needs.

Can recruiters see analytics about candidate and client routing performance?

Yes, Cal.com’s insights dashboard provides real-time analytics on form responses, routing efficiency, and placement success, enabling agencies to fine-tune workflows.

Does Cal.com support multi-location or remote recruiter teams?

Cal.com is built for distributed teams. You can set up routing based on recruiter specialties, locations, or availability, ensuring optimal assignments across your agency.

What support does Cal.com offer for onboarding and migration?

Cal.com provides comprehensive onboarding resources, dedicated documentation, and support channels to help your agency migrate existing workflows and train your team.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help tech hiring marketplaces automate candidate-recruiter matching?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you collect relevant candidate information and use it to automatically match them to the best-fit recruiter based on predefined criteria such as skills, experience, or location. This removes manual triage and accelerates the hiring process.

Can Cal.com integrate with our applicant tracking system (ATS)?

Yes. Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular ATS platforms as well as a flexible API, allowing you to sync candidate and recruiter data, automate event creation, and keep records up-to-date.

Is it possible to customize routing rules for different job categories or regions?

Absolutely. You can define custom routing logic for specific job categories, tech stacks, or regions. This ensures candidates are always matched with the most appropriate recruiter or hiring team.

How does Cal.com handle high-volume scheduling during hiring spikes?

Cal.com is built to handle high-volume scheduling. Attribute-based routing and automation ensure that even during peak hiring seasons, every candidate is efficiently matched and booked with minimal manual intervention.

What is the benefit of open-source infrastructure for tech hiring marketplaces?

Open-source gives your team full control and transparency. You can customize workflows, integrate deeply with your systems, or self-host Cal.com to meet compliance or branding requirements.

How can we embed Cal.com scheduling directly into our hiring platform?

Cal.com provides embeddable widgets and APIs that let you add scheduling and routing forms directly into your platform, maintaining a consistent user experience for candidates and recruiters.

Does Cal.com support analytics to improve our hiring workflows?

Yes. Cal.com comes with built-in analytics and insights that help you monitor candidate flow, recruiter performance, and identify bottlenecks in your scheduling process.

Routing for technical recruiting

# Smarter routing for technical recruiting teams

Automate candidate scheduling and recruiter assignment with open, flexible routing forms built for modern talent acquisition.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Technical recruiting routing form, showing dynamic questions such as technical role, location, availability, and skill set.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/4XEkYqxZ4UmlJUqBGqEIPsGVZxk.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Simplify your technical recruiting workflow with intelligent candidate routing.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up recruiter routing forms

Create custom forms to collect essential details from candidates, such as role, skills, and location, before booking.

![Create technical recruiting form template, highlighting essential questions for candidates applying to technical roles.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/r13DRO6B1QV6pWI6Fcmoo0Llg1A.png)

02

### Let candidates provide information

Candidates complete your tailored pre-screening questions, ensuring you capture the right details up front.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Automatically assign to the right recruiter

Cal.com routes candidates to the most suitable recruiter based on their profile and your team's criteria.

![Automated technical recruiter assignment interface, displaying recruiters sorted by specialty and team.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/kRSVg0PhZsVT1z5T0Z7WL5PzkQE.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for recruiting teams

Unlock efficiency and improve the candidate experience with Cal.com routing.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Attribute-based routing for technical recruiting, showing candidate attributes and recruiter assignment by country and skill set.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/z4B5frYFbNPhVIAp3gYAcDHJPs.png)

01

### Faster candidate screening

Automate the pre-screening process and instantly connect qualified candidates with the right recruiter, reducing manual back-and-forth.

02

### Improved recruiter utilization

Attribute-based routing ensures every recruiter is matched to candidates based on expertise, location, and workload, optimizing team performance.

![Ownership assignment visualization for technical recruiting, with candidates directed to their assigned recruiter or routed via round robin.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gQpaPV2wnfQL6VqrecvgjvI27bk.png)

![Analytics dashboard for technical recruiting, highlighting recruiter routing volumes and candidate distribution.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0HEpgDFzZqQcOgpH9wxKGt4fJI.png)

03

### Enhanced candidate experience

Streamlined scheduling eliminates delays and confusion, giving candidates a seamless way to book interviews at their convenience.

04

### Open-source flexibility

Adapt Cal.com to your unique recruiting workflows with self-hosting, custom integrations, and full API access.

![Customizable routing logic interface for technical recruiting, displaying logic for matching candidates to recruiters based on role, skill set, and region.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Yo0qY1i1ScsmGjFLODegLhEw.png)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for technical hiring

Everything you need for scalable, automated recruiting operations.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Flexible routing logic

Route candidates using multiple attributes such as role, skill set, experience level, and location.

### CRM and ATS integrations

Connect with Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and more to sync candidate data and recruiter assignments.

### Ownership assignment

Assign candidates to the recruiter who already owns the relationship in your ATS, ensuring consistent communication.

### Advanced analytics

Track routing efficiency, candidate drop-off, and recruiter performance from a central dashboard.

### Customizable forms

Build no-code, branded forms to collect candidate information relevant to each technical role.

### Multi-step scheduling

Break down the interview process into clear stages, from screening calls to panel interviews, all in one workflow.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help reduce manual scheduling for recruiting teams?

Cal.com automates the scheduling and assignment of candidates to recruiters by using customizable routing forms and advanced logic, eliminating time-consuming coordination and manual calendar management.

Can Cal.com integrate with our ATS or HR systems?

Yes, Cal.com offers integrations and APIs for leading ATS platforms like Greenhouse and Lever, allowing seamless syncing of candidate data and recruiter ownership.

How does Cal.com ensure candidates are matched to the right recruiter?

Routing logic uses attributes such as technical skills, role, region, and recruiter workload to automatically assign candidates to the best-fit recruiter for each opening.

Is it possible to customize forms for different technical roles or departments?

Absolutely. You can build unique forms for each technical position or department, tailoring questions to screen for specific skill sets and requirements.

Does Cal.com support distributed or global recruiting teams?

Yes, Cal.com’s routing and scheduling tools are designed for distributed teams, supporting multiple time zones, locations, and localized workflows.

How secure is candidate data with Cal.com?

Cal.com provides robust security with SOC 2 compliance, GDPR support, and self-hosting options so you can control your data environment.

What is the onboarding process for technical recruiting teams?

Getting started is simple: sign up, install the Routing Forms app, integrate with your ATS, and configure forms and routing logic for your recruiting team. Our help center and support team are here to guide you.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com route technical support requests to the right engineer?

Cal.com uses customizable routing forms and attribute-based logic to direct customer requests to the most suitable support agent, based on the product, issue type, language, or other key criteria.

Can Cal.com integrate with our existing help desk and CRM tools?

Yes. Cal.com offers robust integrations with popular help desk platforms, CRMs, and internal systems through our API and built-in connectors, ensuring a seamless workflow.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for data-sensitive support operations?

Absolutely. Cal.com is open source and can be self-hosted on your infrastructure, giving you full control over data privacy and compliance.

How does Cal.com handle urgent or high-priority support requests?

With customizable forms and routing logic, you can flag urgent requests and automatically assign them to priority queues or senior engineers for faster resolution.

Can we customize intake questions for different products or support tiers?

Yes. Cal.com allows you to build unique routing forms for each product line, region, or customer segment, ensuring relevant data collection and accurate routing.

Does Cal.com support round-robin and load-balanced assignment for large teams?

Cal.com supports round-robin, load balancing, and advanced attribute-based assignment, so you can distribute requests fairly across your technical support team.

What insights can support managers gain from Cal.com analytics?

Support managers can track key metrics like response times, routing accuracy, agent utilization, and customer satisfaction to identify bottlenecks and optimize team performance.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help us match students to the right tutor or class?

Cal.com's routing forms let you define rules based on subjects, grade levels, test prep needs, or learning styles. When a student or parent books, the system automatically assigns the booking to the tutor or class that best matches their criteria, reducing manual effort and improving fit.

Can we collect specific student information during booking?

Yes, you can fully customize intake forms to collect key details such as grade, preferred subjects, test date, learning goals, and parent contact information. This ensures you have the context needed to deliver personalized instruction.

Does Cal.com integrate with our CRM or learning management systems?

Cal.com integrates with popular CRMs and LMS platforms, as well as Zoom, Google Meet, and more. This keeps your scheduling, communication, and student records in sync across your tools.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for student data?

Absolutely. Cal.com is built with privacy and security in mind. You can self-host to maintain full control over your data, or use our secure cloud that meets industry standards for data protection.

Can we assign returning students to the same tutor automatically?

Yes, with ownership assignment, Cal.com can route repeat bookings to a student's previous tutor or a preferred instructor, supporting consistent and trusted relationships.

How does Cal.com help us manage high booking volumes?

Cal.com's scalable infrastructure and automated routing support large teams, multiple locations, and high-volume scheduling without bottlenecks. You can easily adjust routing rules as your business grows.

What does open source mean for our tutoring center?

Cal.com’s open-source approach lets you customize the platform to fit your unique processes, integrate with custom tools, or deploy on your own servers for maximum flexibility and compliance.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve scheduling for universities and colleges?

Cal.com automates routing and scheduling across campus departments, providing students and faculty with self-service access to the right resources, advisors, or services. This reduces manual coordination and streamlines campus operations.

Can routing logic be customized for different departments?

Yes, Cal.com’s flexible routing engine lets you create unique rules and workflows for each department—such as admissions, counseling, or IT—ensuring every request reaches the correct team.

How does Cal.com handle data privacy and compliance for educational institutions?

Cal.com supports self-hosting and offers robust privacy controls, allowing universities to keep sensitive data on-premises and comply with regulations like FERPA and GDPR.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with existing campus systems?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers API-first architecture and ready integrations with student information systems, learning management systems, calendar apps, and more for seamless campus-wide scheduling.

Can students and faculty book appointments without IT involvement?

Yes. Cal.com’s intuitive, no-code booking forms empower non-technical staff and end users to set up, request, and manage appointments independently.

Does Cal.com support group bookings or recurring meetings for campus events?

Cal.com allows group bookings, recurring meetings, and complex scheduling scenarios—making it ideal for everything from office hours to workshops and campus tours.

What are the key benefits of using open-source scheduling infrastructure for higher education?

Open-source platforms like Cal.com provide flexibility, transparency, and full control over data and workflows. Universities can customize the system to their needs and avoid vendor lock-in.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help us manage high volumes of vaccine or testing appointments?

Cal.com automates the routing and scheduling process, scaling effortlessly to handle surges in appointment requests. Patients are guided to available slots and locations, reducing manual work and bottlenecks.

Is Cal.com compliant with healthcare privacy regulations?

Yes, Cal.com offers HIPAA-ready infrastructure and can be self-hosted to meet strict data privacy requirements. Patient information is always protected, and you have control over data residency.

Can we route patients based on insurance, eligibility, or test type?

Absolutely. Cal.com's forms and routing logic let you collect key data—such as insurance provider, eligibility criteria, or required test type—to ensure each patient is directed to the appropriate provider or service.

How does Cal.com integrate with our existing EMR or patient management systems?

Cal.com features an API-first architecture, making it easy to connect with your EMR, patient portal, or other healthcare software. Sync appointments and patient data across systems for seamless operations.

Can we offer both in-person and virtual appointments?

Yes, Cal.com supports multiple appointment types, allowing you to route patients to virtual consultations, telehealth, or physical locations based on their preferences and service needs.

How do we reduce no-shows for vaccine and testing appointments?

Automated reminders, calendar integrations, and streamlined booking flows help minimize no-shows. You can also collect key information up front to ensure patients are eligible and prepared for their appointments.

What analytics are available for monitoring appointment routing and site utilization?

Cal.com includes built-in analytics to track appointment volumes, routing outcomes, and resource allocation. Use these insights to optimize staffing, identify trends, and improve patient flow.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help veterinary clinics reduce scheduling workload?

Cal.com streamlines appointment intake with self-service routing forms, automating assignment based on pet type, medical need, and provider specialty. This reduces manual calls and administrative overhead.

Can Cal.com route urgent cases to emergency vets automatically?

Yes, you can set up routing logic to identify emergencies from client responses and prioritize or escalate bookings to available emergency veterinarians.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling sensitive pet and client data?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports HIPAA-compliant self-hosting and robust data privacy controls, making it suitable for veterinary practices.

Can returning clients be matched with their preferred veterinarian?

Yes, Cal.com can recognize returning clients and assign them to their regular vet, improving continuity of care and client satisfaction.

Does Cal.com integrate with veterinary practice management software?

Cal.com offers API-first integrations and can connect with popular practice management systems, calendars, and communication tools. Learn more at our integrations page.

How customizable are the intake and routing forms for different veterinary services?

You can fully customize forms to capture species, breed, medical concerns, and service type, ensuring each booking is routed correctly.

What is required to get started with Cal.com for my clinic?

Sign up for a free Cal.com account, or book a personalized demo. Our team will help you set up routing forms and integrations tailored to your clinic’s needs. Visit our Help Center for step-by-step guides.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help vocational schools automate admissions scheduling?

Cal.com enables vocational and trade schools to set up intelligent routing forms, so prospective students are automatically connected to the right admissions advisor or department without manual intervention. This reduces wait times and administrative workload.

Can Cal.com route current students to their assigned advisor or counselor?

Yes. Using attribute-based routing and ownership assignment, Cal.com can securely direct existing students to their designated advisor, ensuring continuity and personalized support.

Is Cal.com compliant with FERPA and data privacy requirements?

Cal.com offers self-hosting and robust security options, allowing schools to maintain compliance with FERPA and other data privacy regulations. You control where and how your data is stored.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our student information system (SIS) or CRM?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers a powerful API and native integrations, making it easy to connect with your SIS, CRM, or communication tools for seamless scheduling and data flow.

How customizable are the routing forms for different programs and campuses?

Routing forms are fully customizable. You can tailor questions and logic for each program, location, or intake type to ensure every student or visitor is matched with the right contact.

Does Cal.com support multi-campus or multi-department scheduling?

Yes. Cal.com allows you to create routing logic for multiple campuses, departments, and teams, ensuring inquiries always go to the correct place.

What support resources does Cal.com offer for educational institutions?

Cal.com provides detailed documentation, a dedicated help center, and responsive support to help vocational and trade schools deploy and optimize scheduling workflows.

# Smarter routing for web development agencies

Automate lead assignment and project intake with flexible, open-source scheduling tailored for agencies

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Web development agency routing form showing project type, budget, and timeline questions for client intake.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/oEsgeLsifdrywhRN3TfQHV1DzNI.png)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## Simple steps to automate client routing

Streamline your new project intake, qualify leads, and connect prospects to the right specialists in your agency.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Define your routing logic

Set up custom intake forms to gather project requirements, budget, and desired services from potential clients before booking.

![Web development agency booking form creation with custom project questions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/03UwzuryRja3Zh83WNzEhpx7P20.png)

02

### Qualify and segment inquiries

Route leads based on client needs, company size, or project type, ensuring every inquiry reaches the ideal team member.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/awXykbNQOWqd9F7QOLEU5mPVzXE.png)

03

### Book and assign instantly

Clients book directly with the right specialist or project manager, reducing manual back-and-forth and speeding up your sales cycle.

![Automated routing interface for web development agencies, showing assignment to frontend, backend, and design teams.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/mbgVbXcO8clK1KLxrTKfAIx3OH4.png)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features designed for modern web agencies

Powerful, flexible tools to automate scheduling, lead routing, and collaboration.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Attribute-based client routing

Match new project requests with the right developer or team based on tech stack, project type, or location.

### CRM and project management integrations

Sync bookings and client data with your agency’s existing tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, and more.

### Customizable intake forms

Gather key project requirements, timelines, and budgets up front with easy-to-build, no-code forms.

### Round-robin and ownership assignment

Assign meetings based on team availability or route returning clients to their dedicated account manager.

### Self-hosting and open-source flexibility

Deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure for maximum security and control, or use our hosted solution.

### Comprehensive analytics and reporting

Gain insights into project pipelines, lead sources, and individual team performance to drive agency strategy.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can web development agencies use Cal.com to qualify leads during the booking process?

Agencies can create custom intake forms that ask prospective clients about their project type, budget, timeline, and technical needs. Cal.com’s routing forms automatically segment and qualify leads so only serious, relevant inquiries reach your team.

Can Cal.com route new project requests to the right developer or team based on skills or availability?

Yes. Cal.com supports attribute-based routing, letting you assign bookings to team members based on expertise, tech stack, or current workload. You can set custom rules to ensure every inquiry is matched with the right specialist.

Does Cal.com integrate with agency CRMs or project management tools?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers direct integrations with popular CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce, as well as tools like Slack, Trello, and Notion. This keeps your project pipeline and communications in sync.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for enhanced data privacy?

Yes, Cal.com is open source and can be fully self-hosted, giving agencies complete control over client data and compliance requirements. You can also choose our secure hosted solution.

How does Cal.com help agencies manage high volumes of client inquiries?

Cal.com automates the intake, qualification, and assignment process, eliminating manual triage. Advanced routing logic, analytics, and integrations let you efficiently manage large volumes while personalizing the client experience.

Can I customize the booking flow to match my agency’s brand and workflow?

Yes, Cal.com offers white-labeling and extensive customization. You can tailor forms, booking pages, and routing logic to reflect your brand and streamline your agency’s unique workflow.

What is the pricing model for agencies looking to use Cal.com’s routing features?

Cal.com offers flexible pricing. Routing features are available as part of the Organizations suite, with per-user pricing and scalable options for agencies of all sizes. Visit our pricing page for details.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help wellness coaches match clients effectively?

Cal.com’s routing forms collect detailed client information at the time of booking. This data is used to automatically assign clients to the most suitable coach based on expertise, availability, and client preferences.

Can I customize intake forms for different wellness services?

Yes, you can create fully customizable forms tailored to specific services such as nutrition, fitness, or mental wellness, ensuring clients are matched with the right coach every time.

Is client data secure and private on Cal.com?

Absolutely. You have the option to self-host Cal.com, giving you complete control over sensitive client information and supporting regulatory compliance.

Does Cal.com integrate with my existing calendar?

Cal.com offers robust integrations with Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, and more, ensuring all appointments are automatically synced.

Can I route clients based on language, specialization, or location?

Yes, attribute-based routing lets you match clients with coaches who meet specific criteria such as language spoken, area of expertise, or preferred location.

How can analytics help my wellness practice grow?

Cal.com provides insights into booking patterns, popular services, and coach performance, empowering you to make data-driven decisions to enhance client satisfaction and business growth.

Can I embed the booking and routing process into my own website?

Yes, with Cal.com’s API and embed options, you can integrate the entire scheduling and intake experience seamlessly into your website or client portal.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help my spa manage multiple therapists and treatments?

Cal.com’s routing forms let you collect guest preferences and match each booking to the most suitable therapist or treatment automatically. This ensures optimal staff utilization and a tailored guest experience.

Can I use Cal.com for group or retreat package bookings?

Yes. Cal.com supports both individual and group bookings, allowing you to capture package preferences and route groups to the right sessions or facilitators within your retreat or spa environment.

Is my guest data secure with Cal.com?

Absolutely. Cal.com offers self-hosting options, so you can keep sensitive guest information on your own servers and comply with privacy regulations relevant to the wellness industry.

Can I customize intake forms to match my brand and services?

Yes. Intake forms are fully customizable, so you can gather specific information such as dietary restrictions, wellness goals, or preferred treatments and reflect your spa’s branding.

How does Cal.com integrate with my current booking or CRM system?

Cal.com provides robust integrations and an API-first architecture, so you can sync bookings with your existing CRM, spa management software, or communication tools.

Does Cal.com support appointment reminders and follow-ups?

Yes. You can automate reminders, confirmations, and follow-up messages to guests, reducing no-shows and enhancing the client experience.

What does it cost to use Cal.com for my retreat or spa?

Cal.com has flexible pricing, including a free tier and affordable paid plans for growing businesses. You can also self-host at no extra cost for maximum flexibility. Visit our pricing page for details.

## How Cal.com works for C-suite executives

Empower your leadership team with streamlined scheduling tools that save time, foster collaboration, and enhance efficiency across your organization.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Wds4slJZAtNkodl0iRNUMbKN1lk.png?scale-down-to=512&width=756&height=578)

01

### Seamless executive collaboration

Coordinate across time zones and teams with ease. Cal.com supports executive meetings with features like dynamic availability, integrated video conferencing, and instant updates, ensuring productive collaboration no matter the location.

02

### Optimized time management

Maximize efficiency with tools like collective scheduling and round-robin setups for board meetings, investor calls, or strategy sessions. Automated reminders and customizable templates ensure meetings are always on track.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xd2BYXgnjnzO9tOkQmwIJyGujo.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=682&height=1183)

03

### A professional client experience

Deliver a seamless and professional experience to your clients and stakeholders. Branded booking pages and automated workflows ensure every interaction reflects your leadership’s commitment to excellence.

## Designed for a maximum efficiency

Boost campus performance with our advanced collaboration features and automated workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Round robin

Distribute meetings amongst team members based on weights, priorities or the person least recently booked.

### Collective events

Book a meeting with several team members at one time.

### Routing forms

Direct bookers to the right people based on their details, like industry, company-size, etc.

### Dynamic meetings

Easily see when everyone's available, automatically handling multiple time zones.

### Automated workflows

Save time with automated workflows like meeting reminders.

### Accept payments

Process payments and place holds through Stripe or PayPal integration.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve my organization's scheduling process?

Cal.com streamlines scheduling for executives and their teams, eliminating back-and-forth emails. It helps manage internal meetings, external consultations, and cross-departmental collaboration efficiently.

Can I manage scheduling for multiple departments or teams?

Yes, Cal.com allows you to create sub-teams, each with its own scheduling preferences, ensuring seamless coordination across the organization.

Is Cal.com secure enough for handling sensitive executive meetings?

Absolutely. Cal.com employs industry-standard encryption and privacy protocols, ensuring that your data and meeting details are always protected.

How does Cal.com integrate with tools my team already uses?

Cal.com integrates with popular platforms like Google Calendar, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams making it easy to sync with your existing workflow.

Can I use Cal.com to schedule board meetings or investor calls?

Yes, Cal.com’s flexible scheduling options allow you to manage high-level meetings like board sessions, investor updates, or client pitches with ease.

## Why choose Cal.com over Calendly

Calendly set the standard for online scheduling, but Cal.com goes further—more innovative, transparent, and user-friendly. We make scheduling simple, flexible, and free from unnecessary limits or upsells, offering more features for everyone, from freelancers to enterprises.

01

### Unlimited free usage

With Cal.com, enjoy unlimited bookings, event types, calendar integrations, workflows, and embeds. In contrast, Calendly’s free plan imposes strict limits, allowing only one calendar connection and a single event type.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3tK0ww3R23ZlVKZt2nOKBItn0ow.png?scale-down-to=2048)

02

### Short, unique, customizable URLs

Your booking link should be simple. With Cal.com/yourname, you get a short, memorable, and customizable URL that reflects your personal brand or business. Calendly? Expect a long, clunky link.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5s0XfrqXJwIUQ7NrXN0RE3JYuCg.png?scale-down-to=1024)

03

### Better user experience and support

The numbers say it all: Cal.com boasts a 4.7 ⭐ Trustpilot rating for ease of use, reliability, and support. Calendly? Just 1.7 ⭐—users complain about limited features and unresponsive support.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ZFLWM8kLNxK6lMhpoIyE3B8jp2M.png?scale-down-to=1024)
