## How does Calendly’s plans compare?

Calendly’s plans come with limitations and extra costs. See how Cal.com offers more features, better pricing, and greater flexibility—right from the free plan.

### Connect your calendar

Calendly offers limited free plan with only one event type and one calendar connection. No workflows and several essential features locked behind paid plans. With their Standard plan, Calendly charges $10/month for what Cal.com offers truly for free.

### Teams

Calendly Teams costs $20/month per user and focuses on scheduling automation and team collaboration tools, while Cal.com Teams is $15/month per user, offering more features at a lower price with same-day support.

### Organizations and Enterprise

Cal.com Organizations offers full transparency at just $37/month per user, packed with advanced business features including SOC2 compliance, SAML SSO, whitelabeling, and a custom subdomain. Calendly’s pricing for plans tailored to larger.

## How Cal.com works for healthcare providers

Revolutionize patient care with seamless scheduling tools designed for healthcare professionals delivering virtual services.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Wds4slJZAtNkodl0iRNUMbKN1lk.png?scale-down-to=512&width=756&height=578)

01

### Easy appointment scheduling

Allow patients to book consultations, follow-ups, or therapy sessions at their convenience. Cal.com integrates with telehealth platforms and adjusts for time zones, ensuring a smooth experience for both patients and providers.

02

### Efficient provider workflows

Streamline scheduling for multiple healthcare professionals with collective and round-robin features. Customizable booking forms help gather necessary patient details before appointments, saving time during consultations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3opxmbPLEyTyAvSda0U6hwynrk.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1428&height=824)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xd2BYXgnjnzO9tOkQmwIJyGujo.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=682&height=1183)

03

### Improved patient experience

Deliver a professional and patient-friendly booking experience with branded scheduling pages, automated reminders, and flexible rescheduling options to reduce no-shows and enhance satisfaction.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com, and how can it benefit healthcare providers?

Cal.com simplifies scheduling for healthcare providers, making it easy to manage patient appointments, consultations, and follow-ups.

How can Cal.com improve patient care?

By streamlining appointment scheduling, Cal.com reduces wait times, minimizes no-shows, and helps providers focus on delivering high-quality care.

Can Cal.com handle multiple providers with different schedules?

Yes, you can assign unique calendars to individual providers or departments, ensuring accurate availability for patient bookings.

Does Cal.com support virtual appointments for telehealth services?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with tools like Zoom and Google Meet, making it easy to manage virtual consultations.

Can Cal.com schedule recurring appointments, like physical therapy sessions or follow-ups?

Yes, recurring bookings are supported, making it ideal for long-term care plans or regular check-ups.

Can patients choose appointment types, like in-person or virtual, when booking?

Absolutely! You can offer multiple appointment types and let patients select their preferred option.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com, and how can it benefit universities?

Cal.com helps universities streamline scheduling for faculty, staff, and students, making it easier to book appointments, office hours, and events.

How can Cal.com support academic advising or faculty office hours?

Cal.com allows students to easily book time slots for advising, office hours, or tutoring, reducing administrative overhead.

Is Cal.com suitable for scheduling campus tours and admissions interviews?

Yes, Cal.com simplifies scheduling for prospective students and admissions teams, ensuring a smooth process for campus visits and interviews.

Can we customize the booking interface to reflect our university's branding?

Absolutely! You can customize colors, logos, and text to match your university’s visual identity.

Can we add custom questions to the booking form for students or visitors?

Yes, you can create custom fields to gather important information like student ID numbers, program interests, or specific questions.

Can Cal.com manage multiple departments with unique schedules?

Yes, Cal.com supports multiple calendars and booking pages, perfect for organizing different departments like admissions, counseling, or career services.

### Round robin

Distribute meetings amongst team members based on weights, priorities or the person least recently booked.

### Collective events

Book a meeting with several team members at one time.

### Routing forms

Direct bookers to the right people based on their details, like industry, company-size, etc.

### Dynamic meetings

Easily see when everyone's available, automatically handling multiple time zones.

### Automated workflows

Save time with automated workflows like meeting reminders.

### Accept payments

Process payments and place holds through Stripe or PayPal integration.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help streamline hiring on our marketplace?

Cal.com simplifies the hiring process by enabling seamless scheduling between job seekers and employers. Candidates can book interviews or demo calls directly based on the employer's availability.

Can employers and candidates manage their schedules through Cal.com?

Yes, both parties can view and manage their schedules, reschedule appointments, and receive automated reminders for upcoming calls or interviews.

Does Cal.com support different types of interviews (e.g., technical, behavioral)?

Absolutely! You can create custom event types for various interview formats and tailor the booking flow to suit your marketplace's needs.

Can Cal.com handle time zone differences for global hiring?

Yes, Cal.com automatically adjusts appointments to reflect the correct time zones for both employers and candidates.

Is Cal.com secure for sensitive hiring data?

Yes, Cal.com uses industry-standard encryption to protect all scheduling data and complies with GDPR and other privacy regulations.

## How Cal.com works for professional services

Empower your business with scheduling tools designed to enhance client relationships, improve team collaboration, and streamline service delivery.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Wds4slJZAtNkodl0iRNUMbKN1lk.png?scale-down-to=512&width=756&height=578)

01

### Seamless client consultations

Allow clients to book consultations, strategy sessions, or project updates effortlessly. Cal.com integrates with video conferencing tools and handles time zone adjustments to ensure smooth communication.

02

### Efficient team collaboration

Coordinate internal meetings, client presentations, and project reviews with ease. Collective and round-robin scheduling ensures the right team members are assigned to every meeting.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help improve my client scheduling?

Cal.com simplifies client scheduling by allowing them to book consultations, follow-ups, or strategy sessions at their convenience. It reduces back-and-forth communication and keeps your team organized.

Does Cal.com support multiple team members?

Absolutely! Cal.com supports collective and round-robin scheduling, ensuring the right team member is available for each meeting or client call.

How does Cal.com handle time zone differences?

Cal.com automatically adjusts meeting times for both clients and team members, ensuring there’s no confusion when scheduling across time zones.

Can Cal.com integrate with tools we already use?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with tools like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com, and how does it benefit a sales team?

Cal.com helps sales teams streamline scheduling by allowing clients to book meetings directly, reducing back-and-forth emails.

How does Cal.com integrate with our existing CRM?

Cal.com integrates with popular CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot, ensuring seamless tracking of leads and opportunities.

Can Cal.com handle group demos or round-robin scheduling for sales teams?

Yes, it supports group bookings and round-robin assignments to distribute meetings evenly among team members.

Can we customize the booking page to reflect our brand?

Absolutely! Cal.com offers white-label solutions to match your brand's look and feel.

Can we add custom fields to the booking form to gather more information about leads?

Yes, you can customize booking forms to collect details like company name, job title, or specific interests.

How does Cal.com handle different time zones for international clients?

Cal.com automatically adjusts for time zones, ensuring accurate scheduling for both clients and team members.

## How Cal.com works for talent acquisition teams

Accelerate your hiring process with scheduling tools that make it easy to connect with candidates, coordinate interviews, and streamline recruitment workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Wds4slJZAtNkodl0iRNUMbKN1lk.png?scale-down-to=512&width=756&height=578)

01

### Simplified interview scheduling

Coordinate interviews across time zones without the back-and-forth. Cal.com integrates with video conferencing tools, supports panel interviews, and ensures a seamless experience for both recruiters and candidates.

02

### Efficient recruitment workflows

Manage high volumes of interviews with collective and round-robin scheduling. Customizable booking forms gather candidate information upfront, saving time and ensuring interviewers are prepared.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3opxmbPLEyTyAvSda0U6hwynrk.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1428&height=824)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xd2BYXgnjnzO9tOkQmwIJyGujo.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=682&height=1183)

03

### A great candidate experience

### Round robin

Distribute meetings amongst team members based on weights, priorities or the person least recently booked.

### Collective events

Book a meeting with several team members at one time.

### Routing forms

Direct bookers to the right people based on their details, like industry, company-size, etc.

### Dynamic meetings

Easily see when everyone's available, automatically handling multiple time zones.

### Automated workflows

Save time with automated workflows like meeting reminders.

### Accept payments

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com, and how does it benefit talent acquisition teams?

Cal.com helps streamline interview scheduling, reducing the back-and-forth emails and making the hiring process faster and more efficient.

How can Cal.com improve our hiring process?

By automating scheduling for interviews, panel discussions, and onboarding sessions, Cal.com saves time and helps you focus on finding the right candidates.

Can we add custom fields to the booking form to gather candidate-specific information?

Absolutely! You can include fields for details like the position applied for, resume uploads, or other screening questions.

Does Cal.com support scheduling for multi-step interviews (e.g., phone screen, technical round, panel interview)?

Yes, Cal.com can handle multi-step interview processes by coordinating availability for multiple stakeholders and candidates.

How does Cal.com handle different time zones for international candidates?

Cal.com automatically adjusts for time zones, making it easy to schedule interviews across regions.

Can multiple interviewers join the same meeting?

Yes, you can set up group bookings to include multiple interviewers in a single session.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What is Cal.com, and how does it benefit telehealth providers?

Cal.com helps telehealth providers streamline appointment scheduling, making it easier for patients to book consultations and reducing administrative burden.

How can Cal.com improve the patient experience in telehealth?

Cal.com offers an easy-to-use booking system that eliminates back-and-forth scheduling, ensuring patients can quickly find and book available slots.

Can Cal.com handle multiple providers with different schedules?

Yes, Cal.com allows you to manage separate calendars for each provider, ensuring accurate availability.

Does Cal.com support telehealth-specific scheduling, such as virtual appointments?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with tools like Zoom, Google Meet, and Cal Video to schedule and manage virtual consultations.

How does Cal.com handle recurring appointments for ongoing care?

Patients can schedule recurring appointments for follow-ups or long-term care plans, ensuring continuity of treatment.

Can we offer patients multiple appointment types (e.g., initial consultation, follow-up, group session)?

Absolutely! You can customize appointment types and durations to fit different patient needs.

01

### Better team meetings

Cal.com simplifies team collaboration across time zones with features like dynamic team meetings that automatically handle availability. Its built-in video platform supports instant meetings, screen sharing, and optional recordings, making it easy to communicate and keep projects on track, no matter the location.

02

### Discover a new kind of efficiency

Teams can now easily manage their time with collaborative scheduling like collective events and round-robin. Routing forms reduce client confusion, and customizable event templates allow role-specific appointments. Automated workflows ensure reminders, emails, and surveys reach the right attendee every time.

# Automate scheduling and reminders with Cal.com workflows

Tired of chasing people with reminders or manually sending confirmations? Cal.com Workflows let you automate your scheduling process, so every meeting runs smoothly without extra effort.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AVndkIcUUV60Yo4KZM7uxfYhjc.png?scale-down-to=2048&width=2553&height=2964)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## The simple steps to take to setup workflows in Cal.com

Cal.com Workflows help you automate the repetitive parts of scheduling. Set up simple, customizable automations around your events so you can focus on your meetings, not manual tasks.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set your trigger

Set what triggers your message and when to start the workflow.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Define what action happens next

Send emails, SMS or WhatsApp messages to anyone involved.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Customize the message

Use Cal.com's default templates or fully customize your messages.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

## Key benefits for automating scheduling with workflows

Workflows help reduce manual work, prevent no-shows and create a reliable, professional scheduling process for your business.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Reduce no-shows with automated reminders

Automated email, SMS and WhatsApp reminders help ensure attendees show up prepared. No more forgotten meetings or last-minute cancellations.

02

### Save time with fully automated scheduling

Cal.com handles confirmations, reminders and follow-ups in the background so you can focus on your work.

03

### Take control of your booking process

Decide exactly what happens and when. From instant confirmations to timed reminders or post-event follow-ups, you control the experience.

04

### Deliver a consistent, professional experience

Clear, branded communication makes every booking feel reliable and professional for your clients, teams and attendees.

## Additional workflow features for smarter scheduling automation

Cal.com Workflows include powerful features that go beyond basic reminders. Customize how, when and where your scheduling automations happen, with full support for multiple channels, event types and personalized messaging.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi-channel notifications

Send reminders and updates via email, SMS or WhatsApp, or combine all three to increase engagement and attendance rates.

### Flexible event triggers

Start workflows based on events like booking confirmations, cancellations, reschedules or time-based triggers before or after a meeting.

### Automate multiple actions with workflows and webhooks

Build workflows and webhooks to for example send a confirmation to the attendee, notify your team in Slack and send a follow-up email after the event ends.

### Custom messaging for branded communication

Edit your email, SMS and WhatsApp content to match your tone, brand and audience. Use default templates or create your own for a consistent experience every time.

### Personalized workflows for group events

Ensure every participant receives tailored messages based on their role or relationship to the event. Perfect for interviews, classrooms or team sessions.

### Easy visual builder and developer ready API

Set up workflows in minutes using a simple no-code interface. Developers can configure workflows programmatically using Cal.com’s robust API.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What are Cal.com Workflows?

Cal.com Workflows are simple automations that let you send reminders, notifications, and follow-ups around your scheduled events. You choose a trigger and define what happens next, so your scheduling runs smoothly without manual effort.

How can I customize messages and which channels can I use?

You can customize email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages using either default templates or fully branded content. These channels can be used individually or combined within the same workflow.

Can I have multiple actions for one trigger?

Yes. You can send different notifications to multiple recipients at the same time, all triggered by a single event.

Can I use Workflows for group events?

Yes. Workflows support both individual and group events. Each participant can automatically receive personalized communication.

Are reminders and follow-ups sent automatically?

Yes. Once your workflows are set up, all messages are sent automatically based on your configured timing and conditions.

Can I use Workflows with a self-hosted version of Cal.com?

Yes. Workflows are fully supported in both hosted and self-hosted Cal.com deployments. You can explore the implementation in our [GitHub repository](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/tree/main/packages/features/ee/workflows).

Can I manage workflows through the API?

Yes. Cal.com offers a developer-friendly API that lets you create, update, and retrieve workflows programmatically. View the full documentation in our [workflow API reference](https://cal.com/docs/api-reference/v2/orgs-teams-workflows/get-organization-team-workflows).

# Automate b2b account management with intelligent scheduling workflows

Coordinate QBRs, renewals, and multi stakeholder meetings with API first scheduling, templates, and automated communications.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow for b2b account management in Cal.com, confirming QBR attendance from multiple stakeholders.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jCvMo3HIHoRCwJRmGCPYl6dcCc.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com Workflows power b2b account management

From first meeting to renewal, Cal.com automates the repeatable steps in b2b account management. Route accounts to the right owner, coordinate stakeholder mapping calls, and standardize QBR and renewal cadences with reliable reminders, follow ups, and post meeting actions. With open source flexibility and a developer ready API, teams can self host or run on Cal.com Cloud, integrate CRMs and support tools, and track outcomes across the entire lifecycle.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your tools and map routing

Sync calendars, CRM, and messaging. Use round robin or account based routing to assign meetings by owner, territory, or segment. Push booking data to Salesforce or HubSpot, and trigger Slack alerts for high value accounts.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Standardize QBRs, renewals, and success playbooks

Create event templates for QBRs, executive briefings, onboarding, and renewal checkpoints. Attach your quarterly business review template, account plan template, and renewal playbook links so every invite includes context and materials.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate reminders and follow ups with data

Send branded emails, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders to all stakeholders. After the meeting, post notes to the CRM, schedule next steps, and kick off b2b upsell strategies when signals match your stakeholder mapping and expansion criteria.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why b2b account teams choose Cal.com

Drive predictable renewals and expansions with fewer manual tasks. Cal.com connects scheduling to your account plans, aligns internal and external stakeholders, and ensures every touchpoint happens on time with clear ownership and reporting.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder on a mobile device for a QBR with b2b stakeholders, including exec roles.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/oVa4Z5XEsL6BTKnOcEG4N0PAgA8.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Consistent QBR and renewal cadence

Lock in quarterly and mid cycle checkpoints with templates and Workflows. Automated reminders, timezone handling, and fallbacks reduce slipped QBRs and missed renewal milestones.

02

### Faster stakeholder coordination

One link collects availability and routes to the right owner. Include assistants and executives, coordinate time zones, and use multi person booking for cross functional calls with sales, success, and product.

![Image of a bookings dashboard listing QBRs, renewal reviews, and stakeholder mapping sessions for b2b accounts.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/VxsRbzWGM8CHj0BwVbDIig8sd9A.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### CRM first visibility and data hygiene

Auto create or update records in Salesforce and HubSpot. Log attendees, meeting types, notes, and outcomes. Trigger tasks for follow ups, renewals, and risk mitigation without manual data entry.

04

### Enterprise grade control and flexibility

Open source, API first architecture, SSO and SCIM support, and self hosting options. Cal.com integrates with your security controls, scales globally, and adapts to your playbooks rather than forcing workflow changes.

![Image of a branded email reminder template tailored for a b2b QBR, requesting attendance confirmation from key stakeholders.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/cA5KMV5YcUEPlnny61c9hUSOyTk.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Features built for account management teams

Everything you need to run repeatable, revenue critical meetings at scale, integrated with your systems and adaptable to your unique operating model.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Account based routing

Assign meetings by account owner, territory, segment, or value. Respect PTO and working hours, and auto reassign when owners change.

### Templates for QBRs and renewals

Standardize event types with descriptions, agenda, resources, and your quarterly business review template and renewal playbook links.

### Multi stakeholder invites and holds

Invite decision makers, champions, and procurement in one flow. Use holds and buffers to secure executive availability across time zones.

### Workflow automation across channels

Send branded email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders, internal Slack alerts, and post meeting follow ups with attachments and next steps.

### Deep CRM integration

Create and update Leads, Contacts, Accounts, and Events in Salesforce and HubSpot. Map custom fields, meeting types, and outcomes.

### Developer ready and self hostable

Use the API and webhooks to orchestrate custom logic. Self host via https://github.com/calcom/cal.com or run on Cal.com Cloud.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do Cal.com Workflows help QBR execution?

Create a QBR event type, attach your quarterly business review template, then use reminders and internal alerts to ensure exec attendance and pre read completion. View steps at https://cal.com/workflows.

Can we trigger CRM updates after a meeting ends?

Yes. Use Workflows and webhooks to post outcomes to Salesforce or HubSpot, update opportunity stages, and schedule next steps. See https://docs.cal.com.

Does Cal.com support stakeholder mapping and role based messaging?

Yes. Collect role, department, or influence via booking questions, then personalize reminders and follow ups per stakeholder group.

Can we manage renewals and expansion with templates?

Yes. Build renewal and expansion event types with your renewal playbook, account plan template, and pricing links, then automate cadence and handoffs.

Is self hosting available for regulated industries?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and supports self hosting. Review deployment options at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com and enterprise help at https://cal.com/enterprise.

How does timezone and multi person scheduling work?

Cal.com detects timezones automatically, offers pooled availability, and supports multi person booking for cross functional sessions without back and forth.

What security and compliance features are available?

SSO, SCIM, audit logs, access controls, and data residency options. Contact https://cal.com/enterprise or see https://help.cal.com for details.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com Workflows help my affiliate program scale?

Cal.com automates repetitive tasks like onboarding, campaign reminders, and status updates, freeing your team to focus on growing relationships and revenue. With easy bulk scheduling and personalized messaging, you can efficiently manage a growing network of affiliates.

Can I send campaign updates or reminders automatically?

Yes. Set up workflows to send automated campaign briefings, performance updates, or meeting reminders to your affiliates via email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

Is it possible to personalize communications for each affiliate?

Absolutely. Use dynamic templates and segmentation to tailor messages for different affiliate tiers, campaigns, or regions, ensuring relevant and on-brand communication.

Does Cal.com integrate with affiliate management software?

Cal.com offers integrations and a robust API so you can easily connect with popular affiliate platforms, CRMs, or analytics tools for a seamless experience.

How does automated scheduling reduce manual work for affiliate managers?

Workflows automatically handle meeting invites, confirmations, and reminders, eliminating the need to coordinate each interaction individually. This saves hours each week for your team.

Can I track all affiliate meetings and follow-ups in one place?

Yes. Cal.com provides a centralized dashboard where you can view all scheduled meetings, campaign touchpoints, and follow-up actions for every affiliate partner.

Is Cal.com Workflows available for self-hosted deployments?

Yes. You can use all workflow features in both our hosted and self-hosted versions. Review our documentation for setup instructions or explore more in our help center.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can agencies customize automated communications for clients?

You can fully customize confirmation, reminder, and follow-up messages. Cal.com supports branded templates and dynamic content, letting you personalize communication for each client or project.

Can we automate reminders for team and client meetings?

Yes, Cal.com Workflows send automated reminders before meetings to both your team and clients via email, SMS, or WhatsApp, reducing no-shows and missed appointments.

Does Cal.com support recurring bookings for agency clients?

Absolutely. You can automate scheduling for recurring meetings, monthly check-ins, or project milestones, ensuring everyone stays aligned.

How does Cal.com help agencies scale their scheduling operations?

By automating manual scheduling tasks, Cal.com enables your agency to handle more clients and projects efficiently, freeing up time for higher-value work.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com workflows with our existing CRM or project management tools?

Yes, Cal.com offers integrations and a robust API, allowing you to sync bookings, contacts, and reminders with your agency’s preferred tools.

Can we use Cal.com workflows if we self-host the platform?

Definitely. All workflow features are available in both hosted and self-hosted deployments, giving you full control over your scheduling infrastructure.

How quickly can agencies set up and start using workflows?

Most agencies can set up essential workflows in minutes using the visual builder. Developers can further extend automation using the API and integrations.

Streamline intakes, reminders, and follow-ups for acupuncture, naturopathy, and wellness teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow builder showing an acupuncture appointment reminder set 24 hours before the visit](https://framerusercontent.com/images/UvlBwIgWs4gj3uWBv6MDZ7RzyI.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows support alternative medicine operations

From intake to aftercare, build automated steps that match your practice. Connect forms, routing, reminders, and follow-ups into one reliable system.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Capture intake and consent securely

Use routing forms to collect holistic health intake forms, allergies, contraindications, and treatment goals before a session is confirmed. Send pre-care instructions for acupuncture, cupping, or massage automatically. Store answers within Cal.com or connect external forms through apps like Typeform or Google Sheets at https://cal.com/apps. Developers can tailor advanced logic with our API at https://cal.com/docs, so every client arrives prepared and informed.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Route bookings to the right practitioner

Direct patients to the best provider based on modality, location, language, and availability. Build naturopathic practice workflows that assign herbal consults to herbalists, acupuncture to licensed acupuncturists, and nutrition to specialists. Use pooled availability, round robin, and priority rules. Sync calendars, block rooms or equipment, and trigger webhooks to your EHR or CRM. See integrations at https://cal.com/apps and pricing at https://cal.com/pricing.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate reminders and aftercare

Reduce no-shows with email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders. Ask clients to confirm, reschedule, or complete missing forms. After sessions, share protocols, links, or intake updates for the herbal consultation process and lifestyle recommendations. Use workflows to schedule follow-ups and package sessions for wellness clinic operations. Host Cal.com or self-host for greater control. Explore help articles at https://help.cal.com.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

## Benefits for alternative medicine teams

Save time, reduce no-shows, and deliver a consistent patient experience.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile reminder notification for an upcoming acupuncture session with patient responses](https://framerusercontent.com/images/uj6m1ky94kmrbua0GkSKCOeiM.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce no-shows and late arrivals

Automated reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients on track. Send time-based prompts, confirmations, and directions. Set cutoffs to protect practitioners from last-minute bookings. Add pre-care instructions for acupuncture and cupping so patients arrive ready, improving on-time starts and outcomes.

02

### Standardize intake and documentation

Collect holistic health intake forms upfront, including contraindications and preferences. Use required fields and conditional questions to capture what matters for acupuncture, naturopathy, and massage. Store responses in Cal.com or sync to your spreadsheets or CRM. Your front desk spends less time chasing paperwork and more time helping patients.

![Bookings dashboard showing naturopathic intakes, herbal consults, and acupuncture sessions](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gzpX7ZVWsH8Hgym0U5ICSy4VYQ.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Improve practitioner utilization

Use routing and pooled availability to match demand with the right provider. Balance schedules across multiple locations, prevent double-booking, and reserve rooms or equipment. Track which services fill fastest and refine your schedule templates. This aligns clinical time with revenue and improves patient access.

04

### Integrate with your tools securely

Cal.com is open-source and API-first, with webhooks and apps for CRMs, messaging, and payments. Connect documentation tools or external forms without vendor lock-in. Run the hosted version or self-host to keep data on your infrastructure. Role-based controls and SSO support help you manage multi-practitioner teams with confidence.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can I collect holistic health intake forms before booking?

Yes. Use routing forms to collect health history, goals, and contraindications before confirming the appointment. You can store answers in Cal.com or connect Typeform, HubSpot, and Google Sheets via https://cal.com/apps. Developers can add custom logic using https://cal.com/docs.

How do reminders work for alternative medicine appointments?

Configure automated email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders. Ask clients to confirm, reschedule, or complete forms. Add pre-care and aftercare instructions tailored to acupuncture clinic management and wellness clinic operations. Timing is fully customizable.

Can I manage multiple locations and practitioners?

Yes. Use pooled availability, round robin, and location-based routing to send bookings to the right practitioner and site. Reserve rooms or resources per event type, and keep calendars in sync across your team.

Do you support custom consent or contraindication questions?

Yes. Add custom questions to booking flows and make them required when needed. For advanced layouts or file uploads, connect external form tools through Cal.com apps, then pass answers into events or your CRM via webhooks.

How does Cal.com integrate with EHR or practice management tools?

Use webhooks, REST APIs, and automation platforms like Zapier or Make to push bookings, updates, and intake data into your systems. Your team controls the data flows, and you can extend logic with serverless functions or your backend.

Is Cal.com suitable for the herbal consultation process and follow-ups?

Yes. Build templates for protocol delivery, schedule follow-up consultations, and send personalized aftercare via workflows. You can track attendance and automate reminders for medication or herb pickup consultations as needed.

What are my hosting and security options?

Choose our hosted service or self-host Cal.com for greater control. Enable SSO, set role-based access for staff, and use per-event privacy settings. Review deployment options at https://cal.com/docs and plans at https://cal.com/pricing.

# Workflows for appliance repair scheduling that customers trust

Automate bookings, reminders, and follow-ups so technicians arrive prepared and jobs get confirmed faster.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com, showing a trigger to send a reminder before an appliance repair appointment with customizable content.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fWaTkBTAvN3SkYummlP4BXHY4.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works for appliance repair teams

Set up routing, reminders, and status updates in minutes.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars and set service zones

Connect Google or Microsoft calendars, define service areas, travel buffers, and working hours. Create event types for diagnostics, washer dryer repair, installations, and warranty calls.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Build smart routing and reminders

Use routing forms to capture brand, model, and location. Auto-assign the best technician, then schedule reminders by email, SMS, or WhatsApp to reduce no shows.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Sync updates and follow-ups

Send real-time updates on technician ETA, reschedules, or parts orders. Trigger post-visit surveys and quotes, and log everything with webhooks to your CRM or FSM.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for appliance repair organizations

Make scheduling easy for your customers and efficient for your team.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com appliance repair reminder on a mobile device with attendee responses and timing.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hkOZL7e7Z2ghd8uMEqEe84qpjI4.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Fewer no shows and faster confirmations

Automated confirmations and multi-channel reminders cut missed visits and late cancellations. Customers receive clear appointment details, prep instructions, and easy reschedule links, so they confirm quickly. Technicians show up prepared with model numbers and issue notes gathered during booking. Teams save time that would be spent chasing customers and juggling calendars, and dispatch gets real-time visibility into status. This consistency helps you offer reliable same day appliance repair without chaos.

02

### Smarter routing that protects margins

Route jobs to the right technician based on skills, location, and availability. Add drive buffers and service zones to minimize windshield time. For urgent tickets, prioritize same day slots while keeping travel realistic. Use round-robin assignment for even distribution or capacity-based rules for high performers. By aligning job type and technician capabilities, first-time fix rates improve, returns drop, and customers get a faster, more professional experience.

![Image of a bookings dashboard displaying scheduled appliance repair jobs and technician assignments for today and tomorrow.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0n9AsQOTTxdS4ZSX5bmPnKuMK8.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Better customer experience, higher conversion

Offer a modern booking flow that feels like appliance repair near me, but operated by your brand. Customers can pick times, add photos, and share brand and model details. Pre-visit checklists reduce onsite surprises. Real-time updates on ETA and technician profile build trust. Clear pricing notes and optional fields for refrigerator repair cost estimates help set expectations, increasing conversions and reducing disputes. A smooth journey turns new customers into repeat clients.

04

### Workflow-driven operations for scale

Standardize your playbook with workflows for every step, across franchises and teams. Trigger reminders, internal Slack alerts, parts ordering tasks, and post-visit follow-ups automatically. Use tags to separate warranty work, installs, and repairs. Centralize data via API and webhooks to your CRM, FSM, billing, or inventory systems. Whether you run a local shop or a national network, Cal.com makes your operations predictable, auditable, and ready to scale without adding manual overhead.

![Image showing a branded appliance repair reminder template with editable subject and content.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/6OJ5HFTtzyXxg3VHpKhSo0Yxbgk.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for field service scheduling

Flexible, API-first scheduling infrastructure you can host or customize.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi-location routing and skills matching

Assign jobs by territory, travel time, technician skills, and service level to maximize first-time fix rates and reduce drive time.

### Multi-channel notifications

Send confirmations, reminders, and ETAs via email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Configure timing and content per event type and customer segment.

### Routing forms with conditional logic

Collect brand, model, photos, and issue details. Show conditional questions based on appliance type to prep technicians before arrival.

### Group and team scheduling

Coordinate dispatcher availability, technician calendars, and parts pickups. Support crew assignments for heavy installs or two-person jobs.

### Workflows and webhooks

Trigger internal alerts, update CRMs, create tickets, or start post-visit surveys. Keep every system in sync with reliable webhooks.

### Open-source and self-hosted options

Run on Cal.com Cloud or self-host for compliance. Extend with our API, customize UI, and integrate with your stack.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help with same day appliance repair?

Use priority event types, routing rules, and travel buffers to surface near-term slots. Automated reminders keep customers responsive, so urgent visits are confirmed faster.

Can customers upload photos or share model details during booking?

Yes. Use routing forms with file upload and custom fields to capture brand, model, photos, and issue notes, so technicians arrive prepared.

Does it support multi-location franchises and dispatch teams?

Yes. Create teams, locations, and service zones. Use skills matching and round-robin or rules-based assignment for balanced, efficient dispatching.

Can we estimate refrigerator repair cost during scheduling?

You can collect key details to generate estimates and send automated follow-ups with pricing ranges. Final pricing remains in your billing system.

What channels can we use for reminders and updates?

Email, SMS, and WhatsApp are supported. Configure timing per event type for confirmations, ETAs, reschedules, and post-visit surveys.

Can we self-host and integrate with our FSM or CRM?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and supports self-hosting. Use webhooks and APIs to connect to your FSM, CRM, inventory, and billing tools.

How do technicians avoid double booking with personal calendars?

Two-way calendar sync with Google and Microsoft blocks personal events, respects working hours, and prevents conflicts across all job types.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com improve our car dealership sales process?

Cal.com automates appointment scheduling, follow-ups, and reminders, ensuring every lead gets timely attention. This streamlines your auto sales workflow, reduces manual work, and helps boost conversion rates.

Can Cal.com integrate with our existing automotive CRM solutions?

Yes. Cal.com’s API-first design allows seamless integration with most automotive CRM and DMS platforms, so your lead management process remains unified.

How does automated appointment scheduling benefit our sales team?

Automated scheduling eliminates manual coordination, reduces double-booking, and makes it easy for customers to book test drives or consultations. Sales reps spend less time on admin and more time closing deals.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for dealership use?

Cal.com is open-source, supports self-hosting, and lets you control your data. Security is a top priority, and you can adapt the platform to your dealership’s compliance needs.

Can customers schedule service and sales appointments online?

Absolutely. Cal.com enables customers to self-book appointments 24/7 from your website or via links sent by your team, improving accessibility and customer satisfaction.

What types of notifications can we automate?

You can send automated email, SMS, and WhatsApp notifications for confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, and satisfaction surveys. All messaging can be branded for your dealership.

How does Cal.com support car sales lead management?

Leads captured through your website or CRM can be routed automatically to the right sales advisor. Cal.com helps track appointments, follow-ups, and customer status throughout the sales funnel.

Workflows for automobile sales

# Automate test drives and follow ups for car sales teams

Turn internet car sales leads into booked test drives, faster. Automate car sales process steps, reminders, and dealer handoffs with Cal.com workflows designed for modern auto dealerships.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Automotive workflows hero showing a scheduled test drive reminder email for a car dealership](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fwQHuLy1cUJvrDiNGiqQw8.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Streamline every step from lead to sale with automated scheduling, reminders, and routing that fit your dealership’s process and tools.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect lead sources and qualify automatically

Capture internet car sales leads from your site, chat, or CRM. Use routing rules to qualify by location, inventory, budget, or credit stage, then auto-assign to the right salesperson or store.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Create a test drive workflow that books itself

Offer real-time availability across sales reps and demo vehicles. Let buyers pick times, set location preferences, and receive instant confirmations. Include ID requirements, trade-in details, and payment options before arrival.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate follow ups that move deals forward

Send multi-channel reminders, no-show recovery messages, and post-test-drive follow ups. Trigger finance consults, manager callbacks, or trade appraisals, and keep every touchpoint tracked in your CRM without manual effort.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for automobile sales teams

Faster lead response, higher show rates, and better visibility across sales, BDC, and managers. Cal.com aligns test drive workflow, auto dealership lead management, and your dealership follow up process into one consistent system.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AMGdiGiiaoHL7HXIYpwBBdNkujw.png?width=1560&height=1116)

01

### Win speed to lead and increase show rates

Route internet car sales leads to the first available rep, store, or virtual team. Send instant confirmations and reminders by email, SMS, and WhatsApp to reduce no-shows and shorten time to first conversation. Calendar holds prevent double booking.

02

### Make test drives effortless for buyers and staff

Give shoppers a simple path from interest to booked drive. Cal.com presents real-time slots across reps and vehicles, handles reschedules, and collects key details in advance. Your team arrives prepared, appointments start on time, and buyers feel in control.

![Bookings dashboard showing scheduled test drives and dealership appointments](https://framerusercontent.com/images/GJfHTdhEEUdMhZo79i9VZd0eX1c.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Standardize car sales process steps across locations

Replace ad-hoc coordination with a repeatable workflow. From pre-qualification to manager callbacks, every step runs the same way, every time. Multi-location routing and pooled availability ensure the right person and vehicle are always matched.

04

### Increase conversions with smarter follow ups

Automate the dealership follow up process with personalized sequences tied to milestones. Trigger finance consults after a test drive, send trade-in prompts, or schedule delivery walkthroughs. Every touch is captured for coaching and forecasting.

![Template editor showing branded test drive reminder email for a dealership](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fGrom62x6pqDknzyoFbCOvK9law.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for auto dealerships

Open, API-first scheduling that slots into your CRM, inventory tools, and messaging stack. Self-host or use our cloud, keep control of data, and scale from a single rooftop to nationwide groups.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing forms and pooled availability

Qualify buyers with dynamic questions and route based on inventory, location, language, or KPI priority. Offer pooled availability across sales teams and demo vehicles to maximize booked appointments.

### Test drive workflow templates

Start with proven templates for pre-drive checks, ID requirements, and liability acknowledgments. Add reminders, directions, and parking instructions so buyers arrive ready, reducing friction at the lot.

### Multi-channel reminders and no-show recovery

Cut no-shows with timed reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. If someone misses, automatically send reschedule links and notify your BDC for quick recovery.

### Deep CRM integration and webhooks

Sync bookings, outcomes, and notes to your CRM. Trigger webhooks to update deals, create tasks, or notify managers in Slack. Keep your pipeline accurate without manual data entry.

### Self-hosting and enterprise controls

Run Cal.com on your infrastructure or use our hosted platform. SSO, SCIM, audit logs, roles, and granular permissions meet security and compliance needs for dealer groups.

### Developer-ready, open-source flexibility

Customize everything with our API and SDKs. Build custom lead forms, embed schedulers, and extend workflows to fit unique store processes without vendor lock-in.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle multi-store lead routing and availability?

Yes. Use rules to route by ZIP, inventory, language, or hours. Pool availability across reps and locations so shoppers always see bookable times, while each store retains resource control.

How do workflows support a test drive workflow with vehicle assignments?

Create event types for demo vehicles or categories. Route by trim or fuel type, hold time buffers, and attach instructions. Staff and vehicles can be pooled or reserved to prevent conflicts and double booking.

Can we integrate with our CRM for auto dealership lead management?

Yes. Use native integrations or webhooks and API to sync contacts, deals, activities, and outcomes. Automatically create tasks, update stages, and attribute bookings to marketing sources.

How do reminders improve the dealership follow up process?

Send scheduled reminders before and after appointments via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Trigger personalized follow ups for finance consults, manager callbacks, or trade appraisals, and log every touch in your CRM.

Do you support internet car sales leads from our website and chat?

Yes. Embed booking on your site, landing pages, chat, or forms. Route internet car sales leads to the right team instantly and present available time slots that match buyer preferences.

What if a buyer cancels or no-shows their appointment?

Automated workflows send reschedule links and notify your BDC. You can apply recovery sequences, adjust rep utilization, and keep your pipeline clean without manual chasing.

Is Cal.com secure and available for self-hosting?

Yes. Cal.com is open source with enterprise security features. You can self-host for data control or use our hosted option. Role-based access, SSO, and audit logging are supported.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle complex crew scheduling across multiple stages and rooms?

Yes. Use routing rules, buffers, and resource calendars to route bookings to specific rooms or stages, prevent conflicts, and respect setup and strike times.

How do we manage call sheets and last minute updates on show day?

Create workflows that send call sheets and SMS updates automatically. Changes to times or locations trigger immediate notifications to each role.

Can we attach our event AV checklist to each booking?

Yes. Add links, custom fields, or workflow steps that include your event AV checklist so crews and clients receive the right tasks before tech checks.

Does Cal.com support stage lighting rental coordination with vendors?

You can schedule vendor delivery windows, confirmations, and on site checks. Workflows notify vendors and internal teams when slots are booked or changed.

We run a live stream production company. Can we automate rehearsal and go live confirmations?

Yes. Set preflight checks, rehearsal holds, and go live confirmations with multi channel reminders and role based messaging for TD, audio, and talent.

Can we self host for enterprise compliance and control?

Yes. Cal.com offers a self hosted deployment with role based access, SSO, and audit friendly controls while keeping full API access.

Do you integrate with calendars and messaging tools we already use?

Yes. Sync with Google and Microsoft calendars, use email, SMS, or WhatsApp messaging, and connect webhooks to Slack and your project systems.

## How automated scheduling boosts background check efficiency

Simplify your employment screening process with Cal.com’s automated workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up automated candidate scheduling

Eliminate the hassle of back-and-forth emails by letting candidates self-schedule appointments for interviews, fingerprinting, or drug testing. Cal.com’s booking pages sync with your team’s real-time availability, ensuring no double-booking or missed slots.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Integrate reminders and confirmations

Automatic reminders and confirmations help candidates and employers stay on track. Cal.com can trigger notifications via email, SMS, or WhatsApp before and after appointments, reducing no-shows and keeping the background verification process moving.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Track and manage appointments at scale

Monitor all appointments in a single dashboard. With Cal.com, your team can filter, update, and export scheduled meetings, whether you’re managing a handful of checks or thousands each month.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Key benefits of Cal.com for background check companies

Why leading employment screening services use Cal.com to automate their scheduling needs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile reminder notification for a candidate’s upcoming background screening appointment.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aRQ19zS0OAjGUxuYHYqql0rOjik.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Save time with automated workflows

Reduce administrative overhead by letting Cal.com handle appointment bookings, confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups. Focus on delivering faster, more reliable background checks while minimizing manual effort.

02

### Reduce no-shows and delays

Automated notifications keep candidates and employers informed at every step, so you experience fewer no-shows and faster turnaround on pre employment screening. Timely reminders help ensure critical meetings are not missed.

![Bookings dashboard for background check companies showing scheduled employment screenings and candidate appointments.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/rXRzcRJdIsDh5zYas5yexbaQREk.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Increase transparency and compliance

Centralize communication and scheduling logs for every candidate. Cal.com helps you maintain auditable records and ensures your background verification process meets compliance standards.

04

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help background check companies automate their scheduling?

Cal.com provides automated workflows that allow background check companies to book, confirm, and remind candidates of appointments for interviews, fingerprinting, or drug testing. This reduces manual coordination and accelerates the employment screening process.

Can Cal.com integrate with our HR or ATS platform?

Yes, Cal.com offers a robust API and pre-built integrations that connect with leading HR and applicant tracking systems. This enables automated scheduling based on candidate status or other workflow triggers.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for handling sensitive data?

Cal.com supports both self-hosted and cloud deployments, giving you full control over your data. All communications and scheduling logs are securely stored, and audit trails help with compliance requirements in the background verification process.

Can we customize reminders and notifications for candidates?

Absolutely. Cal.com allows you to tailor reminders and confirmations via email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Templates can be fully customized to reflect your brand and provide clear instructions to candidates.

Does Cal.com support bulk scheduling for high-volume background checks?

Yes. Cal.com’s dashboard and API support bulk scheduling, updates, and exports. This makes it easy to manage large numbers of candidates and streamline your pre employment screening operations.

How does Cal.com help reduce no-shows and speed up background checks?

Automated, multi-channel notifications keep candidates and employers informed, reducing the risk of missed appointments. Timely reminders help ensure each step in the background verification process is completed promptly.

Is Cal.com open-source and can we self-host it?

Yes, Cal.com is open-source and offers self-hosted deployment options. This is ideal for background check companies with strict privacy or regulatory requirements. Learn more about self-hosting in our documentation.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve the employment background check process?

Cal.com automates scheduling for interviews, verifications, and follow-ups, streamlining the entire employment background check process. By reducing manual coordination and automating candidate communication, you accelerate turnaround times and deliver a better experience for candidates and clients.

Can background screening companies self-host Cal.com for compliance?

Yes, Cal.com can be self-hosted, giving background screening companies full control over data residency and security. This helps meet strict background check compliance standards and regulatory requirements for sensitive information.

How long do background checks take with automated scheduling?

Automated scheduling with Cal.com shortens the background check timeline by reducing delays from manual outreach. Candidates can book verification calls instantly, and reminders keep the process moving, helping you complete checks faster.

Does Cal.com support pre employment screening services that require multiple steps?

Absolutely. Cal.com workflows let you automate scheduling and communication for multi-step background checks. Each stage, from document collection to final interviews, can trigger reminders and updates automatically.

What integrations are available for background check automation?

Cal.com’s API-first architecture enables seamless integration with HR systems, applicant tracking software, and popular background screening platforms. This centralizes scheduling and ensures your process is fully connected.

Can we customize candidate reminders and notifications?

Yes. You can personalize all candidate communication, including emails, SMS, and WhatsApp messages, to match your company’s brand and workflow requirements. Custom templates ensure a consistent and professional candidate experience.

How does Cal.com help with background check compliance and reporting?

Cal.com logs every scheduling action, reminder, and candidate interaction, creating a comprehensive audit trail. This supports your compliance obligations and makes it easy to generate reports for regulators or clients.

Workflows for bookkeeping services

# Automate client scheduling for bookkeeping and monthly close workflows

Reduce no-shows, collect documents on time, and keep recurring finance meetings on schedule with Cal.com Workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for bookkeeping, showing a pre-close reminder email requesting bank statements and receipts before a monthly review.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fyurgj8mk76F12J7ktSeUqjEhI.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Set up smart, reliable workflows for every client touchpoint, from discovery to monthly close.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create your booking flows

Build intake and recurring event types for consultations, onboarding, monthly close reviews, and quarterly tax check-ins. Add buffers, round-robin routing, and time zone handling for distributed clients.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Collect required documents automatically

Trigger reminders to request bank statements, receipts, and payroll exports before meetings. Use email, SMS, or WhatsApp to nudge clients until everything needed for reconciliation is received.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate reminders and follow-ups

Send confirmations, pre-meeting reminders, and post-meeting follow-ups with links to next steps or payment. Reduce back-and-forth and keep every bookkeeping cycle moving on time.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for bookkeeping teams and their clients

Streamline scheduling, reduce administrative work, and deliver a professional experience across every engagement, from first call to monthly close and year-end.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a bookkeeping review on a mobile device, prompting the client to prepare statements and receipts.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/9DKWx1gG1dH7vUbxXpGOx0.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut scheduling admin by automating the routine

Automate confirmations, reminders, reschedules, and document collection so your team spends less time emailing and more time delivering accurate books. Clients see a clear, reliable process for every engagement.

02

### Reduce no-shows across recurring reviews

Pre-meeting reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients accountable for monthly and quarterly finance reviews. You get predictable attendance, timely approvals, and fewer last-minute changes that disrupt the close.

![Image of a bookings dashboard listing bookkeeping meetings such as onboarding, monthly close, and tax prep with client names and times.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/qzHGTiWYtWgCiLSrRG55UvPvClg.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Collect documents on time, every time

Request bank statements, card exports, payroll, and receipts with timed nudges. Use conditional workflows to escalate reminders, notify account managers, or pause meetings until required documents are received.

04

### Deliver a premium client experience at scale

Provide a consistent, branded journey for small business bookkeeping clients. Offer self-serve booking, clear reminders, and follow-ups that link to invoice payment, secure upload portals, or recurring engagement checklists.

![Image of a branded email template for bookkeeping reminders asking clients to upload statements before the meeting.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/txWvgyArLlVjULsOquppGlT1TU.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features tailored to bookkeeping operations

Open-source, API-first scheduling infrastructure that fits your practice, your stack, and your compliance needs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Recurring workflows for monthly close

Automate pre-close document requests, reminders, and post-close follow-ups tied to recurring events for each client, so your cycle stays consistent.

### Multi-channel notifications

Send branded updates via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Configure timing, frequency, and recipients to match your engagement model and client preferences.

### Intake forms and routing

Qualify prospects, route leads to the right QuickBooks bookkeeper or team, and capture accounting needs, entity type, and software usage before the first call.

### Calendar, CRM, and inbox integrations

Connect Google, Microsoft, Slack, and more. Push notes to your CRM, notify channels, and keep your bookkeeping pipeline in sync without manual effort.

### Self-hosting and granular control

Choose hosted or self-hosted deployments. Meet security and compliance needs while retaining full control over data and workflows.

### Developer-ready API

Extend workflows with webhooks, custom logic, and integrations to your ledger tools and document portals. Build exactly what your practice needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle recurring client meetings like monthly close reviews?

Yes. Create recurring event types and pair them with workflows that request documents, send reminders, and schedule follow-ups so every monthly close stays on track.

How do reminders help virtual bookkeeper teams reduce no-shows?

Set timed reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Include prep checklists and upload links so clients arrive ready. Consistent nudges improve attendance and shorten meetings.

Can I route new leads to the right bookkeeper automatically?

Yes. Use routing rules and intake forms to direct prospects by industry, entity size, or tools used. Round-robin across a team or assign to a specialist for faster time to value.

Does Cal.com work with QuickBooks-focused practices?

Absolutely. Many firms offering small business bookkeeping use Cal.com to coordinate recurring reviews for QuickBooks clients and to route calls to the correct QuickBooks bookkeeper.

Is this suitable for outsourced bookkeeping providers?

Yes. Outsourced bookkeeping teams use workflows to manage global time zones, automate pre-meeting requests, and keep communication consistent across many client accounts.

Can I self-host for compliance needs and control data?

Yes. Cal.com supports self-hosting so you control data residency and access. You keep flexibility while maintaining the same powerful scheduling and workflow features.

Do you offer an API to customize workflows?

Yes. Developers can create, update, and manage workflows via API and webhooks, integrate with ledgers or document portals, and adapt scheduling to firm-specific processes.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help streamline our brand strategy process?

Cal.com automates scheduling for client meetings, workshops, and feedback reviews, saving your team time and ensuring every step of your brand strategy process runs smoothly.

Can we customize communications to match our agency’s brand identity?

Yes, all messages and reminders can be fully branded, ensuring consistency with your agency’s brand guidelines and tone.

Does Cal.com support brand positioning workshops with multiple attendees?

Absolutely. You can automate scheduling and reminders for group sessions, making it easy to organize brand positioning workshops with clients or teams.

How does Cal.com handle client updates during brand identity development?

Cal.com workflows let you set automated notifications for project milestones, feedback requests, and delivery updates, keeping clients informed at every stage.

Is Cal.com secure enough for client-facing branding agency services?

Yes. Cal.com offers secure scheduling, privacy controls, and the option to self-host, so your client data and brand projects stay protected.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our creative tools and project management software?

Cal.com features a powerful API and native integrations, so you can connect your workflow with design, feedback, or CRM tools your agency already uses.

How quickly can we get started with automated workflows?

Most branding agencies set up Cal.com workflows in minutes using the visual builder. For custom needs, developers can use the API for advanced automation.

# Automate client scheduling and follow ups for business consultants

Move from discovery to delivery with automated booking, reminders, and next steps for every client.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows support consulting from first call to close

Standardize intake, automate handoffs, and keep clients engaged across discovery, proposal, delivery, and review. Cal.com connects calendars, messages, and your tools so every step is on time and on brand.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Streamline discovery and qualification

Publish a single booking link or embed it on your site to route prospects to the right consultant. Use Routing Forms to collect project scope, budget, and timeline, then auto schedule the appropriate discovery format, from a 30 minute call to a half day workshop. Attach your discovery workshop agenda in the confirmation, and automatically invite additional stakeholders when needed. Workflows can branch on answers to perform stakeholder mapping, assign ownership, and notify your team in Slack. Learn more about workflows at https://cal.com/docs/workflows and see routing in action at https://cal.com/blog/routing-forms.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate proposals and next steps

After discovery, trigger a follow up recap that includes your consulting proposal template, clear next steps, and a link to book the proposal review. Cal.com Workflows can send email or SMS, create CRM tasks via webhook, and notify channels your team already uses. Developers can call internal services with our API at https://cal.com/docs/api to generate documents, start approvals, or update deal stages while your client selects times that work.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Deliver, review, and iterate

Once the proposal is signed, workflows schedule kickoffs, standups, and recurring status reviews. Send preparation prompts that reference process improvement frameworks, share KPI dashboard examples ahead of the meeting, and follow up with action items afterward. If your engagement includes organizational change, include links to your change management plan template in reminders so every stakeholder knows what is coming next. Automatic reschedules, time zone support, and no code messaging templates keep delivery smooth. Explore how to customize communications in the Help Center at https://help.cal.com/en/.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why consultants choose Cal.com workflows

Replace manual back and forth with programmable scheduling that respects client preferences and your business rules.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a consulting session on a mobile device.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QOojQBFAokI3PFEDMW0dpDft9k.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### More billable hours, less coordination

Stop chasing confirmations and reschedules. Cal.com handles booking links, confirmations, reminders, and follow ups so your team spends more time with clients and less time on logistics. Multi time zone support reduces friction when executives travel, while automated nudges reduce no shows for workshops, reviews, and training sessions. All activity is logged so your team can track what happened and when.

02

### Faster sales cycles and approvals

Move deals forward with automated next steps. Send a tailored recap with your consulting proposal template, route the review to the right decision maker, and book the follow up without leaving your CRM. Workflows keep momentum with timely reminders and clear choices, which shortens idle time between discovery, proposal, and kick off. Your team stays aligned because Slack notifications and CRM updates happen as soon as clients book or make changes.

![Image of a bookings dashboard listing consulting meetings and workshops for today and this week.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/wgy56V1X4KBehY3eaKmcCiysj4.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Consistent, branded client experience

Every touchpoint feels professional. Customize confirmations and reminders with your logo, tone, and reusable snippets, then include essential materials like your discovery workshop agenda, stakeholder mapping canvas, or change management plan template. Clients receive clear, branded communication on email, SMS, or WhatsApp, and get the same high quality experience across one on one, group, and recurring meetings. See setup tips at https://help.cal.com/en/.

04

### Flexible, secure deployment options

Adopt Cal.com on your terms. Choose our hosted cloud for speed or self host for full control. As an open source platform, Cal.com lets your engineers review and extend the code at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com. Use role based ownership of event types, manage access centrally, and rely on API logs for traceability. Enterprise services are available at https://cal.com/enterprise.
