## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can I route prospects based on project type and stakeholder role?

Yes. Use Routing Forms to capture answers, then build conditional workflows that assign the right consultant, invite stakeholders, and schedule the correct discovery format. Details at https://cal.com/blog/routing-forms.

How do I include my consulting proposal template in follow ups?

Add a link to your proposal file or eSignature app in workflow emails or SMS. You can also call your proposal system via webhook so the review meeting is booked while the document is sent.

Can I standardize a discovery workshop agenda across my team?

Yes. Save event templates with a shared description, files, and agenda links. Workflows send confirmations and reminders that include your agenda for every attendee automatically.

How does Cal.com handle recurring status reviews and KPI check ins?

Create recurring event types for weekly or monthly reviews. Use workflows to send preparation prompts and links to KPI dashboard examples so clients arrive ready to discuss outcomes.

Is self hosting available for clients with strict data requirements?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and can be self hosted. Enterprises can control data residency and integrate SSO. Learn more at https://cal.com/enterprise and https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.

Can workflows update our CRM or task system?

Yes. Send webhooks on booking, reschedule, or cancel events. Trigger Zapier and notify Slack so your CRM, project board, and team stay in sync. See https://cal.com/docs/api.

How do we support change management across stakeholders?

Use workflows to time communications with your change management plan template. Send pre read materials, assign sessions by role, and follow up with next steps and owners after each meeting.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com keep executive schedules secure?

Cal.com supports role-based access controls, self-hosting, and encrypted notifications to protect c-suite meetings and sensitive information.

Can executive assistants manage workflows for multiple leaders?

Yes. Cal.com enables assistants to configure and oversee workflows, coordinate across calendars, and manage approvals for multiple executives.

How does Cal.com handle last-minute changes or reschedules?

Automated workflows instantly update all participants, send reminders, and manage follow-ups so last-minute changes are seamless and clear.

Can we customize notifications for different executive roles?

Absolutely. Cal.com allows full customization of notifications by role, event type, or recipient—ensuring relevant, on-brand communication.

Does Cal.com integrate with our enterprise tools?

Cal.com’s API-first platform connects with CRMs, communication platforms, and identity management tools. Explore our integrations for more details.

Is Cal.com compliant with enterprise security and privacy standards?

Yes. Cal.com offers self-hosting, data residency options, and advanced security controls to meet strict compliance and privacy requirements.

How quickly can we deploy Cal.com for our executive team?

Most organizations can set up and launch Cal.com workflows for c-suite leaders in hours, with robust documentation and enterprise onboarding support.

# Streamline campus recruiting with automated scheduling workflows

Simplify interviews, job fairs, and university recruiting by automating scheduling for campus hiring teams

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Automated campus recruiting workflow in Cal.com showing a scheduled reminder email for a university job fair with customizable event details and confirmation options.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/VSYitLOEzkJbDTN8onma0oi1Fc.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows simplify campus recruiting

Automate every step of the university recruiting process, from interview scheduling to event reminders.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up automated interview scheduling

Use Cal.com to create booking links for each recruiter, allowing candidates to pick available slots with ease. No more back-and-forth emails or scheduling conflicts—just a streamlined interview experience.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate job fair and event management

Organize and manage college job fairs or university recruiting sessions by sending automated reminders to students and recruiters. Track RSVPs and attendance effortlessly from one dashboard.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Centralize communication for internship placements

Coordinate college recruiter programs by automatically sending updates, confirmations, and follow-ups to candidates and hiring managers. Keep everyone informed and on track throughout the hiring journey.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Key benefits of automating campus recruiting workflows

Deliver a modern, efficient, and transparent experience for candidates and recruiting teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile notification for a campus recruiting interview reminder with candidate and recruiter profiles displayed.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/EWr8yAINv7Jy4hatRfKi3BERayE.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce scheduling friction for students and recruiters

Eliminate email ping-pong and manual work by letting candidates book, reschedule, or cancel interviews themselves. Save recruiters hours every week during busy campus recruitment seasons.

02

### Boost engagement at college job fairs and events

Automated reminders and personalized communications increase attendance and reduce no-shows for college job fairs, info sessions, and interviews. Make sure every candidate and recruiter shows up prepared.

![Bookings dashboard showing scheduled campus recruiting events, interviews, and job fair appointments for students and recruiters.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/RVLBjMByPtbfKmr5rl8WSrVvs.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Enhance transparency and tracking across the university recruiting process

Monitor the entire campus recruitment pipeline in real time. See who has booked, confirmed, or missed their slots and get actionable insights to improve your campus recruitment strategies.

04

### Scale your internship campus placements with ease

Handle high-volume internship and entry-level hiring without bottlenecks. Cal.com's automation ensures every step is tracked, compliant, and easy to manage for large university programs.

![Branded email template for a campus recruiting event reminder, personalized for students and recruiters.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/f01PQZw3aV6RTzYEC7cBPLBI.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Powerful features built for campus recruiting

Flexible, secure, and easy-to-use tools for every part of your campus hiring journey.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Open source and API-first flexibility

Customize every touchpoint of your college recruiter programs, from branding to notifications. Integrate with your HRIS or ATS for a seamless workflow.

### Self-hosting for privacy and compliance

Deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure to ensure data privacy and meet university or company compliance standards.

### Multi-channel reminders and notifications

Send automated reminders via email, SMS, or WhatsApp to candidates and recruiters, ensuring high engagement and attendance at every event.

### Group scheduling for job fairs and panel interviews

Easily manage group sessions, panel interviews, or info sessions. Cal.com supports both one-on-one and multi-attendee events to fit every campus recruiting scenario.

### Advanced analytics and reporting

Track candidate engagement, attendance, and conversion metrics to refine your campus recruitment strategies year after year.

### Easy admin dashboard and booking links

Manage all your recruiting events, bookings, and communications from a single dashboard. Share custom booking links with candidates, professors, or career centers.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com improve campus recruitment strategies for hiring teams?

Cal.com automates the entire scheduling process for campus recruiting, eliminating manual coordination, reducing errors, and saving significant time during university recruiting drives, college job fairs, and internship campus placements.

Can we use Cal.com to manage multiple college recruiter programs at the same time?

Yes. Cal.com lets you create and manage multiple recruiting programs, booking pages, and workflows for different universities, locations, and departments, all from one platform.

Does Cal.com support self-hosting for privacy compliance with university partners?

Absolutely. You can deploy Cal.com on your own servers, ensuring that candidate and recruiter data remains private and compliant with institutional policies.

How does Cal.com help increase attendance at college job fairs and recruiting events?

Automated reminders and confirmations sent via email, SMS, or WhatsApp keep students and recruiters informed, reducing no-shows and maximizing event participation.

Can recruiters customize communications for different university recruiting processes?

Yes. Cal.com allows full customization of messages, branding, and booking experiences to match each university or program’s unique requirements.

Is it possible to integrate Cal.com with our current HR tools or ATS?

Cal.com’s API-first architecture makes it easy to connect with popular HRIS, ATS, and campus management systems, creating a seamless workflow from booking to onboarding.

What analytics does Cal.com provide for campus recruiting teams?

Recruiters can access real-time analytics on bookings, attendance, and conversion rates, helping them optimize their campus recruitment strategies and report on program ROI.

How does Cal.com help with CEO calendar management?

Automates scheduling, reduces manual work, and keeps the CEO focused on priorities.

Can CFOs use Cal.com for sensitive meeting scheduling?

Yes, with secure self-hosting and access controls.

What integrations are available for executive tools?

Connect with Google, Outlook, Slack, and more.

Can assistants manage executive appointments?

Yes, delegated access enables assistants to coordinate schedules.

Automates bookings, reminders, and reduces scheduling conflicts.

Is executive data secure on Cal.com?

Self-hosting and strict permissions keep your information private.

Yes, flexible APIs and workflows let you tailor scheduling to COO needs.

Workflows for chiropractors

# Automate chiropractic scheduling, reminders, and patient follow-ups

Use Cal.com Workflows to simplify bookings, reduce no-shows, and keep patients engaged with automated reminders, intake, and post-visit touchpoints tailored for chiropractic practices.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow builder showing a 24 hour pre-visit email reminder for a chiropractic appointment with confirmation request and visit details.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/p0xEacHrIguJq6LFbtDZTQ9mcU.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How chiropractic scheduling automation works

Streamline bookings and keep patient communications consistent by automating intake, reminders, and follow-ups across your entire practice.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your calendars and event types

Sync Google, Microsoft, iCloud, or CalDAV so availability is always accurate. Create visit types for new patient exams, adjustments, re-exams, telehealth, and report of findings. Map custom fields to capture chiropractic patient intake forms and lock buffers between visits. Learn more at cal.com/features/workflows and cal.com/integrations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Add automations for intake, reminders, and follow-ups

Build workflows that trigger on booking, reschedule, or a time before an appointment. Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders, share digital chiropractic patient intake forms, and deliver prep instructions. After the visit, send satisfaction checks, exercise videos, or a link that helps your team complete soap notes chiropractic faster.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize care plans and track outcomes

Use tags and routing logic to place patients into the right treatment plan chiropractic sequence. Automate re-exam reminders and create a patient reactivation campaign after missed care. Track attendance and responses, then pipe data to your EHR, Slack, or CRM via webhooks or our API at cal.com/docs.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for modern chiropractic practices

Turn your scheduling into a patient experience engine that protects provider time and keeps care plans on track.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile SMS reminder for a chiropractic adjustment showing patient responses and status indicators.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/qRee4x0U2FI927BZqdujh0H7uY4.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Fewer no-shows and gaps in the schedule

Automated confirmations, multi-channel reminders, and waitlist notifications keep your book full. Patients receive the right message at the right time, in their preferred channel.

02

### Faster intake and better documentation

Send digital chiropractic patient intake forms automatically the moment a visit is booked. Pre-fill details, reduce front-desk phone time, and guide your team to complete soap notes chiropractic right after each visit.

![Bookings dashboard for chiropractic visits including new patient exams, adjustments, and re-exams.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fcvRMxgwlEe2SVY8OjtxfuHE.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Higher treatment plan adherence

Create step-by-step reminders for report of findings, re-exams, exercises, and follow-ups. Nudge patients to stay on their treatment plan chiropractic and close care loops with clear next steps.

04

### Grow referrals and reactivations

Trigger post-visit requests to join your chiropractic referral program and launch a patient reactivation campaign for patients who miss appointments or have aging care plans.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle chiropractic patient intake forms?

Yes. Add custom fields to event types, send secure intake links automatically on booking, and sync responses to your EHR or CRM via webhooks or the API.

Does Cal.com support SOAP note workflows for chiropractors?

Yes. Trigger reminders for clinicians to complete soap notes chiropractic after each visit, or send a summary link to your internal tools to speed documentation.

How do we automate treatment plan reminders and re-exams?

Create a workflow sequence that schedules future visits, sends nudges for re-exams, and delivers at-home exercises. Use tags to place patients into a treatment plan chiropractic path.

Can we run a patient reactivation campaign for inactive patients?

Yes. Build time-based workflows that message patients who have not visited recently. Offer easy booking links and measure response rates.

Can Cal.com help with a chiropractic referral program?

Yes. After successful visits, trigger referral requests with trackable links. Route advocates to a unique page and attribute referred bookings.

Is Cal.com HIPAA compliant?

Cal.com offers open-source and self-hosting so you can control data, infrastructure, and vendor choices. Many teams integrate with HIPAA-compliant systems. Assess your compliance needs with your counsel.

Does Cal.com integrate with our existing EHR or billing?

Use webhooks and the API to connect to your EHR, billing, Slack, or CRM. See cal.com/docs for examples and cal.com/integrations for ready-made connectors.

## How it works

Set up campus workflows once, then let Cal.com run the process

01

### Connect calendars and define event types

Sync team calendars, create event types for info sessions, coffee chats, and interviews, set capacity and buffers, and map recruitment stages to automate movement from registration to interview.

### Track, measure, and optimize

## Benefits for university recruiting teams

Turn fragmented campus activity into a reliable, student friendly hiring engine

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a student about a campus interview, with attendee response status](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3gZp5S6hUnF67wAf477SsKlzMpg.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Higher show rates at university events

Send targeted reminders that fit student schedules and reduce friction before university recruiting events. Nudge registrants to confirm, share venue details and virtual links, and handle waitlists automatically. Cal.com workflows adapt to different campuses, time zones, and formats, so invites and updates always arrive at the right moment. Clear confirmations, calendar holds, and day of reminders improve attendance, lower no-shows, and keep sessions full. Your team gets predictable turnout and better data to plan the next event.

02

### Shorter time to schedule interviews

Eliminate back and forth by letting students pick times that match recruiter and interviewer availability. Round robin rules fill calendars without conflicts, while buffers protect transition time. Candidates move from event check-in to interview signups in minutes, accelerating the college hiring process. Coordinators save hours per week, interviewers avoid double booking, and hiring managers see faster funnel movement from screen to offer. Speed matters when competing for top students, and automation ensures no strong candidate waits for next steps.

![Image of a bookings dashboard showing campus info sessions, interviews, and student meetings organized by day](https://framerusercontent.com/images/W70cUUabWyickrdYnGmKfvakA.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Better candidate experience across campuses

Give students a consistent, branded scheduling experience whether they meet you at a career fair, attend an info session, or book a final interview. Cal.com simplifies the journey with clear confirmations, reschedule options, and timezone aware reminders. Personalized messaging explains next steps and required materials, improving preparedness and satisfaction. By reducing friction, you strengthen your reputation on campus, grow referrals, and build an early talent pipeline that returns every recruiting season. Students feel respected and informed throughout the process.

04

### Proven efficiency for lean teams

Automate repetitive tasks like reminders, interviewer notifications, and post event follow-ups so your team can focus on quality conversations. Use routing rules to prioritize target majors and graduation years, then sync outcomes to your ATS for clean reporting. Cal.com’s open source, API first platform supports self hosting for strict security, and integrates with tools you already use. You get a scalable campus recruiting strategy that works for accelerators, co ops, and full time hiring. Refine your intern recruiting plan with data, not manual spreadsheets.

![Template for branded campus communication in Cal.com, customizing reminder subject for a university recruiting session](https://framerusercontent.com/images/f0U9l2qBHRXwZlWZK4nON1OMF4.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Features built for campus hiring

Everything you need to coordinate events, interviews, panels, and offers

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing forms and rules

Collect major, GPA, graduation year, and interests, then route students to the best event or interviewer. Apply qualification logic, segment by campus, and auto balance calendars to protect service levels.

### Multi channel messaging

Send email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders with brand aligned templates. Configure timing, quiet hours, and escalation messages for no response scenarios. Include materials, maps, virtual links, and prep guidance.

### Group and round robin events

Host large info sessions and office hours with capacity limits and waitlists. Use round robin to distribute one on ones across interviewers while honoring time windows, buffers, and location preferences.

### ATS and HRIS integrations

Sync bookings, outcomes, and tags to systems like Greenhouse and Lever through native integrations, webhooks, or API. Keep candidate stages current, reduce duplicate data, and trigger next step workflows.

### Self hosting and SSO

Deploy on your infrastructure with self hosting, or use our hosted cloud. Enterprise controls include SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, role based access, and detailed audit logs.

### Analytics and capacity planning

View attendance, no show rates, interviewer load, and campus trends. Forecast demand, adjust capacity, and measure conversion from event to interview to offer for each university or program.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can we route students by major, GPA, or graduation year?

Yes. Use routing forms to capture fields like major, GPA range, graduation year, and interests, then auto direct students to the right event or interviewer based on your rules.

How do group info sessions and office hours work?

Create group events with capacity, waitlists, and time slots. Students book instantly, receive reminders, and can reschedule. Hosts see attendees in one view and can send targeted updates.

Will Cal.com integrate with our ATS for status updates?

Yes. Connect via native integrations, webhooks, or API to sync bookings, notes, and outcomes to your ATS. Update stages automatically when interviews are scheduled or completed.

Can we run simultaneous events across multiple campuses?

Absolutely. Spin up campus specific pages and event types, assign local recruiters, and use round robin pools. Workflows handle reminders and updates per campus, all managed centrally.

How do you prevent double booking and interview conflicts?

Cal.com respects connected calendars, timezones, buffers, and working hours. Round robin pools balance load, and holds are placed instantly to prevent conflicts across overlapping events.

Is self hosting available for our security requirements?

Yes. Cal.com supports self hosting with an open source core. Enterprises can enable SAML SSO, SCIM, and audit logs, and control data residency while retaining API first flexibility.

How do we measure impact on our early talent pipeline?

Use analytics to track attendance, conversions, interviewer capacity, and time to schedule. Compare campuses and events, and export metrics to your BI tool or ATS for pipeline reporting.

Workflows for conference centers

# Automate scheduling and communications for busy conference centers and venues

Reduce no-shows, coordinate staff, and scale bookings with workflow automation built for meeting rooms and events.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow builder showing conference center reminder setup with 24 hour email confirmation before event](https://framerusercontent.com/images/zgldByGMR0GtaobHAJUKzx1Vi4w.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Build reliable, scalable scheduling workflows for rooms, staff, and vendors

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your calendars and rooms

Sync venue calendars, room resources, and staff availability. Map meeting room rental inventory to event types, set buffer times, and avoid double booking across corporate meeting space and hotel conference rooms.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Define triggers and actions

Choose triggers like booking created, rescheduled, or capacity reached. Automate actions such as email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders, internal Slack alerts, and vendor notifications for catering, AV, and security teams.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize guest and vendor communications

Brand confirmations and updates, collect attendee details, send badges or access info, and tailor training room rental instructions by room, capacity, and layout to boost attendance and on-time arrivals.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for conference centers

Increase utilization, reduce no-shows, and deliver a consistent experience for clients and attendees

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AMGdiGiiaoHL7HXIYpwBBdNkujw.png?width=1560&height=1116)

01

### Maximize room utilization and revenue

Every idle hour costs money. Cal.com helps you fill gaps with accurate availability, pooled resources, and smart routing. Route inquiries to the right corporate meeting space or training room rental, ensure holds expire on time, and automate reminders so prospects convert. With real-time availability for hotel conference rooms and on-site spaces, staff can quickly reassign rooms or extend events without conflicts. Self-hosting and open-source flexibility let IT integrate existing CRMs and PMS systems to capture upsell opportunities while keeping control of data and workflows.

02

### Reduce no-shows with proactive communication

Missed arrivals hurt schedules and budgets. Automate multi-channel reminders that confirm headcounts, share parking and access details, and send day-of directions. Cal.com workflows support email, SMS, and WhatsApp to reach attendees where they are. For conference centers near me searches that drive last-minute bookings, confirmations go out instantly, with optional pre-event check-ins. If plans change, rescheduling is smooth, and staff receives alerts to reset seating or AV, minimizing waste while protecting the guest experience.

![Bookings dashboard for conference center rooms showing today and tomorrow events](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aQZ5vvrDrAPTmg7mbyqdozuaHaY.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Streamline vendor coordination and compliance

Large events depend on AV, catering, and facilities. Cal.com routes bookings to the right teams, triggers internal notifications at set thresholds, and attaches requirements like stage setup or dietary needs. Role-based messages keep vendors informed without overloading guests. For regulated industries, store audit trails and consent logs, and leverage our API-first architecture to connect visitor management tools. When multiple events overlap, workflows sequence load-in, security, and cleanup, keeping corridors clear and timelines on track.

04

### Deliver a branded, premium guest experience

From first inquiry to post-event follow-up, communication shapes perception. Customize confirmations, floor plans, and signage instructions by room type and brand. For meeting room rental clients, embed room photos, capacity charts, and add-ons in messages. Corporate meeting space guests can receive calendar holds, badge QR codes, and Wi-Fi details automatically. After the event, send surveys and invoices, or trigger sales workflows for repeat bookings. Cal.com ensures every interaction feels consistent, helpful, and on-brand.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/EgtNzQuE00PvJhX28LT3Afn1syU.png?width=1040&height=730)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for modern venues

Open, API-first scheduling infrastructure that adapts to your venue’s tech stack

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Resource and room pooling

Group rooms by capacity, layout, or building. Automatically route bookings to the best-fit space, prevent double booking, and respect buffers for setup and teardown.

### Multi-channel reminders and updates

Send email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders to attendees, organizers, and vendors. Time messages to confirmations, check-ins, and post-event follow-ups to reduce no-shows.

### Conditional workflows and approvals

Require approvals for large events, alcohol service, or VIP access. Trigger internal reviews when headcount or budget thresholds are reached.

### Calendar and PMS integrations

Connect Google, Microsoft, and enterprise calendars, plus property and event systems. Keep availability in sync for hotel conference rooms and on-site resources.

### Self-hosting and enterprise security

Run Cal.com in your own cloud for data control. SSO, SCIM, role-based access, audit logs, and granular permissions support enterprise compliance needs.

### Developer ready API and webhooks

Use our API to create bookings, manage resources, and trigger webhooks to AV, signage, and billing systems. Extend logic with custom fields and forms.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com prevent double booking across rooms and staff?

Cal.com maps resources to event types and pools rooms by rules like capacity and layout. Availability is checked in real time across calendars and buffers, preventing conflicts for rooms and assigned staff.

Can we automate vendor notifications for AV and catering?

Yes. Use workflows to trigger emails, SMS, or Slack messages to vendors based on booking type, headcount, or timing. Include setup notes, diagrams, and access instructions automatically.

Does Cal.com support approvals for large or high-risk events?

Yes. Configure conditional approvals. When thresholds like attendee count or alcohol service are met, the booking routes to managers for review before confirmation is sent.

How do reminders help reduce no-shows for conference centers?

You can schedule branded email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders with access, parking, and arrival instructions. Send confirmations, day-before details, and day-of prompts to keep guests on time.

Can we manage training room rental with different layouts?

Yes. Create event types for classroom, theater, or boardroom layouts. Attach setup buffers, capacity limits, and custom instructions so staff and guests see the right details automatically.

Is Cal.com available for self-hosting with enterprise security?

Yes. Cal.com offers self-hosting with SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and role-based access. Enterprises gain data control while keeping the same workflow capabilities and APIs.

How do we integrate with our CRM or property systems?

Cal.com is API-first. Use webhooks and SDKs to sync contacts, opportunities, and bookings with your CRM or PMS. Push updates bi-directionally to keep sales and operations aligned.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help content marketing teams?

Cal.com automates and streamlines scheduling for content marketing teams, helping you manage tasks, deadlines, and collaboration easily.

Can I connect Cal.com to my content calendar tools?

Yes, Cal.com integrates with leading content calendar tools so your schedules stay in sync.

Is Cal.com suitable for blog management process automation?

Absolutely. Use Cal.com to automate meetings, approvals, and reminders for your blog management process.

How customizable are Cal.com workflows for content creation workflow?

You can fully customize triggers, actions, and notifications to fit your content creation workflow.

Can multiple team members collaborate on scheduling?

Yes, Cal.com supports collaborative scheduling and shared workflows for teams.

Does Cal.com offer analytics for content marketing strategy?

Cal.com provides robust analytics to help you track and optimize your content marketing strategy.

Can I self-host Cal.com for my marketing team?

Yes, Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted for full control and flexibility.

# Workflows for continuing education and adult learning teams

Automate enrollments, reminders, and cohorts while integrating LMS and payment tools with Cal.com

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows support continuing education

Set up automated messages, tasks, and integrations that match how your programs run, from enrollment to final assessment.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars, LMS, and payment tools

Connect staff calendars and teaching tools in minutes. Cal.com syncs with Google Calendar, Outlook, and Apple Calendar, and integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams for virtual delivery. Use the Apps Marketplace to link Stripe for paid sessions and donations. Connect your LMS or SIS using webhooks, Zapier, Make, or the Cal.com API. This foundation powers adult learning programs across admissions, advising, classes, and exams. Learn more at https://cal.com/apps, explore workflows at https://cal.com/workflows, and review the API at https://cal.com/docs/api.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Design the learner journey with triggers and actions

Create rules that reflect how you operate. Choose triggers like booking created, rescheduled, or canceled, or time based triggers such as 48 hours before class. Pair triggers with actions such as email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders, Slack notifications for instructors, CRM updates, and LMS task creation via webhooks. Personalize content by event type, cohort, or learner segment. This helps you guide continuing education courses online, workforce development training, and professional certification programs from orientation through graduation.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Measure, iterate, and scale

Monitor attendance, reschedules, and cancellations to identify improvement opportunities. Refine timing and message templates to reduce no shows and drop offs. Reuse workflow templates for new cohorts, franchises, or campuses to scale consistently. Manage workflows in code with the API, or use the no code builder for quick changes. If data residency or stricter controls are required, deploy Cal.com self hosted and keep student data under your control. See options at https://cal.com/self-hosting and enterprise capabilities at https://cal.com/enterprise.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for continuing education and adult learning

Deliver a consistent, student centered experience while reducing manual admin across programs, cohorts, and partners.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com class reminder notification on a mobile device for a continuing education learner, with attendee responses visible.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QuORULo1wvRIIPYP0dPIheBEUZE.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce no-shows and drop-offs

Automated reminders by email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep learners on track. Cal.com respects each learner’s time zone and preferred language, so reminders and updates feel personal. Use pre class checklists, day of reminders, and post session follow ups to improve attendance for continuing education courses online and in person. Institutions report smoother cohorts when reminders include join links, parking details, and materials, all sent at the right moment.

02

### Automate enrollments and compliance

Replace manual back and forth with reliable automation. Send confirmations with payment receipts, join links, and policies after registration. Trigger reminders for prerequisites, ID verification, or proctoring instructions for exams. After completion, send follow ups with next steps to claim certificates in your LMS or to enroll in the next module. Professional certification programs benefit from consistent, audit friendly messaging and timestamped activity logs.

![Image of a bookings dashboard displaying scheduled classes and sessions for continuing education with dates, times, titles, and participant avatars.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/RFYf5zTmra4mDhMAxyJ0QKSvGmE.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Scale cohorts and instructors

Grow without adding admin hours. Pool instructor availability, route learners to the right advisor, and manage group events for classes, office hours, or labs. Round robin booking and collective scheduling let multiple instructors share a workload fairly. For workforce development training, use routing forms to place learners into the correct track or skill level, then auto assign sessions based on capacity and location.

04

### Stay flexible and secure

Cal.com is open source and API first, which means you can extend, integrate, and self host when needed. Choose hosted or self hosted to align with institutional requirements and data residency. Single sign on and granular access controls support larger teams. The platform supports lifelong learning strategies across departments and partners, while your marketing team can test continuing education marketing ideas without being blocked by engineering. See the docs at https://cal.com/docs.

![Image of a branded class reminder email template for continuing education with subject and customizable content fields.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/c8clmbfDA65s1qwlyc7TCRRLc.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com connect with our LMS and SIS?

Yes. Use the Apps Marketplace, webhooks, Zapier or Make, and the Cal.com API to integrate with your LMS and SIS. Embed booking pages in portals, pass metadata, and update records automatically when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled. See https://cal.com/apps and https://cal.com/docs/api.

How do reminders handle multiple time zones and modalities?

Cal.com automatically respects the attendee’s time zone and preferred language. You can send email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages with join links for virtual sessions or location details for in person classes. Send pre class and post class messages based on precise timing.

Can we schedule group classes, cohorts, and office hours?

Yes. Create group events for classes and info sessions, plus round robin or collective events for advising and office hours. Set capacity, waitlists, and audience specific messaging so instructors and learners get what they need, when they need it.

Is Cal.com secure enough for institutions and partners?

Cal.com offers enterprise grade security features, access controls, and the option to self host for data residency. You can use SSO and detailed permissions to meet internal policies. Review your requirements with our team at https://cal.com/enterprise.

Can we accept payments for continuing education courses?

Yes. Connect Stripe to collect payments during booking, enforce paid access, and send receipts automatically. Pair payment confirmations with workflow messages that include course materials and policies for a smooth learner experience.

Can marketing track which campaigns drive bookings?

Yes. Cal.com supports UTM parameters and custom fields so you can attribute bookings to campaigns. Forward data to your CRM or analytics through webhooks and apps, then optimize continuing education marketing ideas based on real outcomes.

Do we need developers to maintain workflows?

No. Nontechnical staff use the no code builder to launch and adjust workflows quickly. Developers can extend functionality with the API, webhooks, and apps. Start with templates and grow as your adult learning programs scale. See https://cal.com/workflows and https://cal.com/docs.

Workflows for CPAs/accountants

# Automate client scheduling and reminders for accounting teams

Streamline onboarding, reviews, and deadlines with workflows that cut no-shows, automate reminders, and free billable hours.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow for a CPA firm in Cal.com, showing a trigger to send a tax planning reminder email 24 hours before an appointment with a customizable confirmation template.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/2YJYa14s7G5p6bKtHAXoaP8y3IY.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How workflows support busy accounting teams

Automate intake, reminders, and follow-ups across tax season, month end, and advisory.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Define triggers for key milestones

Start by mapping your accounting lifecycle, from new client intake to monthly close and tax filings. In Cal.com, choose the trigger that kicks things off, such as when a meeting is booked, a client reschedules, or a due date approaches. For tax engagements, trigger reminders 14 days before a filing deadline, then again 24 hours before. For controllership work, trigger tasks around your month end close checklist at T minus 3 days and on day 1. You can also start workflows when a routing or intake form is submitted for accounting client onboarding. Connect practice tools using webhooks or Zapier so every booking updates your CRM and task manager. Explore setup details at https://cal.com/workflows.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate messages and tasks

Choose the actions that should happen next. Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders with prep instructions, links to your secure portal, and the exact documents you need. Ask clients to complete a tax preparation checklist or upload accounting workpapers before the meeting. Notify your team in Slack, post to a reconciliation channel, or create a task in your practice system via Zapier. After the meeting, send follow ups with next steps and a link to schedule the next check in. Tie each message to a consistent bookkeeping workflow so nothing is missed. See integrations at https://cal.com/integrations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize scheduling for clients and teams

Personalize messaging with variables like client name, service type, organizer, and time zone. Route bookings to the right partner or staff accountant using forms and team round robin. Use group events when multiple stakeholders must attend, such as kickoff calls or audit fieldwork. For onboarding, automatically schedule chart of accounts setup and training sessions. Create role based messages so clients, partners, and staff receive the right instructions at the right time. Developers can manage workflows programmatically with our API at https://docs.cal.com/api. If you need full control of data residency, deploy Cal.com self hosted from https://github.com/calcom.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why accountants choose Cal.com Workflows

Reduce admin, protect utilization, and deliver a better client experience.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder on mobile for a CPA client, indicating responses for an upcoming tax review.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/vr7OuhL4J652VyX0ctHFlmJ8Rs.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Fewer no-shows and last minute delays

Automated reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients informed and on time. Pre event messages include directions, portal links, and prep items so meetings start ready. You can add confirmations and nudges that escalate as a due date approaches, which reduces missed appointments during tax season and monthly close. The result is a predictable calendar and fewer urgent reschedules for your team.

02

### Operational consistency across every engagement

Codify your firm’s best practices once, then apply them to every client. Use workflows to enforce consistent steps for accounting client onboarding, chart of accounts setup, quarterly reviews, and your month end close checklist. For tax season, attach the same tax preparation checklist to each booking so staff and clients know exactly what is required. Standardization lowers training time and helps new hires execute with confidence.

![Image of a bookings dashboard with accounting meetings, including tax planning sessions and month end close reviews.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/leBiiyYfy1q835gFAdQOTtmeKhQ.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Developer friendly and enterprise ready

Cal.com is open source and API first, which means you can integrate scheduling deeply with your practice systems. Use webhooks to update records, add audit trails, and orchestrate tasks. Self host if you need tighter control and customize the code for unique workflows. Role based permissions and detailed event logs support firm wide governance. Read the docs at https://docs.cal.com.

04

### Works with your accounting stack

Connect your calendars and communications in minutes. Cal.com integrates with Google and Microsoft calendars, Slack, Zoom, and Zapier, so you can plug into your practice tools without disruption. Trigger work in QuickBooks Online or Xero through Zapier or custom API calls. Whether you run a boutique firm or a multi office practice, workflows adapt to your bookkeeping workflow and advisory services. Browse integrations at https://cal.com/integrations.

![Image of a branded email template for a CPA firm, asking if the client is still attending the scheduled tax review.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/xFtr5fjvffiAj9bIHCN4PbSFmU.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for accounting workflows

Flexible automation and developer control for firms of any size.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi-channel reminders and follow ups

Send confirmations, reminders, and post meeting notes by email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Increase attendance and reduce back and forth for every client touchpoint. Use branded templates to keep communication consistent.

### Conditional logic and timing controls

Trigger on booking, reschedule, cancellation, or time based offsets before or after a meeting. Sequence messages to suit each engagement. Delay or skip steps based on answers from routing forms or event type.

### Routing forms and intake

Collect the right details upfront, then route clients by entity type, service, or urgency. Perfect for accounting client onboarding. Eliminate back and forth by capturing meeting goals and required systems upfront.

### Group events and role based messages

Invite multiple stakeholders and tailor content for each role, for example client, partner, and staff accountant. Keep internal notes private while clients only see what they need to prepare.

### Team scheduling and round robin

Balance workload across your team, set availability by service, and respect time zones for remote offices. Offer pooled availability for shared services like tax reviews or onboarding.

### Secure self hosting and API access

Run Cal.com on your own infrastructure or use the hosted cloud. Extend workflows with webhooks and our API at https://docs.cal.com/api. Authenticate with API keys and manage workflows through code or the dashboard.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can workflows handle tax season deadlines and extensions?

Yes. Create time based triggers relative to filing deadlines, then schedule reminder sequences that escalate as the date approaches. You can add separate flows for extensions and send clients a tax preparation checklist to complete ahead of their appointment.

How do we request documents and accounting workpapers?

Include links in your reminders to your secure portal or document system. Cal.com sends the message at the right time, then you track completion in your DMS. For extra clarity, attach a short accounting workpapers list and the exact prep steps.

Can we automate steps in our practice management tool?

Yes. Use webhooks or Zapier actions to create or update tasks when a booking is made, changed, or completed. This keeps your month end close checklist and job queues in sync with the calendar.

Does Cal.com support self hosting for data control?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and can be self hosted, giving your firm control over infrastructure and data residency. See deployment options at https://github.com/calcom.

How do routing forms help accounting client onboarding?

Routing forms capture entity type, services, and urgency, then send new clients to the right calendar and teammate. This ensures chart of accounts setup, kickoff, and training sessions are scheduled in the correct order.

Can we personalize messages for different stakeholders?

Yes. Use variables for client names, service types, and event details. Send role based messages so clients get prep instructions while partners and staff receive internal checklists and links.

What calendars and communications tools are supported?

Cal.com supports Google and Microsoft calendars, plus email, SMS, and WhatsApp notifications. You can also connect Slack, Zoom, and more via https://cal.com/integrations.

Workflows for creative agencies

# Automate client approvals and handoffs with Cal.com workflows

Streamline your creative approval process, design handoff best practices, and client feedback management with flexible, API-first workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up a creative review workflow in Cal.com, sending a 24 hour reminder for a brand review meeting.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/S9FuoaKFWY66IkHrwgdQfNQ5NY.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows fit creative agency operations

From intake to delivery, automate the meetings, messages, and handoffs that keep agency projects moving. Cal.com connects briefs, reviews, and approvals to reliable, branded communication and calendar logistics.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Collect the brief and set the plan

Start with a structured intake using your creative brief template. Trigger a kickoff call as soon as the brief is submitted, attach your brand guideline checklist, and invite the right stakeholders automatically. Sync all events to Google, Outlook, or iCloud with Cal.com, then store links in your project tool.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Route reviews and approvals

Define routing logic for the creative approval process. Cal.com Round Robin and Routing Forms send clients to the appropriate art director, brand manager, or legal reviewer. Automate reminders and escalation if feedback is late, while logging decisions to your system via webhooks.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Handoff, QA, and delivery

When approved, trigger design handoff best practices. Schedule internal QA, client walkthroughs, and delivery sessions. Send branded confirmations and files, and follow up post-launch for client feedback management and NPS. All steps can be replicated across accounts and projects.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits that help agencies move faster with less chaos

Reduce back-and-forth, eliminate missed reviews, and keep brand standards on track. Cal.com centralizes approvals, handoffs, and recurring client ceremonies so your team can focus on creative work, not calendar admin.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a creative design review on a mobile device.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/cedLokXchsWuH8BXrTctSDfVD0.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut review cycle time

Automated reminders and routing keep work moving. Clients get timely nudges via email, SMS, or WhatsApp, and approvers receive consolidated review slots. No more chasing feedback or rescheduling marathons across time zones.

02

### Protect brand quality at scale

Attach your brand guideline checklist and reference materials to confirmations and reminders. Ensure every reviewer sees the correct assets and context, improving decisions and reducing rework before production.

![Bookings dashboard for creative agency meetings including kickoff, design review, approval, and handoff sessions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/np736VLdUSiP6gAwItypbZolz7s.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Give clients a polished experience

Offer a clean booking flow, branded notifications, and timezone-aware scheduling. Share links that reflect the project name and team. Add post-meeting surveys for client feedback management without extra tools.

04

### Build on open, secure infrastructure

Use our open-source platform and API-first architecture to integrate with your stack. Self-host if needed, map data to your DAM or project tools, and meet enterprise security needs. See cal.com/open-source and cal.com/security for details.

![Branded communication template for creative agencies reminding attendees to review brand guidelines before a session.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/oD3cjnWd2sWDM0FfsLDBeYWeRA.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for creative operations

Everything you need to standardize reviews, approvals, and handoffs across clients and teams, with strong developer control and enterprise reliability.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing Forms for approvals

Qualify requests, capture scope, and send clients to the right approver or pod automatically. Perfect for brand, legal, and stakeholder review flows.

### Workflows for reminders and follow-ups

Automate confirmations, review reminders, and post-delivery check-ins across email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Reduce no-shows and late feedback.

### Round Robin and pooled availability

Balance meetings across creative leads or pods. Keep utilization healthy without manual reschedules.

### Custom branding and templates

Use branded email templates, embed assets, and attach your creative brief template and brand guideline checklist to messages.

### Webhooks and API integration

Connect Cal.com to Asana, Jira, Monday, Notion, or your DAM. Create or update tasks when meetings are booked, rescheduled, or approved. See docs at cal.com/docs and apps at cal.com/apps.

### Self-hosting and SSO

Deploy on your infrastructure with SSO, SCIM, and audit logs for enterprise clients. Learn more at cal.com/enterprise.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/LaiSiyunhUPK91GLM2TnFrTAXo.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows support our creative approval process?

Create a workflow that triggers on booking or a form submission, routes to approvers via Routing Forms or Round Robin, and sends reminders and escalations. Decisions can be logged with webhooks to your PM tool.

Can we attach a brand guideline checklist to reminders and invites?

Yes. Use custom email templates to include links to brand guidelines, asset libraries, or checklists so reviewers have the right context before each session.

How do we enforce design handoff best practices?

Automate a sequence after approval: schedule internal QA, client handoff, and training. Include files and checklists in confirmations and follow-ups, then schedule a post-launch review.

Can clients book multi-person reviews across teams?

Yes. Use collective or multi-host events to align creative, strategy, and brand stakeholders. Cal.com finds overlapping availability and sends one confirmation to all parties.

Do you support self-hosting for enterprise agencies?

Yes. Cal.com supports self-hosting and advanced security. Review cal.com/open-source and cal.com/enterprise, and contact us for architecture guidance.

How do we manage client feedback management at scale?

Automate feedback sessions and follow-ups, add surveys, and sync notes to your PM or CRM via webhooks and the API. Use workflows to remind clients until feedback is received.

Can developers manage everything programmatically?

Yes. Cal.com is API-first. You can create events, workflows, webhooks, and templates via the API. See cal.com/docs and the GitHub repo for examples.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help creative talent platforms manage bookings for freelance projects?

Cal.com automates scheduling so artists, designers, and photographers can book meetings or interviews directly with clients. This removes scheduling friction, saves time, and helps creative talent focus on their craft.

How do automated workflows benefit creative job marketplaces?

Automated workflows handle reminders, confirmations, and follow-up tasks for every booking or project. This reduces manual admin, prevents double bookings, and creates a smooth experience for both talent and clients.

Can I customize the intake process for different types of creative roles?

Yes, Cal.com lets you build custom workflows for onboarding, vetting, or portfolio review. Tailor forms and automations for designers, photographers, or other creative professionals.

Is it possible to support group interviews or collaborative project calls?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports multi-party scheduling, ideal for group interviews, creative kickoffs, or project briefings involving multiple stakeholders.

Does Cal.com support integrations with creative marketplaces and payment platforms?

Yes, you can integrate Cal.com with your existing tools, payment platforms, and creative management systems via API or native integrations.

Can I use Cal.com on a self-hosted platform for privacy or compliance?

Yes, Cal.com is open-source and self-hostable. This gives you full control of your data and compliance with your platform’s requirements.

How does Cal.com help deliver a branded experience for artists and clients?

You can customize email, SMS, and WhatsApp communications to match your platform’s brand. Every touchpoint feels professional and consistent, enhancing your reputation as a top creative talent platform.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do Cal.com workflows help customer support teams?

Workflows automate appointment scheduling, reminders, and follow-ups, allowing support staff to focus on customer issues instead of manual coordination.

Can we personalize messages for different customer segments?

Yes, Cal.com lets you customize messages for each event type, customer group, or trigger, so communication feels personal and relevant.

Does Cal.com integrate with our help desk and CRM tools?

Cal.com connects with popular CRM and help desk platforms directly or via Zapier and API, ensuring your scheduling data is always in sync.

Are reminders and follow-ups sent automatically?

Once your workflow is set up, Cal.com sends reminders and follow-ups automatically based on your selected timing and triggers.

Can we automate onboarding or group sessions?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports both individual and group events, making it easy to automate onboarding, webinars, or training sessions with tailored messaging.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for customer data?

Cal.com is built with enterprise-grade security and supports self-hosting for full data control. We comply with industry standards to keep your customer data safe.

Can our developers extend workflows using the API?

Yes, Cal.com offers a robust API, letting your developers create, update, and manage workflows programmatically for custom automation.

How it works

## How it works

Launch automated workflows for bookings, trials, and tuition in minutes.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars, classes, and staff

Sync teacher calendars, class schedules, and studio rooms. Import existing dance studio programs, set capacities, and define age levels so every booking automatically fits your timetable and space.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Build no-code workflows

Use the visual builder to create confirmations, reminders, waitlists, and follow-ups. Add email, SMS, or WhatsApp messages for trials, drop-ins, and recurring sessions, all triggered at the right time.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Go live and measure results

Publish your public booking pages or embed them on your site. Track attendance, no-shows, and conversions, then iterate with A/B-tested messages to maximize enrollments and retention.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

## Benefits for dance schools

Lower admin workload, increase attendance, and deliver a polished experience for every student and parent.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com ballet class reminder on a mobile device for a dance school, with attendee response status icons.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MOkisRUxMUdTujur6WfKAh24ko8.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Fewer no-shows, higher attendance

Automatic email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders help students and parents show up prepared. Send pre-class checklists, attire notes, and location details. For trials and evaluations, use confirmation prompts to secure commitment and reduce last-minute cancellations.

02

### Simplified enrollments for every program

Offer clear booking flows for series, drop-ins, and workshops. Collect student details, age, and skill level with custom questions, then route each booking to the right level and room. Make it easy for families browsing dance classes near me to reserve a spot instantly.

![Image of a bookings dashboard for a dance school showing today’s and tomorrow’s classes, trials, and private coaching sessions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3riGb3MGM0UCO8N8W9F7VXI.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Parent and adult friendly communication

Create separate workflows for kids dance classes and adult dance lessons. Send role-based messages to guardians, students, and instructors. Attach payment links, studio policies, and parking info. Personalized reminders build trust from trial to ongoing enrollment.

04

### Built for scale and control

Coordinate multi-location timetables, shared rooms, and teacher availability. Use waitlists to fill canceled spots fast. Self-host or use our cloud, plug into your stack with an API-first approach, and maintain brand consistency across ballet classes near me and wider studio offerings.

![Image of a branded email subject template for a dance class reminder, customized for a dance school.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/pjwg2YtS3Q7jH53YHxLC2gZe9EU.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Features to run your studio smoothly

Developer-ready and easy for staff, with open-source flexibility and enterprise reliability.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi-location and resource scheduling

Manage rooms, mirrors, barres, and teachers across locations. Set capacities and prevent double-booking with real-time calendar sync.

### Automated reminders and waitlists

Send timed reminders, confirmations, and post-class follow-ups. Enable waitlists to auto-fill openings and notify the next student.

### Payments and policies

Attach payment steps for trials or drop-ins, surface waivers, and require consent before booking. Store preferences with secure fields.

### Embeds and booking pages

Publish branded booking pages or embed them on your site. Showcase dance studio programs, class levels, and instructors with clear availability.

### API-first, secure, and self-hostable

Integrate with your CRM, POS, and messaging tools. Choose hosted or self-hosted deployments for higher control and compliance.

### Integrations that fit your stack

Connect calendars, Stripe for payments, Slack for team alerts, and webhooks for custom workflows and reporting.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can parents book a spot for their child and add details?

Yes. Use custom questions to capture the student’s name, age, level, allergies, or attire needs, while the parent is the main contact for confirmations and reminders.

Can we offer trials and then convert to ongoing classes?

Yes. Set a trial event type with targeted reminders and a post-class follow-up that includes a direct enrollment link and waitlist option if the class is full.

How do we handle different rooms and teachers at the same time?

Create resources for rooms and assign teachers to event types. Cal.com prevents double-booking by checking all assigned resources during scheduling.

Can we take payments during booking?

Yes. You can collect payments for drop-ins, workshops, and intensives, or request a deposit. Workflows then send receipts and policy reminders.

Do reminders support SMS and WhatsApp?

Yes. Send email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders. You can combine channels and tailor timing by class type, like ballet, hip hop, or contemporary.

Is self-hosting available for our organization?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted for maximum control and compliance. You can also use the hosted platform, both support workflows.

Can we manage seasonal schedules and camps?

Yes. Create separate event types for summer camps and seasonal series. Use capacity, waitlists, and follow-ups to keep sessions full and organized.

# Automate inclusive scheduling for DEI programs and advisory

Build reliable, bias aware scheduling that scales your DEI audits, trainings and stakeholder sessions without manual follow up.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow builder showing a DEI session reminder email configured for a stakeholder interview.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0UJKlAV3zYi7sJ8K4nQHi1GkmZw.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com Workflows power DEI engagements

Turn messy scheduling into a consistent experience for audits, trainings, and ERG initiatives, with automation that respects privacy and scale.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Map your DEI process

Define each step in your dei audit checklist, from stakeholder interviews and policy reviews to leadership readouts. Create event types that mirror your inclusive hiring framework, bias training curriculum, and ERG office hours.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Set triggers and actions

Choose when messages go out, who receives them, and what happens next. Automate confirmations, reminders, and follow ups. Trigger Slack notifications, route bookings, and send data to your dei metrics dashboard via API.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize and brand communication

Use templates for different audiences, like executives, ERG leaders, hiring managers, and employees. Localize content, add accessibility notes, and align tone with your practice. Keep everything consistent across projects.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why DEI consultants choose Cal.com

Deliver inclusive, reliable scheduling for complex programs while protecting data, reducing manual work, and improving participant experience.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile view of a DEI stakeholder interview reminder with participant responses.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/4xqTZdetYcNX4WBOz3yHSwIX1Ls.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce admin workload across programs

Automate recurring training series, policy interviews, and report reviews. Replace manual outreach with email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders so your team can focus on analysis and outcomes.

02

### Increase attendance and engagement

Send considerate reminders and pre work, share accessibility details, and provide easy rescheduling. Fewer no shows and better prepared stakeholders lead to stronger, more actionable insights.

![Bookings dashboard showing DEI audit, training, and ERG sessions scheduled.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/zuUxo9MHFHalnRjKFWlyU0pNcY.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Standardize inclusive communication

Create templates that reflect inclusive language and accessibility practices across your bias training curriculum and employee resource groups guide. Ensure every participant receives clear, equitable instructions.

04

### Operate with privacy and control

Self host Cal.com or use our enterprise plan for SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and granular permissions. Keep sensitive data from DEI interviews and surveys secure while integrating with your stack.

![Template editor showing branded DEI session email subject with inclusive phrasing.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QXyAw5xiKDIIrRYYnUiLdcx5Ns.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Features built for DEI consulting workflows

API first, open source, and privacy forward, with powerful automation for audits, trainings, and ERG programs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Automated reminders and follow ups

Reduce no shows with timed email, SMS, or WhatsApp messages, including pre work, accessibility options, and post session surveys.

### Routing forms for the right match

Route stakeholders to the right consultant based on department, region, or availability. Perfect for multi track training or leadership coaching.

### Multi channel templates

Standardize inclusive language in templates across channels. Use branded content that aligns to client tone and culture.

### Group events and series

Run workshops, cohorts, and ERG meetings with capacity limits, waitlists, and recurring schedules that sync to calendars.

### Analytics and integrations

Sync attendance and outcomes to your dei metrics dashboard. Use webhooks and the API to connect HRIS, LMS, or BI tools.

### Self hosting and enterprise security

Choose hosted or self hosted. Get SSO, SCIM, audit logs, DPA, and role based access for client facing teams.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows support a dei audit checklist?

Create event types for each audit stage, automate stakeholder invites and reminders, attach pre work, and route interviews to the right consultant. Use webhooks to update your project tracker and metrics.

Can I align scheduling with an inclusive hiring framework?

Yes. Build templates for candidate panels, hiring manager training, and interview calibration sessions. Route requests to certified facilitators and automate pre and post session materials.

How do I manage bias training curriculum sessions at scale?

Use group events with capacity limits, recurring series, and automated reminders. Send pre reads and post training assessments. Track attendance via the API for LMS reporting.

Can I support employee resource groups with flexible scheduling?

Yes. Offer ERG office hours, mentorship matching, and quarterly planning sessions. Use routing rules, templates per ERG, and branded communications that respect each group’s needs.

What privacy controls are available for sensitive interviews?

Use self hosting or enterprise features like SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and access controls. Limit who can view bookings and metadata. See https://cal.com/enterprise for details.

Can I send data to a dei metrics dashboard?

Yes. Use webhooks and the API to push attendance, completion, and feedback data into your BI tools or dashboards. See https://cal.com/docs for integration guidance.

What integrations are available for DEI teams?

Connect Google, Microsoft, Zoom, Slack, HubSpot, and more in https://cal.com/apps. Developers can extend via the API and embed scheduling in your client portal.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com automate demo scheduling for hardware and IoT teams?

Cal.com lets you create dedicated booking pages for hardware or IoT demos, automates reminders and confirmations via email or SMS, and handles post-demo follow-ups. Everything can be customized for your sales workflow, reducing manual admin and ensuring every prospect gets a seamless experience.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my CRM or sales enablement tools?

Yes. Cal.com supports integrations with major CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. You can sync attendee data, demo outcomes, and engagement stats automatically, supporting IoT sales enablement and reporting.

Does Cal.com support self-hosting for data-sensitive hardware companies?

Absolutely. Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted, giving hardware and IoT companies full control over their scheduling data and compliance with industry regulations.

Can I handle group demos or multi-attendee scenarios?

Yes. Cal.com supports group bookings for hardware and IoT product demos. You can invite multiple attendees, assign roles, and automate tailored communications for each participant.

How do automated reminders help with demo scheduling best practices?

Automated reminders via email or SMS significantly reduce no-shows for hardware and IoT demos. They help prospects remember appointments, confirm attendance, and maintain momentum in your sales pipeline.

Can I customize the booking experience to match my brand and product?

Definitely. Cal.com lets you fully brand your demo booking pages, confirmation emails, and reminder messages. Tailor every touchpoint to reflect your hardware or IoT product identity.

Is Cal.com developer-friendly for building custom hardware sales workflows?

Yes. Cal.com provides an API-first architecture, allowing hardware and IoT teams to build custom integrations, automations, and advanced demo scheduling workflows tailored to their exact needs.
