## Features that fit legal workflows

Flexible, API-first scheduling infrastructure with enterprise-grade controls.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Conflict-aware routing

Route new matters by practice area, location, role, or conflict flags. Use intake answers to determine eligibility, assign the right neutral, and prevent double booking across personal and shared calendars.

### Multi-party scheduling

Invite clients, counsel, and observers with role-based notifications. Support joint sessions, private caucuses, and follow-ups in one flow. Handle time zones, breakout rooms, and group availability cleanly.

### Automated reminders and follow-ups

Send branded reminders with preparation steps, payment links, or Zoom details. Trigger post-session tasks for agreements, invoices, or feedback. Reduce no-shows and keep all parties aligned.

### Payment, deposits, and holds

Collect fees or retainers before confirming hearings. Place soft holds that auto-expire, or require approval for premium blocks. Sync with accounting tools through webhooks.

### Self-hosting and SSO

Deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure for sensitive matters. Enable SSO and granular permissions to meet firm policies and regional compliance requirements.

### Developer-ready API and webhooks

Automate intake, routing, and notifications programmatically. Connect case management, billing, and CRM systems with robust API endpoints and real-time webhooks.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com handle multi-party availability for mediation?

Create multi-party events that collect each participant’s availability, then present overlapping times. Use host pools or round robin for panels, and add buffers to protect preparation time.

Can I collect intake forms and confidentiality agreements before sessions?

Yes. Add custom questions, file uploads, and pre-session tasks. Automate reminders to complete forms and send secure links for agreements before the meeting starts.

Does Cal.com support self-hosting for sensitive cases?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted, giving you control over data residency, security, and compliance. Use SSO and permissions to restrict access by team and role.

Can I separate joint sessions and private caucuses in one booking flow?

Yes. Offer multiple session types within a workflow. Use dynamic routing to schedule joint sessions first, then automatic caucus slots with separate links and notifications.

How do payments or retainers work for arbitration hearings?

Require deposits or full payments before confirming. Use payment steps in the booking flow, hold times until payment clears, and trigger invoices or receipts automatically.

What integrations are available for legal teams?

Connect calendars, video platforms, CRMs, and communication tools. Use webhooks and the API to integrate case management and billing systems with your preferred stack.

Can I manage panel scheduling across multiple neutrals via API?

Yes. The API supports creating events, updating availability, routing by rules, and syncing statuses across large panels, administrators, and practice groups.

Workflows for mortgage advisors

# Automate compliant scheduling for mortgage advisors

Streamline pre approval, document collection, and client updates with automated workflows that fit your existing origination stack and compliance needs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow builder showing a 24 hour pre approval consult reminder for mortgage advisors](https://framerusercontent.com/images/RAp1BN4CN8h5G3Ji2c67UE7HHE.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Set up smart automations that match your origination process, communications, and compliance needs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your calendars and define your pipeline

Sync calendars, map stages in your mortgage advisor process flow, and set guardrails for availability, buffers, and required fields across loan types.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Choose triggers across the loan lifecycle

Use event-based or time-based triggers tied to key loan origination workflow steps, like pre approval, appraisal, underwriting, and closing to send timely prompts.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate messages, tasks, and handoffs

Send reminders, collect documents, route to teammates, and post updates to CRMs. Build consistent client touchpoints without manual follow up.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits

Build a reliable, compliant client journey from first lead to funded loan.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile SMS reminder for an upcoming mortgage consultation](https://framerusercontent.com/images/XJNJlciE6LEMchLopGbbPwcCnA.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Convert more leads with timely, personal outreach

Turn inquiries into consultations with automated confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling. Embed booking in your site and email sequences to support mortgage lead nurturing tactics. Use routing and intake to qualify borrowers, capture goals, and steer them to the right product expert fast.

02

### Shorten time to pre approval with structured intake

Collect the right data at the right time, then trigger pre approval checklist mortgage items automatically. Require income, employment, and credit details up front, route to underwriting prep, and reduce back-and-forth. Clients see clear next steps, you see fewer stalled files.

![Bookings dashboard showing mortgage pre approvals, refinance reviews, and closing prep](https://framerusercontent.com/images/sdjL34kPrg6HdtomV5tpxprsQ.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Eliminate document chaos and missed steps

Create repeatable workflows tied to your mortgage document checklist. Auto send secure upload links, reminder cadences, and status updates. Escalate missing items before deadlines and keep stakeholders aligned. Every borrower gets a consistent, audit-ready experience.

04

### Keep your refinance and purchase pipelines moving

Build refinance pipeline management rules that nudge rate-check calls, appraisal scheduling, and closing packages. Automate status messages, internal alerts, and follow-ups after funding for reviews and referrals, improving lifetime value and repeat business.

![Branded email template confirming a mortgage appointment date](https://framerusercontent.com/images/46dYeI2A5PZch6rGqRVBRT3RFs.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features

Developer friendly, enterprise ready scheduling for modern mortgage teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Pipeline-aware routing

Route borrowers by product, credit profile, language, or branch. Power fair lead distribution and SLAs with flexible rules that reflect your process.

### Checklist driven automations

Tie steps to the pre approval checklist mortgage and mortgage document checklist. Automatically request documents, verify completion, and trigger next actions.

### Multi channel reminders

Reduce no shows with email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders. Customize tone and timing for each loan stage and borrower preference.

### CRM and ops integrations

Post events to your CRM, loan origination system, and internal tools. Keep notes, tasks, and statuses in sync across the stack.

### Self hosting and compliance controls

Run Cal.com on your infrastructure, control data residency, and apply access rules. Align with internal policies and auditor expectations.

### API first and extensible

Use webhooks and APIs to program workflows, service accounts, and custom fields. Fit unique loan origination workflow steps without vendor lock-in.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support a typical mortgage advisor process flow?

Define pipeline stages, set triggers per stage, and automate confirmations, reminders, and document requests. Intake fields capture borrower data while routing and availability logic align staff coverage with demand.

Can I mirror my loan origination workflow steps from our LOS and CRM?

Yes. You can map events to your LOS and CRM objects via webhooks and integrations, then trigger messages or tasks when statuses change, such as application submitted, conditional approval, or clear to close.

How do you handle a pre approval checklist mortgage inside workflows?

Create a checklist template, require key fields, and auto request documents. When items are complete, trigger the next step and notify stakeholders while maintaining a clear audit trail.

Can Cal.com help enforce our mortgage document checklist?

Yes. Use required pre-meeting questions, secure upload links, and reminder cadences. If items are missing, escalate to a teammate or reschedule conditions until compliance is met.

What options reduce no shows for rate and refinance reviews?

Enable multi channel reminders, add time zone detection, and allow easy rescheduling. Pair with refinance pipeline management triggers to keep milestones on track.

Is self hosting available for sensitive borrower data?

Yes. Cal.com supports self hosting with granular permissions and SSO. You control data residency and can meet internal compliance and vendor risk requirements.

Can developers manage workflows through the API?

Yes. The API lets you create and update workflows, templates, and availability programmatically. Use webhooks to sync status changes with your LOS and data warehouse.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows help the mortgage pre approval process?

Workflows collect key borrower info before the call, route to the right loan officer, and send reminders and follow ups automatically. After meetings, they can trigger document requests and status updates.

Can I route leads to the best loan officer by loan type or branch?

Yes. Use routing forms and rules to assign purchase, refinance, or HELOC consultations by expertise, branch, language, or availability. Round robin and priority routing are supported.

Do reminders support SMS for borrowers on the go?

Yes. Send email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders. You control timing, frequency, and content to reduce no shows and keep borrowers engaged throughout the process.

Can Cal.com integrate with our CRM and LOS?

Cal.com is API first and supports webhooks. Teams commonly connect CRMs and underwriting tools to update stages, create tasks, and log meetings automatically.

Is self hosting available for compliance and data control?

Yes. You can self host Cal.com to meet strict security and compliance needs, while keeping full feature parity for workflows and scheduling.

How do you support teams of many loan officers?

Use team pages, round robin, and pooled availability. Admins manage templates, permissions, and branding so every borrower receives a consistent experience.

Can I use Cal.com if I am a solo home loan broker?

Absolutely. Solo brokers can launch a simple booking page, automate reminders, and grow with advanced routing and integrations when needed.

Capture inventory, addresses, stairs, and special items to qualify jobs. Route leads to the right team, assign estimates, and trigger moving company quotes automatically.

### Crew and resource scheduling

Coordinate trucks, crews, and equipment with team availability and round-robin logic. Prevent double booking and keep multi-stop days organized.

### Branded templates and localization

Customize templates with your brand, languages, and city-specific details. Personalize by service type, from apartment movers to long distance movers.

### Payments and deposits

Collect deposits during booking with secure payments to reduce no-shows. Automate receipts, terms, and pre-move checklists after payment is confirmed.

### Open API and self-hosting

Integrate with your CRM, TMS, inventory tools, and messaging systems using our API-first platform. Self-host for compliance and advanced control when needed.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows help local movers near me reduce no-shows?

Set automated confirmations, time-window reminders, and day-of arrival texts. Customers stay updated, which reduces missed moves and improves crew utilization.

Can we handle quotes and estimates automatically?

Yes. Use routing forms to capture inventory and access details, then trigger estimate bookings and send moving company quotes faster with standardized templates.

How do you support apartment movers with specific building rules?

Collect elevator access, COI requirements, and parking notes on booking. Trigger building-specific instructions to customers and crews before arrival.

Can we manage long distance movers with multi-day timelines?

Yes. Create workflows across multiple events, send day-by-day updates, and sync with your CRM via webhooks. Manage pickups, layovers, and final delivery windows.

Do you support packing and moving services upsells?

Add pre-move checklists and optional add-ons in reminders. Trigger upsell messages for packing services, materials, and specialty item handling before the job.

Will this integrate with our existing tools?

Use the API and webhooks to connect CRMs, TMS, billing, and messaging. Post internal updates to Slack and keep calendars in sync across teams.

Can we self-host for compliance or control?

Yes. Cal.com supports self-hosting and an API-first architecture, giving moving companies full control over data, security, and customization.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help reduce scheduling workload for music and art schools?

Cal.com automates repetitive scheduling tasks like lesson booking, reminders, and cancellations. This saves your admin team hours every week and ensures families always have up-to-date information.

Can we customize onboarding and enrollment for different classes or programs?

Yes, Cal.com workflows let you tailor onboarding steps, messages, and enrollment forms for each class, instrument, or art program. Deliver a personalized experience for every student.

Does Cal.com support group classes, recitals, or workshops in addition to private lessons?

Absolutely. You can schedule group events, workshops, and recitals, managing registration, waitlists, and communications for each event type.

How does Cal.com handle communication with parents, students, and teachers?

Use Cal.com to automate branded messages for reminders, confirmations, cancellations, and follow-ups. Send notifications by email, SMS, or WhatsApp, ensuring everyone stays in the loop.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our existing school management or CRM system?

Yes. Cal.com offers an API-first architecture, making it easy to connect with your preferred school management, CRM, or billing platform. Find more details in our API documentation.

Is it possible to self-host Cal.com for greater data privacy?

Definitely. Cal.com is open-source and can be self-hosted, giving your school complete control over student and parent data. Learn more on our self-hosting guide.

What support does Cal.com offer for onboarding and workflow setup?

We provide detailed documentation, onboarding resources, and a dedicated support team to help you set up custom workflows tailored to your music or art school’s needs.

# Automated Workflows For Nonprofits And Community Organizations

Spend less time scheduling and more time making a difference. Cal.com helps nonprofits and community organizations simplify event coordination, automate reminders, and ensure seamless communication with volunteers, donors, and stakeholders.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Workflow email reminder template for a nonprofit volunteer event, showing a confirmation request for participation.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/2J7VNd9yyyi0O53hI8MvTX5bFI.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows support nonprofits and community organizations

Cal.com makes it easy for nonprofits and community organizations to automate scheduling tasks, manage volunteers, and streamline outreach for events or programs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set up your event triggers

Create workflows that trigger reminders or follow-ups based on volunteer sign-ups, event registrations, or donation appointments.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Define automated actions

Send confirmations, reminders, or personalized thank-you messages to volunteers, donors, and community members by email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Customize your messaging

Tailor communications to reflect your mission, event details, and branding to engage supporters and provide a professional experience.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Key benefits of using Cal.com workflows for nonprofits

Workflows help your organization save time, reduce manual coordination, and deliver a consistent, engaging experience for every volunteer, attendee, or donor.

01

### Automate volunteer and event communication

Never miss a follow-up with automated reminders, confirmations, and post-event thank-yous for volunteers and participants.

02

### Save administrative time

Eliminate repetitive manual tasks so your team can focus on your mission, not chasing down RSVPs or sending reminders.

03

### Increase event attendance and engagement

Boost turnout with timely, reliable communications and reminders that keep your community informed and excited.

04

### Maintain secure and accessible data

Control your data with flexible self-hosting options and open-source transparency, ensuring privacy for your organization and participants.

## Features designed for nonprofits and community organizations

Cal.com provides the flexibility, integrations, and automation tools that nonprofits need to streamline scheduling and engagement.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Volunteer and donor management automations

Automate outreach and reminders for volunteer shifts, donor meetings, and community events.

### Branded multi-channel communication

Engage supporters with personalized emails, texts, and WhatsApp messages tailored to your organization’s voice.

### Flexible event triggers and workflows

Start workflows based on sign-ups, event registrations, or donation bookings to keep everyone informed.

### Bulk scheduling for group events

Coordinate group volunteer shifts, board meetings, or fundraising events with ease—even across multiple locations.

### Self-hosting and data privacy

Run Cal.com on your own infrastructure for compliance and control, or use our hosted platform for convenience.

### API-first and open-source flexibility

Integrate Cal.com with your existing tools or custom systems, and adapt workflows to your unique needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help our nonprofit manage volunteer scheduling?

Cal.com enables you to automate volunteer shift sign-ups, send reminders for upcoming shifts, and manage group communications—reducing admin time and improving volunteer engagement.

Can we send personalized thank-you messages to donors automatically?

Yes. You can set up workflows to automatically send personalized thank-you emails or texts to donors after a meeting or donation is scheduled, reinforcing your appreciation and encouraging long-term support.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for sensitive community data?

Cal.com offers advanced privacy features, including self-hosting, encrypted data handling, and open-source transparency—helping your organization meet compliance and safeguard participant information.

Can we coordinate large community events or group meetings?

Absolutely. Cal.com makes it easy to schedule and manage group events, volunteer trainings, or board meetings, with automated communications and attendance tracking for every participant.

How does Cal.com integrate with the tools we already use?

Cal.com offers an API-first architecture and integrates with popular calendars, communication platforms, and fundraising tools, enabling seamless data flow and workflow automation.

Can we use Cal.com if our volunteers or staff have different tech skills?

Yes. Cal.com has an intuitive, user-friendly interface for non-technical users, while offering robust APIs and customization for tech-savvy teams.

Is there special pricing or support for nonprofits?

Cal.com offers nonprofit discounts and dedicated support. Visit our pricing page or contact our team to learn more about eligibility and onboarding.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com support mobile notary services with travel buffers?

Yes. You can add setup, travel, and cleanup buffers to prevent back to back bookings that risk delays. Workflows also send location details and updates if the address or time changes.

How do workflows help loan signing agent services?

Create lender specific templates with required docs, ID reminders, and access notes. Send reminders to borrowers and escrow, route urgent signings to available agents, and log every step for compliance.

Can I use Cal.com for online notarization appointments?

Yes. Add secure video links, device readiness instructions, and time based reminders. Include join links for signers and witnesses, and trigger follow ups with completed document delivery details.

Does Cal.com support apostille notary workflows?

Yes. Build multi step workflows for intake, notarization, and apostille submission. Share checklists, deadlines, and pickup or courier instructions, and track status changes automatically.

What if clients search notary public near me open now?

Publish a booking page with real time availability. Clients can book the next open slot, choose in person or virtual, and receive instant confirmation with reminders to reduce drop offs.

Can I self host Cal.com for stricter compliance needs?

Yes. Cal.com offers a self hosted deployment that lets you control data residency and access. You can configure permissions, retention policies, and integrate with your existing security stack.

How do teams manage coverage across regions?

Use team availability, territories, and round robin assignment. Create routing rules by zip code, service type, language, or urgency to ensure the right notary gets the right booking quickly.

## Benefits

Why nutrition professionals rely on Cal.com for scheduling workflows

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AMGdiGiiaoHL7HXIYpwBBdNkujw.png?width=1560&height=1116)

01

### Convert more clients with frictionless booking

Make it easy for people searching for a registered dietitian near me or an online nutritionist to book without back and forth. Offer precise time windows, group classes, and multi-location options. Add routing logic to direct athletes to a sports nutrition coach, or families to a pediatric specialist. Let clients self-book the right session on any device, then receive clear confirmation and instructions. With transparent availability and automated reminders, you eliminate barriers to booking and build trust from the first click.

02

### Deliver consistent, high quality sessions

Start every appointment prepared. Use workflows to collect nutrition history, goals, allergies, and food preferences before the visit. For a meal planning consultation, automatically request dietary restrictions, pantry staples, and budget so your recommendations land well. Standardize reminders, prep instructions, and document requests. Cal.com helps you deliver a reliable, professional experience that scales across telehealth, in-person, and hybrid visits.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/OWQBZtmpRKUQqnGb7W6yXN6doU.png?width=1557&height=1116)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Reduce no-shows and admin load

Automated reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients on track, while reschedule links and time zone handling reduce friction. Intake forms, consent, and payment prompts can be sent automatically. After sessions, follow-up tasks like sending recap notes, recipes, or lab requests are triggered without manual effort. Your calendar stays accurate, your team saves hours weekly, and clients feel supported between visits.

04

### Adapt to any practice model

Whether you are a solo online nutritionist, a clinic with multiple registered dietitians, or a sports nutrition coach embedded in a training facility, Cal.com flexes to your workflow. Use our API-first platform for custom intake, EHR integrations, or group programs. Self-host if you require maximum data control. Build routing forms that map client goals to the right practitioner and package. Cal.com helps you grow programs while maintaining a personal, human touch.

### Routing forms and conditional logic

Qualify clients by goals, nutrition needs, and location. Route athletes to a sports nutrition coach, families to pediatric dietitians, or clients to telehealth vs in-person based on responses.

### Multi-channel reminders

Collect nutrition history, allergies, and consent before sessions. Reuse templates across event types, and prefill data for returning clients to speed up booking and reduce errors.

### Group sessions and programs

Offer classes on label reading, meal prep, or team nutrition briefings. Manage waitlists, reminders, and post-session materials automatically for cohorts or recurring programs.

### Calendar and availability controls

Sync multiple calendars, set buffers, and protect focus time. Offer different durations for assessments vs check-ins, and handle time zones for remote clients.

### API and webhooks

Extend Cal.com with custom logic. Trigger EHR updates, send resources, or notify coaching apps after bookings. Self-host for maximum control over data and integrations.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do Cal.com workflows help a nutrition practice handle no-shows?

You can set multi-channel reminders, require confirmations, and include quick reschedule links. Buffers and cutoff times reduce last minute cancellations, keeping your day predictable and client friendly.

Can I collect intake details before the first appointment?

Yes. Create pre-visit forms for goals, medical history, allergies, and food preferences. Workflows send the form automatically after booking and can require completion before confirming.

Does Cal.com support telehealth and in-person scheduling together?

Yes. Offer both options within the same event type or separate types. Routing forms can direct clients to telehealth or office visits based on location and preferences.

How can a sports nutrition coach use this?

Create athlete specific event types, request training logs before sessions, and send automated follow-ups with fueling plans. Route athletes to the right specialist based on sport or season.

Can teams of registered dietitians share availability?

Yes. Use round-robin or collective scheduling, assign specialties, and route clients to the best fit. Shared workflows standardize reminders, intake, and follow-ups across the team.

Is self-hosting available for clinics with strict data requirements?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted, giving you control over infrastructure and data. You can also use the API to integrate with existing practice systems and workflows.

Can I automate post-session materials and next steps?

Yes. Trigger recap emails, resources, meal plans, lab requests, and next booking links after each session. Timing and content are fully customizable per event type.

## How onboarding specialists use Cal.com Workflows

Replace manual booking, reminders, and follow-ups with automated workflows that keep every client on track from kickoff to go live.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Define your onboarding journey

Map each phase, from discovery to launch, then connect them to event types in Cal.com. Use routing forms to guide prospects to the right kickoff call agenda, assign the correct specialist, and capture required fields up front. Link assets like your customer onboarding checklist, onboarding playbook template, and implementation plan template so every booking includes the right resources.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate scheduling and communication

Set triggers for confirmations, reschedules, no‑shows, and milestones. Cal.com Workflows send branded emails, SMS, or WhatsApp messages so clients always know what comes next. Share timelines, prerequisites, and prep steps, and embed calendar booking inside your LMS or success portal. Use the API to sync tasks to CRM or project tools. Explore docs at https://cal.com/docs.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Orchestrate handoffs and reporting

As onboarding moves from solutions to training to support, automatically notify internal teams in Slack and update CRM stages. Use webhooks to push status, deadlines, and outcomes. Maintain visibility with a consistent cadence of updates, while customer journey mapping stays aligned across teams. Learn more about integrations at https://cal.com/apps.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows support a customer onboarding checklist?

Attach your customer onboarding checklist to event types and send it automatically after booking. Use reminders to confirm completion before the next step. Track status via API in your CRM.

Can we include a kickoff call agenda in invites?

Yes. Add a kickoff call agenda to confirmation emails and reminders, including goals, attendees, success metrics, and prep tasks, so stakeholders arrive aligned.

How do we standardize our onboarding playbook template?

Create templates for each phase, link your onboarding playbook template in messages, and reuse workflows across products or segments to ensure consistent delivery at scale.

Can Cal.com automate our implementation plan template?

Yes. Host or link your implementation plan template, generate step assignments via webhooks, and trigger messages when tasks or milestones change.

How do we manage complex customer journey mapping?

Use routing, tags, and workflow triggers to reflect each stage. Send different messages by role or phase, and push updates to CRM to keep customer journey mapping accurate.

Does Cal.com support enterprise security and self-hosting?

Yes. Cal.com is open source with optional self-hosting, SSO, SCIM, role-based controls, and data residency options. See https://cal.com/enterprise for details.

Can developers manage workflows via API?

Yes. Create and update workflows, events, and webhooks programmatically. Explore https://cal.com/docs and the workflow API reference in the docs.

Workflows for optometrists

# Automate optometry scheduling and workflows for modern eye care

Cal.com helps optometry teams manage bookings, intake, reminders, and follow-ups so every eye exam runs on time and on brand.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of an automated workflow for optometrists sending a 24-hour eye exam reminder email with confirmation and visit details.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bTyBHCmhDcvZNsOnidxa4CavvwM.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows power optometry practices

Connect your calendars, define triggers and actions, and automate every step from intake to follow-up without manual work.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your practice systems

Start with a unified scheduling layer for eye exams, contact lens checks, and optical consults. Sync provider calendars, rooms, and equipment, then connect your EHR or practice management system using our API or webhooks. Support hosted or self-hosted deployments. Learn more at https://cal.com/enterprise and https://cal.com/docs/api.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Define triggers for your eye exam workflow

Choose time-based and event-based triggers, such as when a new patient books an appointment, 48 hours before an eye exam, or after a visit ends. Trigger the optometry patient intake form, insurance verification prompts, and pre-visit instructions.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate actions for patients and staff

Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders, route patients by exam type, collect forms, and notify optical staff for eyewear dispensing. Automate post-visit follow-ups for the contact lens fitting process and reorders. Explore configuration in our docs at https://cal.com/docs and help center at https://help.cal.com.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for optometry teams and patients

Cut admin time, improve patient experience, and keep your clinical schedule on track with automation that fits your practice.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile preview of an eye exam SMS reminder for an optometry appointment with patient response status icons.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/b94HW5BJdZF4D9vULDLZVik5M8.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce no-shows and late arrivals

Automated reminders by email, SMS, and WhatsApp reduce missed appointments. Include pre-visit directions, parking details, and insurance requirements so patients arrive prepared for their eye exam. Add confirmations and rescheduling links to keep your day balanced.

02

### Shorten check-in with digital intake

Send the optometry patient intake form right after booking and again 24 hours before the visit. Auto-sync completed forms to your EHR or PMS via API. Staff sees who has completed forms before the patient walks in, cutting bottlenecks at the front desk.

![Bookings dashboard showing optometry appointments including eye exams, contact lens fittings, and glasses pick-ups.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/BbM0pzTv84vbQ62ac6p9o69yHg.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Streamline the eye exam workflow from booking to follow-up

Use routing to assign patients to the right provider and room, and automate post-visit messages, prescriptions ready notifications, and recall reminders. Build a consistent experience for comprehensive exams, pediatrics, and urgent visits.

04

### Improve optical operations and revenue capture

Alert opticians when an exam ends so they can start the eyewear dispensing checklist. Automate frame selection follow-ups, lens order status updates, and contact lens supply reminders. Use data to forecast demand and support optical inventory management.

![Template editor for branded optometry reminder email subject and content aligned to practice style](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MYwFUrtQ8y4CJNHXlUZKaDwk.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for clinical-grade scheduling

Flexible, secure, and developer friendly scheduling infrastructure with workflows tailored to optometry operations.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Workflow builder with multi-channel messaging

Create eye care workflows with time-based and event-based triggers. Send branded emails, SMS, and WhatsApp across the patient journey, from reminders to post-visit care instructions.

### Routing and advanced availability

Route by provider, exam type, equipment, or location. Respect provider hours, room constraints, and turnaround times to keep the schedule realistic.

### Digital intake and form reminders

Automate delivery of your optometry patient intake form and collect required documents before arrival. Reduce lobby time and increase throughput.

### Post-visit and recall automation

Schedule follow-ups for contact lens fitting process, glasses pick-up, and annual eye exam recalls. Send prescription ready and order status notifications.

### API-first and self-hosting options

Integrate with your EHR or PMS using webhooks and our API at https://cal.com/docs/api. Choose hosted or self-hosted at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com to meet compliance standards.

### Analytics and audit trails

Track completion rates, no-show reduction, and workflow performance. Maintain logs for compliance and team accountability.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com connect to our EHR or practice management system?

Yes. Cal.com is API-first with webhooks and an SDK, so you can push intake data, appointment details, and outcomes to your EHR or PMS. See https://cal.com/docs/api.

How do we handle the optometry patient intake form and insurance details?

Send secure links automatically after booking. Patients complete forms before arrival. Use webhooks to send data to your systems, and reminders ensure completion. Learn more at https://help.cal.com.

Can we support different exam types and providers across multiple locations?

Yes. Use routing rules to match patients with providers, rooms, and equipment by location and exam type. Manage availability across sites from one place.

Does Cal.com support the contact lens fitting process and recalls?

Yes. Automate follow-ups for fittings, training, rechecks, and lens reorders. Schedule annual recalls and notify patients via email or SMS.

How do we manage optical handoffs and eyewear dispensing?

Trigger a workflow when an exam ends to alert opticians. Start an eyewear dispensing checklist, send lens order updates, and notify when glasses are ready for pick-up.

Can we self-host for stricter compliance needs?

Yes. Cal.com supports self-hosting. Review our repository at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com and enterprise options at https://cal.com/enterprise.

What analytics are available for operations and growth?

Track no-show rates, intake completion, and recall conversions. Use data to improve the eye exam workflow and optical inventory management decisions.

Workflows for paralegal services

# Workflows tailored for paralegal operations and client care

Automate intake, documents, and reminders so freelance and virtual paralegals work faster with fewer errors.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for a paralegal intake reminder, including a 24-hour email confirmation before an intake meeting.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/9yJstTbEuCFwFcR8FnZCCPGtNwA.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com streamlines paralegal workflows

Set up reliable automations for intake, document tasks, scheduling, and follow-ups without extra admin.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### connect calendars and define intake rules

Sync firm and freelance calendars, add booking limits, and route clients by matter type, urgency, or jurisdiction to the right paralegal or attorney for faster triage.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### automate documents, reminders, and tasks

Trigger paralegal document preparation, gather disclosures, and send reminders by email, SMS, or WhatsApp based on booking, reschedule, or filing deadlines.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### track outcomes and improve performance

Log attendance, deadlines met, and turnaround times. Push updates to case tools or Slack, then iterate with data to reduce no-shows and speed document delivery.

01

### faster client intake across practice areas

Turn intake into a structured, repeatable process that supports freelance paralegal services and in-house teams alike. Use routing forms to capture matter type, language needs, and jurisdiction, then assign the best available professional. Reduce phone tag with instant confirmations and time-zone aware invitations. Automated reminders cut delays and keep clients informed. Cal.com helps you standardize intake without sacrificing a human touch, so every new client starts on the right track with the right paralegal.

02

### reduce no-shows and missed deadlines

Deadlines drive legal outcomes. Cal.com sequences reminders relative to hearings, signings, and filing dates, so clients and staff stay on time. Multi-channel notifications reduce no-shows for consultations, document reviews, and court prep sessions. For virtual paralegal teams, pooled availability and round-robin routing provide coverage across time zones. Add follow-ups to confirm attendance, request reschedules, or share next steps. With consistent communication, you protect calendars, prevent last-minute cancellations, and give attorneys better visibility into capacity and caseload.

Cal.com unifies reminders and tasks so documents move forward without manual chasing. ## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com support virtual paralegal teams across time zones?

Yes. Cal.com handles multi-time-zone scheduling, pooled availability, and round-robin routing so virtual paralegal teams can cover clients globally.

How do workflows help with paralegal document preparation?

Create triggers that request documents, send templates, and remind clients to upload files. Automations reduce back-and-forth and accelerate drafting.

Is Cal.com suitable for litigation support services?

Yes. Use deadline-based reminders, group scheduling for depositions, and status notifications to keep counsel, witnesses, and vendors aligned.

Can we handle freelance paralegal services alongside firm staff?

Yes. Set permissions, use team pools, and route matters to freelancers or internal staff based on skills, workload, or practice area.

Does Cal.com integrate with eSignature and payments?

Yes. Use integrations and webhooks to trigger eSignature requests and collect consultation fees or retainers during booking.

Can I self-host Cal.com for stricter compliance?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted and extended via API, giving you more control over data residency and security.

How are contract drafting paralegal tasks automated?

Use workflows to send intake questionnaires, assign drafting sessions, and schedule review calls. Follow-ups ensure clients sign and return agreements.

# Automate passport and visa scheduling with Cal.com workflows

Reduce no-shows and manual follow-ups for consulates, agencies, and travel firms with automated reminders.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for consulate appointment reminders, confirming attendance before passport or visa appointments.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/JuKqSAklLBBlzhRe506rIt3y3C8.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Launch end to end scheduling for passports and visas in a few steps, from intake and routing to reminders and follow-ups, all powered by Cal.com Workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars, forms, and intake

Connect your staff or vendor calendars, set office hours, and add intake forms to capture applicant details like passport number, nationality, and travel dates. Use eligibility questions to route applicants to the right event types, including passport renewal, expedited passport services, and visa interviews. Cal.com integrates with your existing tools through the apps marketplace at https://cal.com/apps and supports enterprise SSO at https://cal.com/enterprise for secure rollouts across teams and locations.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Design your workflow and rules

Use the no-code Workflow builder to set rules around the visa application process. Define instant confirmations, time-based reminders, and pre-appointment instructions. Add dynamic links for forms, checklists, and payments. Configure separate paths for first-time applicants, renewals, and families. Developers can extend and automate with our API and webhooks at https://cal.com/docs/api, allowing you to update case systems, generate reference numbers, or trigger background checks when bookings are created or rescheduled.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups

Send confirmations immediately and schedule reminders by email, SMS, or WhatsApp to reduce no-shows. Include visa photo requirements, a travel visa checklist, and consulate appointment tips so applicants arrive prepared. After the appointment, send follow-ups for missing documents, reschedules, or next steps. Every touchpoint is logged, and you can sync statuses to your internal systems. Learn more about configuring Workflows at https://cal.com/docs.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for passport and visa teams

Operational efficiency and a better applicant experience, delivered with flexible infrastructure you control.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com consulate appointment reminder on a mobile device, with a reminder message and attendee response status.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/900GttPTN6DsOcw7Gdjf9VgSHo.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut no-shows and late arrivals

Applicants miss appointments when instructions are unclear or reminders arrive too late. Workflows solve this with smart confirmations, scheduled notifications, and clear directions. You can include consulate appointment tips, what to bring, and on-site check-in details. For high-demand days, send a 24-hour reminder, a 2-hour reminder, and a 15-minute nudge. Teams see fewer walk-ins at the wrong time and fewer empty slots, which increases throughput and applicant satisfaction.

02

### Speed up document readiness

Reduce last-minute issues by sending the right guidance at the right time. Before the visit, share visa photo requirements, the travel visa checklist, and any local forms in a single message. For renewals, include a short guide on passport renewal requirements and a link to your FAQ. If something is missing, automatically trigger a follow-up with instructions to re-upload or reschedule. This cuts desk time per appointment and raises first-pass success.

![Image of a bookings dashboard displaying scheduled passport and visa appointments with dates, times, event titles, and participant profile pictures.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Bg5A18uaA88gIY88tA1lh3K8xBA.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Scale across locations and vendors

Roll out a consistent booking experience across consulates, partner agencies, and outsourced service centers. Cal.com supports pooled and round-robin scheduling, so you can distribute demand fairly and keep utilization high. Manage local holidays, staff permissions, and unique event types per site. Choose hosted or self-hosted deployments, and integrate with existing systems via API. Explore open-source flexibility at https://cal.com/open-source and enterprise options at https://cal.com/enterprise.

04

### Prove compliance and security

Protect personally identifiable information with strong access controls and role-based permissions. Cal.com supports encryption in transit and at rest, SSO, audit logs, and custom data retention policies. Keep applicant communication consistent and centralized for audits, while using self-hosting options if you need more control. Read about our security posture at https://cal.com/security and explore pricing at https://cal.com/pricing.

![Image of a branded email reminder template for a consulate appointment, tailored messaging about visa and passport requirements.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5t4zlb4R5jvcwtB6pbelkDQgVl8.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Features built for high-volume passport and visa scheduling

Everything you need to orchestrate reliable, compliant bookings across teams and regions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing forms and eligibility checks

Screen applicants with routing forms to send them to the right event type, time slot, and location based on the visa application process or renewal needs.

### Multi-channel notifications

Send confirmations and reminders via email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Add timed alerts for critical cases like an expedited passport to keep applicants on track.

### Document collection and links

Share links to instructions, checklists, and upload portals. Include visa photo requirements and a travel visa checklist so applicants arrive ready with compliant documents.

### Team scheduling and round robin

Pool availability across sites, assign skills, and use round-robin routing to spread workload for interviews, renewals, and intake consults.

### APIs and webhooks

Connect Cal.com to your case management or CRM. Trigger webhooks on booking, reschedule, or cancellation. See developer docs at https://cal.com/docs/api.

### Open-source and self-hosting

Deploy in your own environment for maximum control, or use our hosted service. Explore options at https://cal.com/open-source and https://cal.com/enterprise.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle location-specific rules like blackout dates and slot caps?

Yes. You can set availability windows, buffers, per-day caps, and location-specific schedules. Combine routing forms with event types to enforce rules per consulate or service center.

How do we collect applicant data and documents securely?

Use custom intake questions for key fields and include links to your secure document portals. Workflows automate reminders for missing items. Access is controlled by roles and SSO.

Can Cal.com help applicants meet visa photo requirements?

Yes. Include photo specs and examples in reminders, plus links to your guidance page. Cal.com does not validate images, but it ensures applicants receive the right instructions on time.

Do you support expedited passport offerings with priority scheduling?

Yes. Create dedicated event types, add eligibility questions, require payment with apps like Stripe, and send high-priority reminders for expedited passport appointments.

How do you prevent double bookings across multiple calendars?

Cal.com checks connected calendars for conflicts, supports pooled availability, and can hold slots while applicants complete intake, reducing accidental double bookings.

Is Cal.com secure for PII and compliant with enterprise standards?

Cal.com provides encryption, audit logs, SSO, and role-based access. Review details at https://cal.com/security and choose hosted or self-hosted to meet your compliance needs.

Can developers integrate Cal.com with our case system and status updates?

Yes. Cal.com is API-first with webhooks, SDKs, and an apps marketplace. Use https://cal.com/docs/api to sync bookings, statuses, and notes with your internal systems.

# Automated workflows for patent and trademark attorneys that streamline intake

Standardize consultations, filings, and reminders with API-first scheduling built for IP practices and legal teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Hero image of a Cal.com workflow reminding a client to confirm an IP consultation for patents or trademarks.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5aY6AEimDANIe8xKHPIcjx3yRY.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works for IP attorneys

Set up once, then guide clients from inquiry to granted rights with reliable, automated steps.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Configure compliant intake and screening

Create booking pages for patent lawyer consultation, conflict checks, fee agreements, and NDAs. Route prospects by matter type, urgency, office, or attorney availability. Capture disclosures and consent before meetings.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate filings and deadline reminders

Trigger reminders for filing, responses, and renewals after bookings. Send staged email, SMS, or WhatsApp nudges for office actions, drawings, and payments to reduce risk of missed dates.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Sync teams, tools, and trust

Connect calendars, CRMs, and case systems. Notify paralegals in Slack, push data via webhooks, and keep clients informed at every step with branded, accessible communication.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for patent and trademark practices

Cal.com brings operational clarity to high-stakes IP work. Automate repeatable steps, protect deadlines, and deliver a consistent client experience across your entire firm.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile view of an IP consultation reminder SMS for a patent or trademark meeting.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/zgCfxn5hHNW8O7a2N06fbhYE.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Eliminate no-shows and idle time

Automated confirmations and time-based reminders cut missed patent lawyer consultation appointments and wasted prep. Clients receive clear instructions, including document checklists, so meetings start on time and end with action.

02

### Accelerate intake and qualification

Route leads from a trademark attorney near me search directly to the right attorney or team. Use screening questions to separate simple file a trademark matters from complex provisional patent help and portfolio work.

![Bookings dashboard showing today and tomorrow for patent and trademark matters in an IP firm.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/QuRly0jAys14M29ybbfgfhMJwQ.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Protect deadlines and reduce risk

Model your docket touchpoints with dependable workflows. Send reminders for use specimens, office action responses, renewals, continuations, and foreign filing decisions. Keep clients and paralegals aligned without manual chasing.

04

### Scale a predictable client experience

Standardize communications across your intellectual property law firm. Brand emails and SMS, localize time zones, and keep every matter moving. Free attorneys to focus on strategy, not scheduling and follow-ups.

![Branded email template prompting clients to review IP documents before a scheduled meeting.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/F8T3OnJyIyCwJm9hx0rGhfDTNI.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for IP scheduling operations

API-first, open source, and privacy conscious. Run hosted or self-hosted, integrate with your stack, and control every detail of your client journey.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing forms with dynamic logic

Qualify by matter type, jurisdiction, budget, or timeline, then route to the right attorney, team, or office. Reduce back-and-forth and match expertise automatically.

### Multichannel reminders and follow-ups

Send confirmations, prep checklists, and filing reminders via email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Sequence nudges for deadlines and post-meeting tasks to prevent stalls.

### Flexible triggers and actions

Start workflows on booking, reschedule, cancellation, or at time-based offsets. Fire webhooks, update systems, notify Slack, and send personalized messages to stakeholders.

### Group events for client and team

Coordinate inventor interviews, examiner interviews, or client workshops. Tailor communications for attorneys, paralegals, clients, and interpreters with role-based messages.

### Calendars, buffers, and compliance

Respect buffers, time zones, and working hours. Offer secure, private booking links and data retention controls to meet firm and client requirements.

### Developer-ready and self-hostable

Use the robust API and SDKs to manage workflows at scale. Self-host on your infrastructure for full control and data residency needs.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help reduce missed IP consultations?

By automating confirmations, prep instructions, and timed reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Clients arrive prepared, and your team avoids idle time and reschedules.

Can we route by attorney specialty and jurisdiction?

Yes. Routing forms capture matter details and direct bookings to the right attorney or team based on practice area, country, urgency, and availability.

Can we collect NDAs and conflict details before meetings?

Yes. Add required questions and consent steps to intake. Capture documents, conflict data, and custom fields before a meeting is confirmed.

How do we manage filing and response deadlines?

Create time-based workflows that trigger reminders before office actions, renewals, and filings. Notify clients and staff, and push updates to your case or CRM via webhooks.

Is self-hosting available for our firm?

Yes. Cal.com can be self-hosted for maximum control, privacy, and data residency while retaining the full workflow feature set.

Can we brand communications for our firm?

Yes. Customize templates, subjects, and content to reflect your intellectual property law firm brand, tone, and languages across all channels.

Does Cal.com integrate with our calendars and tools?

Yes. Sync major calendars, send Slack notifications, and connect systems through APIs and webhooks to keep your matter data aligned.

Workflows for permit/license scheduling

# Automate permit and license scheduling with Cal.com workflows

Streamline public permitting, inspections, and licensing with automated scheduling, reminders, and secure routing across teams.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Automated workflow builder showing a 24 hour email reminder for a permit appointment with confirmation button and event details.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/P9hD91G1vk4tGclPzBluu9m74.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

From intake to confirmation, Cal.com automates permit and license scheduling so agencies reduce back-and-forth, increase compliance, and deliver a predictable citizen experience.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars and set intake rules

Sync staff calendars, define office hours, and add intake questions so residents can schedule the right permit appointment. Route based on location, project type, or priority to avoid misbookings.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate confirmations and reminders

Send branded confirmations and time-based reminders by email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Reduce no-shows and ensure applicants bring correct documents aligned to building permit requirements.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Trigger follow-ups and handoffs

After the appointment, trigger follow-ups, fee reminders, or inspection scheduling. Use webhooks and API to update case systems and move applications to the next step automatically.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for public sector permitting and licensing

Reduce friction across permitting and licensing while improving service delivery and compliance. Cal.com centralizes scheduling with robust guardrails, from intake to inspection, so residents, contractors, and agency staff stay aligned and on time.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile notification showing a permit inspection reminder with attendee responses for city staff and applicant.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aQAu8rGo0KIoG4KzHxnVVCJMI.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut wait times and phone volume

Offer self-serve booking to help residents schedule permit appointment on any device, at any time. Intelligent routing assigns the correct staff or office, reducing transfers and manual coordination that can delay approvals.

02

### Improve compliance and first-time approvals

Use customizable reminders to list required documents and link to checklists aligned to building permit requirements. Applicants arrive prepared, reducing reschedules and improving first-time approval rates for common permits and licenses.

![Bookings dashboard listing permit intakes, inspections, and business license reviews organized by day.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/W6u5OdJ5Y4b5WSeqQZJO1CFgA98.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Unify teams and systems

Coordinate planning, inspections, and licensing teams with shared availability and permissions. Cal.com integrates through API and webhooks so data flows to case management, payments, and document systems without duplicate entry.

04

### Serve every resident equitably

Offer fair, accessible scheduling with multilingual templates, time zone handling, and SMS notifications. Provide DMV appointment alternatives for select workflows where walk-ins are limited, ensuring transparent access to services.

![Branded communication template for a permit appointment reminder email subject tailored to permitting workflows.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/7som4n6TIk7o9XSrRUbzNkOcDU0.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for permits, inspections, and licensing

Configurable, API-first scheduling that adapts to your process while maintaining security and control. Deploy quickly, scale confidently, and meet agency requirements with auditability and flexible hosting.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Conditional routing and intake logic

Direct bookings by location, permit type, project size, or applicant role. Prevent misrouted appointments with rules-based routing and required intake questions that capture the details your team needs.

### Automated multi-channel notifications

Send confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups via email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Personalize content to the appointment type, add preparation checklists, and reduce no-shows for inspections and licensing visits.

### Group sessions and cohort scheduling

Run applicant workshops, contractor briefings, or office hours for the business license application process. Manage capacity, waitlists, and attendee communications automatically.

### Role-based permissions and audit trails

Control who can view, edit, or book on behalf of others. Track changes, view history, and meet internal audit requirements with transparent activity logs.

### Open-source and self-hosting options

Deploy in Cal.com Cloud or self-host for maximum control. Review code, customize workflows, and meet data residency policies without vendor lock-in.

### Developer-first APIs and webhooks

Connect to case management, payments, and document verification. Trigger events on booking, reschedule, or completion to update external systems and move applications forward.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows help reduce no-shows for inspections?

Workflows send timed reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp with preparation checklists. You can include site access notes, permit documents, and reschedule links so inspectors and applicants stay aligned.

Can we route by jurisdiction and permit type?

Yes. Use routing rules and intake questions to direct appointments by address, municipality, or permit category, ensuring the correct office and staff receive the booking.

How does Cal.com support the business license application process?

Create event types for intake reviews, document checks, and issuance. Automate reminders with required documents and trigger follow-ups or fee notices after each step.

What about building permit requirements that vary by project?

Add conditional questions to collect project scope and materials. Tailor reminders with specific requirements, attach checklists, and route to specialized reviewers or inspectors.

Can Cal.com replace DMV appointment alternatives for our services?

For services with limited walk-ins, create self-serve booking pages and queue alternatives. Residents select a time, get reminders, and can reschedule, reducing congestion and frustration.

Is self-hosting available for government environments?

Yes. Cal.com supports self-hosting, letting agencies control data, meet residency policies, and pass security reviews while keeping all scheduling functionality available.

How do we integrate with our case management system?

Use Cal.com’s API and webhooks to sync appointment data, statuses, and notes. Trigger updates on confirmation or completion to advance cases without manual data entry.

# Automate client scheduling and follow-ups for personal trainers

Cut no-shows, standardize intake, and scale your coaching with automated, flexible workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Automated workflow email reminder for a personal training session asking the client to confirm attendance.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ocWzCDMXVtgWp4KPzUxsMepM320.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows power a modern fitness business

Connect your tools, set rules, and let automation handle the admin. Cal.com orchestrates bookings, reminders, intake, and follow-ups so you can focus on client results. Learn more in the docs at https://cal.com/docs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect your calendars and define event types

Start by connecting Google, Outlook, or iCloud calendars so availability stays accurate. Create event types like intro consults, assessments, and recurring training sessions. Add buffers, locations, and payment collection. Use routing forms to qualify leads and send them to the right slot or coach. If you need advanced control, configure everything via the API at https://cal.com/docs, or self-host from https://github.com/calcom/cal.com for full ownership.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate intake, reminders, and check-ins

Replace manual forms and messages with automated steps. Trigger a fitness client intake form after booking to capture goals, injuries, and preferences. Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp reminders to cut no-shows. Start a client check in process before each session to confirm attendance and readiness. After sessions, request feedback and progress updates automatically. Cal.com keeps clients informed, on time, and accountable without extra work for your team.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Sync follow-ups and data to your tools

When a session is booked, rescheduled, or completed, send data to your CRM, spreadsheets, and messaging apps. Push details to Google Sheets for a progress tracking sheet fitness workflow, or to Notion and Slack for coach visibility. Share links to your workout program template and meal plan template fitness libraries in automated messages. Explore integrations at https://cal.com/integrations and get help at https://help.cal.com.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

## Benefits that grow your training business

Automated scheduling, clear communication, and unified data help trainers deliver better client outcomes while reducing admin. Cal.com gives you open, developer friendly infrastructure that adapts to your model.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile SMS reminder preview for a personal training session with attendee response status.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/lCUDUOHVQJi4tqkNAviXbbWxSo.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce no-shows and late cancellations

Automated reminders across email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients on track. Require confirmations, set cutoff rules, and add buffers so your day runs smoothly. Clients receive the right message at the right time, which lowers missed sessions and protects your calendar.

02

### Standardize intake and safety

Send a fitness client intake form after every new booking, capture PAR-Q style health information, and route clients to the appropriate coach or session type. Maintain consistent data collection for goals, injuries, and experience so each session starts safe and personalized.

![Bookings dashboard showing scheduled personal training sessions, assessments, and nutrition check-ins.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/4c5csIXmN4l1sjsPPWOKzgoXiBU.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Scale programs without extra admin

Use automations to deliver links to your workout program template and meal plan template fitness resources, then collect adherence and readiness data before sessions. Centralize follow-ups and progress updates so coaches spend more time coaching and less time chasing messages.

04

### Own your data with open infrastructure

Cal.com is open source and API first. Self-host for compliance or branding control, or use our hosted platform. Integrate with your stack, keep data portable, and avoid vendor lock-in. See pricing at https://cal.com/pricing and security info at https://cal.com/security.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How do workflows help reduce client no-shows?

You can schedule reminders by time offset, require confirmations, and send multi channel nudges. If a client does not confirm, trigger a follow up or free the slot. All logic is configurable in the workflow builder or via API.

Can I customize a fitness client intake form?

Yes. Use routing forms to collect health history, goals, injuries, and preferences. Store responses, route clients to the right coach, and trigger different workflows based on answers. See examples in https://help.cal.com.

How do I manage recurring sessions for clients?

Create recurring event types or let clients book a series. Workflows can send prep notes, program links, and check ins before each occurrence, then follow up for adherence and recovery after each session.

Can I attach program and nutrition resources automatically?

Yes. Include links to your workout program template and meal plan template fitness in confirmation or reminder messages. You can personalize by event type or client responses using variables and conditional workflows.

How do I track progress across clients and coaches?

Send session outcomes to Google Sheets or Notion to build a progress tracking sheet fitness view. Automate weekly check ins, collect RPE and measurements, and notify coaches in Slack. Use webhooks for custom dashboards.

Does Cal.com support payments and policies?

Yes. Collect payment at booking with Stripe, set cancellation windows, and send automated receipts and policy reminders. You control buffers, reschedule rules, and no show fees per event type.

Is self hosting available for compliance needs?

Yes. Cal.com is open source. You can self host for data control and compliance, and still use the full workflow engine. Review the repository at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com and docs at https://cal.com/docs.
