## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com support a telehealth onboarding workflow?

You can collect demographics, consent, insurance, and reason for visit with conditional forms. Responses trigger routing, eligibility checks, and reminders before a slot is confirmed.

Can we triage patients based on symptoms and licensure rules?

Yes. Build telemedicine patient triage rules to route by symptom category, state licensure, language, risk score, and schedule priority, ensuring the right clinician is assigned.

How do reminders reduce no-shows for virtual visits?

Automate confirmations, time-based reminders, and prep instructions via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Include secure join links and device checks to lower drop-off.

Can we manage a remote patient scheduling flow across multiple clinics?

Yes. Create provider pools per clinic or specialty, apply availability and buffer policies, and centralize routing so every location follows consistent rules.

Is Cal.com compatible with HIPAA requirements?

Cal.com offers self-hosting and strict access controls. You can configure encryption, audit logging, SSO, and data residency to align with your telehealth compliance checklist.

Do you support group therapy or caregiver joins?

Yes. Multi-party events enable caregivers, interpreters, or supervisors with role-based invites and personalized communications for each participant.

Can developers manage workflows programmatically?

Absolutely. Use the API to create events, update participants, trigger workflows, and receive webhooks for booking, reschedule, and cancellation events.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How can Cal.com help telehealth support teams?

Cal.com automates scheduling, reminders, and follow-ups for virtual care helpdesks, reducing admin work and improving remote healthcare support.

Is Cal.com suitable for online patient assistance?

Yes. Cal.com is designed for telehealth workflows, helping teams set up and manage virtual care helpdesks and technical support.

Can we send reminders for telemedicine technical support sessions?

Yes. Use SMS, email, or WhatsApp reminders to notify patients and staff about upcoming appointments.

Does Cal.com work for remote healthcare support teams?

Absolutely. Cal.com supports remote healthcare support, making it simple to coordinate virtual appointments and send reminders.

Is my patient data secure with Cal.com?

Cal.com offers HIPAA-ready options and self-hosting for secure telehealth support scheduling.

Can I integrate Cal.com with other healthcare platforms?

Yes. Cal.com’s API-first architecture lets you connect with EHRs or other telemedicine tools.

How fast can I set up a virtual care helpdesk workflow?

You can launch automated telehealth support workflows in minutes with Cal.com’s easy setup.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help telemedicine startups automate scheduling?

Cal.com enables telemedicine startups to automate patient booking, reminders and follow-ups with customizable workflows.

Is patient data secure when using Cal.com?

Yes. Cal.com offers self-hosted solutions so online healthcare startups can keep all data private and compliant.

Can we integrate Cal.com with our existing digital health platform?

Yes. Cal.com provides a robust API and supports integrations with major healthcare and telehealth tools.

Do patients get reminders for virtual care appointments?

Yes. Patients receive automated SMS, email or WhatsApp reminders for upcoming appointments.

Can Cal.com handle group telehealth sessions?

Yes. Cal.com supports both 1:1 and group scheduling for virtual care teams.

Is Cal.com suitable for startups and growing digital health platforms?

Absolutely. Cal.com scales with your needs and offers flexible deployment options.

How quickly can we launch Cal.com for our telemedicine workflow?

You can get started in minutes with Cal.com’s simple setup and onboarding.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

What makes Cal.com different from other staffing scheduling tools?

Cal.com is open-source and API-first, allowing temp staffing platforms to fully customize workflows, integrate with existing systems, and self-host for total data control. Unlike closed platforms, you get unmatched flexibility and scalability.

Can Cal.com handle high-volume, multi-location scheduling for large agencies?

Yes. Cal.com supports multi-user and multi-location bookings, group scheduling, and can automate thousands of appointments per day. This is ideal for the best temp staffing services and agencies managing high demand.

How do reminders and notifications help reduce no-shows?

Automated reminders via SMS, email, or WhatsApp keep candidates and clients informed and accountable. Agencies using Cal.com have seen significant drops in no-shows and improved placement reliability.

Can we brand all communication sent to candidates and clients?

Absolutely. Cal.com allows full customization of all messages, including your logo, colors, and wording. Every touchpoint reflects your agency’s professionalism and brand identity.

Does Cal.com integrate with our ATS or job board?

Yes, Cal.com provides a robust API and webhook system. You can connect directly to your ATS, CRM, or any external job portal to automate scheduling and keep your workflows in sync.

Is Cal.com suitable for on demand staffing apps and platforms?

Definitely. Cal.com’s flexible, API-driven infrastructure is ideal for on demand staffing apps, supporting rapid candidate placement, shift management, and real-time scheduling updates.

How secure is candidate and client data with Cal.com?

You can self-host Cal.com for maximum data privacy, meeting strict client and regulatory requirements. All communication is encrypted, and data access is tightly controlled.

# Automate campus scheduling with workflows for universities and colleges

Streamline the university admissions process, campus tour checklist, student orientation ideas, and the academic advising workflow with flexible, API driven workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com, showing a trigger to send an email reminder to attendees 24 hours before a campus tour starts. The action section includes a customizable email template asking students to confirm attendance, with variables for date, time, organizer, location, and a confirmation button.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/dF1qMHQLDHnPU06hJREZd8uiT0.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works for universities and colleges

Cal.com turns complex academic scheduling into simple, configurable workflows. Connect your calendars, video tools, and forms, then define logic that fits each department. Developers can extend everything with our API and webhooks.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars, conferencing, and policies

Connect Google or Microsoft calendars, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and more in minutes via the Cal.com marketplace (https://cal.com/marketplace). Set guardrails that match campus policy, including booking windows by term, buffers before and after meetings, working hours across time zones, and limits per day. Add intake forms to capture program, student ID, or applicant status, and route based on responses. Admissions staff can publish a single booking page for interviews, while facilities teams manage capacity for tours. Everything stays in sync with your calendars, so double bookings and time conflicts are prevented.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Model academic scheduling workflows

Model each academic flow with reusable event types and workflow templates. For the university admissions process, route applicants by program or interviewer seniority, then auto schedule interviews and decision calls. For tours, use your campus tour checklist to assign guides and rooms. For student orientation ideas like multi track sessions, create group events with capacity limits and automatic reminders. Advisors can standardize the academic advising workflow, from intake to follow up. Even the degree audit process and registrar office procedures benefit from automated confirmations, reminders, and escalations that keep students on track.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Automate messaging, routing, and handoffs

Automate messaging and internal handoffs without manual effort. Use Cal.com Workflows to send branded email, SMS, or WhatsApp confirmations, reminders, and post event follow ups triggered by bookings, reschedules, and cancellations (https://cal.com/docs/workflows). Notify Slack channels for high priority applicants, post webhook payloads to your SIS or CRM, and update spreadsheets or data warehouses through the API (https://cal.com/docs/api). Access logs and controls your IT team expects, including SSO and role based access, with details on our security page (https://cal.com/security).

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Key benefits for higher education scheduling

Cal.com helps universities reduce administrative load, increase show rates, and deliver a consistent experience to applicants, students, faculty, and staff.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder notification on a mobile device for a campus tour, with a reminder message and attendee profile pictures indicating their response status.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ZAgvQkpK7oz4EYfYb0CMc7NjJiw.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Accelerate the admissions pipeline

Move applicants from inquiry to enrolled faster. Replace back and forth emails with instant booking links that respect interviewer availability, time zones, and program specific rules. Use routing forms to qualify prospects, send high priority candidates to senior staff, and balance load with round robin assignment. Automate reminders to reduce no shows, and collect the information reviewers need upfront. Cal.com plugs into Zoom or Teams for virtual interviews, and embeds on your website or portal so the experience feels native. By streamlining the university admissions process, your team spends more time evaluating fit and less time chasing calendars.

02

### Improve student success and advising

Enhance advising outcomes with a reliable academic advising workflow. Create separate event types for drop in hours, graduation checks, and transfer evaluations, each with the right meeting length, buffers, and forms. Trigger reminders for students who need to complete paperwork before a session, and send follow ups that include resources and next steps. Advisors can also automate nudges tied to the degree audit process, so students book time to resolve holds or select courses. Integrated conferencing and calendar sync keep everyone aligned, while accessibility friendly booking pages support all learners.

![Image of a bookings dashboard displaying scheduled admissions interviews, campus tours, orientation sessions, and advising appointments with dates, times, event titles, and participant profile pictures.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fqRX4OAjMtmY5eW56bwCHDnVrgc.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Reduce risk with control and compliance

Maintain control over data and operations. Cal.com is open source and supports self hosting, giving universities options for data residency and custom deployment. Enable SSO to enforce central authentication and manage access by department and role. Detailed audit logs, configurable data retention, and encryption help IT meet internal standards. Review our approach at https://cal.com/security and explore the code on GitHub at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com. With fewer manual steps, staff reduce errors and protect sensitive information tied to applicants and students.

04

### Build once, reuse across departments

Scale consistent scheduling across admissions, advising, registrar, housing, and more. Build templates once, then share them with departments to speed rollout and preserve best practices. Our API first architecture lets developers create event types, routing rules, and workflows programmatically, or sync metadata with your SIS and CRM. Use the platform to streamline registrar office procedures like transcript pickups and graduation appointments, then reuse the same patterns for campus events. See developer docs at https://cal.com/docs/api and enterprise options at https://cal.com/enterprise.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can we self host Cal.com to meet university data policies?

Yes. Cal.com supports self hosting with the same core features as our cloud service, so IT can control data residency and deployment. Review security details at https://cal.com/security and explore the code at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.

How do we support the university admissions process with routing?

Use routing forms to capture program, location, and priority, then auto assign interviews with round robin or direct routing. Add interviewer pools by department and publish a single booking link for applicants.

Does Cal.com integrate with our SIS or CRM?

Yes. Use our API and webhooks to sync bookings, attendees, and metadata with your SIS or CRM. You can also connect popular tools through the marketplace (https://cal.com/marketplace) or middleware like Zapier.

Can we manage group events for campus tours and orientation?

Yes. Create group events with capacity limits, time slots, and automated reminders. Assign hosts, add intake questions, and track attendance from a single dashboard.

How do advisors manage recurring availability across multiple terms?

Define schedules by term, campus, or program. Set booking windows, buffers, and time zone rules. Advisors can offer distinct links for drop in hours and appointments, each with tailored forms.

Can we collect payments for events like continuing education?

Yes. Connect Stripe from the marketplace to collect payments or deposits when a session is booked. Enable per event pricing and issue refunds through your Stripe account.

What security features help IT and the registrar office?

Cal.com offers SSO, role based access controls, audit logs, encryption in transit and at rest, and self hosting options. Learn more at https://cal.com/security.

# Automate veterinary scheduling and client communication with workflows

Reduce phone tag, prevent no-shows, and standardize care instructions across your clinic with configurable scheduling workflows.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of a veterinary workflow showing a 24 hour pre appointment email reminder with confirmation request, including pet name, doctor, location, and parking notes.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/oqWpeAbj3sefQvuFrVauo789pSE.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works for veterinary clinics

Configure workflows that automate reminders, triage steps, and post visit follow-ups while syncing with your calendars and practice tools.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Set your clinical triggers

Choose when a workflow starts, such as when a client books online, 24 hours before an appointment, at curbside check in, or when a status changes in your veterinary triage protocol. Trigger actions for new, rescheduled, or canceled appointments, and for time based events like vaccines coming due.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Define actions across channels

Send branded email, SMS, or WhatsApp messages for confirmations and reminders. Use webhooks to post to Slack or your practice apps, and create tasks for techs. Auto send forms such as your vet patient intake form, curbside check in process vet instructions, and post op care instructions vet.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize and scale safely

Use dynamic fields to personalize pet name, doctor, location, and service. Route urgent cases using a simple veterinary triage protocol before the visit. Manage group events like vaccination clinics, and control delivery windows to avoid late night messages.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Why veterinary teams choose Cal.com workflows

Give clients clear instructions, reduce front desk workload, and standardize communication across doctors, techs, and front office staff.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Mobile view of a veterinary appointment reminder SMS with curbside check in instruction and client responses.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bqj2kkXuAl9H5NfFzrNk6S1bQWQ.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut no-shows and late arrivals

Automated confirmations and reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp keep clients on time. Add a 24 hour reminder, a 2 hour SMS, and a 15 minute heads up with parking notes. Share the curbside check in process vet so arrivals are smooth.

02

### Standardize clinical communication

Send the right content at the right time. Share pre visit fasting guidelines, species specific vaccine prep, and post op care instructions vet that match the service booked. Ensure every client receives the same, accurate guidance from your medical team.

![Bookings dashboard showing veterinary appointments like vaccine clinic, surgery prep, wellness exams, and intake sessions.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/6blp06PxwGycfdeoYkd0RoTOMA.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Route urgent cases faster

Ask brief questions at booking to route emergencies and time sensitive issues using your veterinary triage protocol. Escalate with instant alerts to the on call vet, and provide self service reschedule links for non urgent visits.

04

### Free up your front desk

Move routine calls to automated flows. Collect a vet patient intake form before arrival, push vaccine reminder workflow messages at the right intervals, and send check out follow ups and review requests without manual effort.

![Editor showing a branded veterinary reminder email template with subject confirming pet arrival date.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/sNkE0AAPJogrSKCi78ixKUumfQ.png?width=2432&height=1752)

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can we customize reminders for different services like surgery, vaccines, and wellness exams?

Yes. Create service specific workflows with different timing, messaging, and channels. For example, send fasting instructions before surgery, a vaccine reminder workflow for due dates, and a simple day of reminder for wellness exams.

How do we collect a vet patient intake form before the appointment?

Attach your intake form to the booking confirmation workflow. Send a link via email or SMS immediately after booking and add auto reminders if it is not completed.

Can workflows support a veterinary triage protocol for urgent cases?

Yes. Add routing questions at booking or send a quick pre visit triage form. Based on responses, notify your team in Slack or email, and redirect clients to call the clinic for emergencies.

Do you support curbside check in for busy hours or parking lot service?

Yes. Send the curbside check in process vet instructions in the reminder, include a link to tap when they arrive, and notify staff via webhook or Slack to come outside.

Can we automate post visit messaging like medications and post op care instructions?

Yes. Trigger messages when the appointment ends. Send post op care instructions vet, medication reminders, and recheck scheduling links at set intervals.

What about multi location clinics and doctor specific availability?

Use routing forms and round robin to route by location, species, or doctor. Cal.com supports pooled availability and resource assignment for rooms and equipment.

Is there an API to manage workflows and can we self host?

Yes. Cal.com is API first. Manage workflows via the API at https://cal.com/docs. You can self host from https://github.com/calcom/cal.com. See help at https://help.cal.com.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com automate the virtual doctor visit process?

Cal.com triggers and automates reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups to streamline every step of the telemedicine appointment process.

Can I customize notifications for my virtual care workflow?

Yes, you can fully customize messages for each step of your online doctor appointment workflow.

Is Cal.com secure and compliant for healthcare use?

Cal.com supports privacy and allows self-hosting so your virtual doctor operations can comply with regulations.

Can I integrate Cal.com with my existing healthcare systems?

Yes, thanks to the API-first architecture, you can connect Cal.com to your EMR or practice management tools.

Does Cal.com support group virtual care sessions?

Yes, you can automate scheduling for individual or group telemedicine appointments.

Can I automate follow-up messages after appointments?

You can send automatic post-visit surveys or instructions to patients as part of your virtual care workflow.

Is Cal.com suitable for clinics of any size?

Cal.com scales for solo practitioners, group practices, and enterprise virtual doctor operations.

Workflows for wealth management firms

# Automate client scheduling for wealth and investment management teams

Reduce no shows, streamline compliance, and personalize touchpoints across client reviews, onboarding, and investor meetings.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for a wealth management review, showing a 24 hour reminder email with disclosure text and confirmation button.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/NxLND2jCdoo9KofjKMF90fzLQ.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Spin up compliant, personalized scheduling workflows across your firm. Non technical teams use a visual builder. Developers manage everything via API, webhooks, and config, with SOC 2 and self hosting options.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars and define event types

Connect Google, Microsoft, and Apple calendars, then create event types for reviews, onboarding, and portfolio updates. Set durations, buffer times, time zones, and availability for each advisor and team.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Add compliance and communication steps

Insert pre meeting forms for KYC, risk tolerance, and consent. Add disclosures, document links, and multi channel reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp, tailored to client segments and event types.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Launch, measure, and optimize

Publish booking links or embed in your site. Route prospects and clients to the right advisor. Track show rates and cycle time, iterate reminders and questions, and sync data to your CRM via webhooks.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for wealth and advisory teams

Deliver consistent, compliant client experiences while reducing manual work. Cal.com brings open source flexibility, API first control, and enterprise security to modern advisory operations.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a wealth management portfolio review on a mobile device, with attendee responses displayed.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/fIQRK8qXGbAcClaxATIo9ccqbhs.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Cut no shows and delays

Automated email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders keep client reviews on track. Intelligent buffers protect prep time, and time zone handling prevents confusion. Clients book in a few clicks, so your team spends less time chasing confirmations and reschedules. When prospects search financial advisors near me, your embedded scheduler converts that intent into confirmed meetings without back and forth.

02

### Personalize every client touchpoint

Tailor workflows for new prospects, existing households, and high net worth wealth management relationships. Ask the right questions up front, from investment objectives to scheduling preferences. Add custom messages and branding for each team or office, and provide clear next steps with confirmations, directions, virtual meeting links, and post meeting follow ups aligned to your client journey.

![Image of a bookings dashboard for wealth management, listing discovery calls, quarterly reviews, and onboarding sessions by day.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0hEgyv8n7KWwdPxpvJR0EJC3DJw.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Build compliant, auditable processes

Insert required disclosures, consent capture, and document links before clients can confirm. Store responses with timestamps, and maintain an audit trail of reminders and changes. Standardize who can book which event types, set cancellation windows, and record communication history to support supervision and quality reviews across investment management services.

04

### Scale firm wide with open infrastructure

Roll out consistent scheduling across branches, specialists, and partners. Our open source platform supports self hosting, so data can remain in your cloud. Use our API first architecture to route meetings, enforce policies, and sync data to your systems, without locking your firm into a proprietary tool or rigid workflow.

![Template editor showing branded email subject for a wealth management portfolio review reminder, with editable variables for date and client name.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/cAPHAy5EKLknKJIzp5lF4eoe2Q.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features designed for advisory operations

Everything you need to automate scheduling in a regulated environment, from routing and reminders to audit trails, data controls, and developer tooling.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi channel reminders and confirmations

Automate branded emails, SMS, and WhatsApp with timing rules for different client segments, event types, and time zones.

### Routing, round robin, and pooled availability

Send prospects to the right advisor by expertise, licensing, or location. Support round robin distribution and pooled calendars for fast response.

### Disclosures and document steps

Require clients to view or acknowledge ADV, Form CRS, or fee schedules before confirming. Attach links, PDFs, and custom text.

### Client data controls

Collect only what you need via forms, mask sensitive fields, and configure retention rules to align with compliance and security requirements.

### API first and webhooks

Create and manage workflows programmatically. Sync bookings, updates, and form responses to your CRM or data warehouse in real time.

### Self hosting and SSO

Run Cal.com in your own cloud for maximum control. Enable SSO, SCIM, and granular permissions to manage users at scale.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com support fee only financial advisor workflows?

Yes. You can configure event types, disclosures, and fee explanations specific to a fee only financial advisor model, then automate confirmations, reminders, and follow ups with firm approved language.

How does Cal.com help with compliance and audit needs?

Cal.com offers SOC 2 aligned controls, role based access, audit logs, and configurable retention. Add consent steps, disclosures, and required fields to bookings, and self host to keep data in your environment.

Can we route high net worth prospects to senior advisors?

Yes. Use routing forms and rules to assign high net worth wealth management inquiries to senior advisors based on assets, location, language, or availability, with round robin for pooled teams.

Do you integrate with our CRM and portfolio systems?

Cal.com connects to major tools via native integrations, webhooks, and no code connectors like Zapier and Make. Sync contacts, meetings, and form data to your CRM and trigger downstream workflows.

How do reminders work across email and SMS?

Workflows let you schedule multi step reminders and confirmations via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Customize timing and content by event type and audience, and include meeting links or directions.

Can we host Cal.com in our own cloud?

Yes. Cal.com is open source and supports self hosting. Deploy in your preferred cloud, maintain control of data, and integrate with your SSO and security stack.

How do developers manage workflows at scale?

Use our API to create, update, and retrieve workflows, event types, and bookings. Subscribe to webhooks for lifecycle events, and manage configuration as code across environments.

## How Cal.com supports your agency process

Cal.com integrates into your website project management workflow in just a few clicks.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

# Automate wedding planning workflows to book, remind, and coordinate

Streamline vendor coordination, client communication, and timelines with flexible scheduling automation built for wedding planners.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of a Cal.com workflow sending a wedding reminder email 24 hours before an event.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/BKSJzSn1jbNTHugpG1cijuLe2I.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com workflows power wedding planning

From inquiry to sparkler exit, keep every detail on schedule.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Create bookable event types for planning stages

Set up event types for discovery calls, venue tours, vendor meetings, design reviews, rehearsal, and the wedding day. Use routing forms to qualify leads, capture preferences, and align availability. Share links in your proposals and your client onboarding wedding planner packet. Attach documents like a wedding planning checklist and a wedding budget spreadsheet via links so couples can access everything in one place. Learn more about event types and routing at https://help.cal.com and https://cal.com/docs.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Automate reminders across channels

Reduce no-shows by scheduling email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders for couples, family, and vendors. Send confirmations instantly, add countdown reminders the week and day before, and follow up with thank you notes. Build conditional workflows that notify the florist with setup times while sending a different reminder to the DJ with arrival and soundcheck details. See how workflows operate at https://cal.com/docs and explore apps at https://cal.com/marketplace.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Connect tools, track changes, and scale

Keep calendars synced for every planner on your team. Connect Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, and Slack to centralize updates. When a time shifts, Cal.com automatically adjusts reminders and alerts the right stakeholders through webhooks. Developers can extend the flow using our API-first architecture. Self-host if you need full control and compliance. Explore the API at https://cal.com/docs/api, marketplace apps at https://cal.com/marketplace, and self-hosting at https://cal.com/self-hosted.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for modern wedding planning teams

Deliver a polished client experience while reducing manual work and stress.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Never miss vendor deadlines

Create a reusable vendor timeline template wedding vendors can follow. Trigger setup and teardown instructions at the right moments, and keep the day of wedding timeline on track. If anything changes, workflows notify vendors automatically, preventing delays and last-minute confusion.

02

### Professional client onboarding

Make the first impression count. Build an intake flow that routes packages, locations, and budgets to the right planner. Share your wedding planning checklist, contracts, and payment links in automated confirmations. Use reminder sequences to collect missing details during client onboarding wedding planner stages without manual chasing.

![Bookings dashboard showing wedding events for today and this week.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/GTKV3qQiiwmYVQN9DCb3HrQbA.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Reduce no-shows and last-minute chaos

Smart reminders confirm attendance, share parking info, and include prep checklists. If a vendor or guest reschedules, Cal.com updates the invite and messages everyone affected. You get fewer panicked calls and a smoother run of show on rehearsal and wedding day.

04

### Own your data and brand

Cal.com is open source and API-first. Customize templates, white-label booking pages, and control your data. Self-host for privacy and compliance needs, and integrate with your CRM, storage, and communication tools. See enterprise options at https://cal.com/enterprise and the code at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com handle day of wedding timeline reminders?

Yes. Create timeline events for rehearsal, load-in, ceremony, and reception. Add timed reminders for vendors, the couple, and family with role-based messages and dynamic fields. Cal.com updates reminders if times change.

How do I manage vendor communications in one place?

Use workflows to send vendor-specific briefs, arrival windows, and location details by email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Connect Slack for internal alerts and track confirmations. Centralize everything with apps from https://cal.com/marketplace.

Can I customize client onboarding for different packages?

Yes. Use routing forms to segment by package, venue, and budget. Trigger unique confirmation pages, prep questionnaires, and payment or contract links. You can add package-specific timelines and reminders automatically.

Does Cal.com integrate with my existing tools?

Cal.com integrates with Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud, Zoom, Teams, Slack, and more. Use Zapier or webhooks to connect CRMs like HubSpot and Airtable. Developers can extend workflows via API at https://cal.com/docs/api.

Is there a way to share a wedding planning checklist with clients?

Attach links to your wedding planning checklist in confirmations and reminders. Embed your checklist app in confirmation pages or use webhooks to update tasks as meetings are booked or rescheduled.

Can I self-host Cal.com for my agency?

Yes. You can deploy Cal.com on your own infrastructure, maintain full control of data, and customize as needed. Learn more at https://cal.com/self-hosted and review the repository at https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.

How secure is guest and vendor data?

Cal.com uses industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. You can enable SSO and granular access controls. For advanced needs, explore enterprise features at https://cal.com/enterprise.

# Automate client care with workflows for wellness coaches

Reduce no shows, streamline habit coaching, and personalize touchpoints across your wellness coaching programs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for a wellness coach, showing a 24 hour pre session email reminder with branded content and session details.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hNpK11WCkTi6cx7TUzySyvSLU.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How Cal.com Workflows support wellness coaching

Set up flexible automations that guide clients from discovery to sustained behavior change.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Capture leads and qualify clients

Use routing forms to segment leads by goals, location, and program fit, then automatically route to the right holistic health coach or corporate wellness coaching path.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Onboard and schedule the right sessions

Trigger welcome messages, collect intake data, and schedule assessments, 1 to 1 sessions, and group classes, all aligned to the client’s plan and availability.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Nurture, measure, and retain

Send timely reminders, habit check ins, and follow ups across email, SMS, and WhatsApp to reduce churn and improve outcomes for every online wellness coach.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for wellness coaches

Turn first interest into long term engagement with automated but personal client communication throughout the coaching journey.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com wellness coaching reminder on a mobile device, with attendee response status for an upcoming session.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AGX8TiUmsProPohJaaq1gAeBaqs.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Increase show rates and reduce churn

Automated confirmations, reminders, and reschedule flows dramatically cut no shows across assessments, coaching calls, and group sessions. Cal.com Workflows support email, SMS, and WhatsApp, so clients get nudges where they pay attention. Send pre session prep, link waivers, and share location or video details. After sessions, trigger notes and next steps to keep momentum. For wellness coaching programs, these timely touchpoints help clients follow through, strengthen trust, and steadily improve adherence to plans.

02

### Personalize every client journey at scale

Create branching workflows based on client goals, program tier, attendance history, or corporate wellness coaching requirements. New stress management clients can receive a weekly check in, while nutrition focused members get daily reminders near mealtimes. Use variables and templates to keep communication personal without manual typing. Your brand, tone, and cadence remain consistent while each client gets exactly what they need.

![Image of a bookings dashboard showing wellness assessments, group classes, and habit coaching sessions organized under Today and Tomorrow.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/l0ez1sua07qvP0XAsK2oirgJw.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Streamline operations and reclaim coaching time

Replace repetitive admin with automated scheduling, intake collection, payment confirmations, and post session follow ups. Connect calendars, video, and chat tools to eliminate friction. Use tags and triggers to coordinate multi coach teams, round robin assignments, and group cohorts. With manual tasks handled in the background, you can focus on coaching, content creation, and client outcomes, not chasing messages.

04

### Prove progress and grow recurring revenue

Automate progress check ins and reactivation campaigns to maintain engagement beyond the first month. Nurture former clients with value based touchpoints and timely offers for renewals, higher tier packages, or seasonal wellness coaching programs. Use data driven triggers, such as missed sessions or plan completion, to send the right message at the right time and improve lifetime value.

![Image of a branded email template for a wellness coaching check in, showing a subject customized with the client’s session date.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Y5YCFVHMwPovaIvQEjJDNanRcBo.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for modern coaching teams

Open source flexibility, API first architecture, and enterprise grade controls give you the freedom to design scheduling that fits your practice today and scales tomorrow.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Routing forms and lead qualification

Segment by goals, readiness, budget, and employer program, then route to the best coach, group, or cohort.

### Multi channel reminders and follow ups

Send emails, SMS, and WhatsApp messages with branded templates and dynamic variables for context.

### Flexible triggers and conditions

Start workflows on booking, reschedule, cancel, or time based checkpoints before and after sessions.

### Packages, cohorts, and group events

Automate multi session packages, recurring classes, and cohort programs with attendance aware messaging.

### Integrations and webhooks

Connect video tools, CRMs, Slack, Stripe, and EHR like systems via integrations, webhooks, and the Cal.com API.

### Self hosting and admin controls

Choose hosted or self hosted, with SSO, role based permissions, and granular data retention settings.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can Cal.com support complex wellness coaching programs with cohorts and packages?

Yes. Use event types for packages, recurring series, and group sessions. Workflows can automate reminders, prep materials, and follow ups per attendee and per session.

How do I route leads to the right holistic health coach?

Use routing forms to collect goals and preferences, then auto assign to the right coach or calendar based on rules like specialty, availability, or location.

Can I send habit coaching check ins by SMS and WhatsApp?

Yes. Workflows support email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Configure timing and content, then personalize with variables such as client name, coach, and session details.

Does Cal.com work for corporate wellness coaching?

Yes. Create employer specific booking pages, route employees based on benefit tier, and automate reporting touchpoints and attendance reminders for cohorts.

How does Cal.com handle intake and consent?

Attach pre session forms, waivers, or links in booking confirmations and reminders. Trigger follow ups if forms are incomplete before the session.

Can I integrate with my CRM or notes app?

Yes. Use native integrations, Zapier, and webhooks, or the API to sync contacts, deals, notes, and outcomes with your existing systems.

Is Cal.com secure for client data?

Cal.com offers encryption in transit and at rest, role based access, SSO, audit logs, and the option to self host for maximum data control.

# Automate scheduling for wellness retreats and spas with workflows

Reduce admin, prevent no‑shows, and deliver serene guest experiences with automated reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups tailored for retreats, spas, and wellness programs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow for a wellness retreat reminder, confirming attendance before arrival.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/OiTLCXQ1LkZIdXCK1VcxHpVoVc.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Build calm, reliable scheduling around every wellness experience.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Connect calendars and create your event types

Sync your team calendars, set up spa day packages and retreat sessions, define availability by location and practitioner, and map buffers for prep, cleanup, and transitions.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Choose triggers and actions for each experience

Trigger workflows on booking, reschedule, or time-based windows. Send email, SMS, or WhatsApp confirmations, intake forms, packing lists, and directions for yoga retreat or meditation retreat arrivals.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize messages and automate follow-ups

Use branded templates for welcome notes, pre-retreat checklists, dietary reminders for detox retreat guests, and post-visit feedback requests. Add webhooks to notify staff in Slack and update CRM.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

## Benefits for wellness retreats and spas

Deliver a consistent, stress-free booking journey for every guest.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AMGdiGiiaoHL7HXIYpwBBdNkujw.png?width=1560&height=1116)

01

### Cut no-shows and late arrivals

Automated reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp reduce missed appointments across spa day packages and multi-day wellness retreats. Include directions, parking details, and check-in instructions. Time messages to local time zones, add calendar invites, and provide quick reschedule links that keep your schedule full without extra back-and-forth.

02

### Elevate the guest experience from first touch

Craft nurturing touchpoints before, during, and after each yoga retreat, meditation retreat, or detox retreat. Send personalized itineraries, packing lists, and dietary guidance. Provide clear expectations for classes and treatments, plus gentle post-session care tips. Guests feel supported and informed at every step, which builds trust and repeat bookings.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/OWQBZtmpRKUQqnGb7W6yXN6doU.png?width=1557&height=1116)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Unify complex retreat schedules with team coordination

Coordinate practitioners, rooms, saunas, and studios with pooled availability and routing forms. Automatically assign bookings to the right therapist or teacher based on service, language, or location. Trigger internal alerts for prep tasks, inventory checks, and room turnover so your team stays aligned while guests enjoy a seamless flow.

04

### Scale with open, API-first scheduling

Cal.com is open source and API-first, giving your retreat center or spa the flexibility to self-host, integrate with your stack, and build custom flows. Connect Stripe for deposits, Zoom for virtual classes, and CRMs for lead nurture. Use webhooks to sync guest data, run waitlists, and automate targeted follow-ups without vendor lock-in.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/EgtNzQuE00PvJhX28LT3Afn1syU.png?width=1040&height=730)

Additional features

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Dj29kSLckc1RzF6ZngkIWClZ3k0.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Features built for modern retreats and spas

Open scheduling infrastructure that adapts to your programs and brand.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Multi-channel reminders

Send confirmations and reminders by email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Include itineraries, intake forms, and directions for each service or retreat session to reduce confusion and no-shows.

### Routing forms and pooled availability

Match guests to the right therapist or teacher based on preferences, modality, or location. Balance workloads across teams and rooms automatically.

### Deposits and payments

Collect deposits or full payments for spa day packages and retreats using Stripe. Automate refund and reschedule policies with clear confirmations.

### Group and multi-session events

Offer cohorts for yoga retreat weeks, meditation retreat circles, or detox retreat programs. Manage recurring sessions and track attendance.

### Open-source and self-hosting

Run Cal.com in your own environment for maximum control. Extend with custom apps, webhooks, and the developer-friendly API to fit unique operations.

### Integrations and webhooks

Connect calendars, CRMs, Slack, Zoom, and data tools. Use webhooks to update rosters, trigger onboarding tasks, and centralize guest feedback.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

Can we handle complex itineraries for multi-day retreats?

Yes. Create multi-session event types with pooled hosts, buffers, and staged reminders. Use workflows to send daily agendas, location notes, and updates for each session in a multi-day itinerary.

How do reminders work for international guests and time zones?

Cal.com automatically respects organizer and attendee time zones. Schedule email, SMS, and WhatsApp reminders relative to the event time so guests receive clear, local-time prompts.

Can we collect deposits for spa day packages and retreats?

Yes. Connect Stripe to accept deposits or full payments during booking. Include policy details in confirmations and automate reminders tied to payment status.

Do workflows support intake forms and dietary preferences?

Yes. Add links to custom intake forms and personalize messages based on responses. Send pre-arrival dietary guidance for detox retreat participants and reminders for allergies or preferences.

What if we need to notify staff across departments?

Use workflows and webhooks to post updates in Slack, update CRMs, or notify facilities for room setup. Automate prep tasks between sessions to keep teams in sync.

Is Cal.com suitable for self-hosting and enterprise compliance?

Yes. Cal.com is open source with self-hosting options and an API-first architecture. Enterprises can deploy privately and integrate with existing security and compliance workflows.

Can we manage waitlists and last-minute openings?

Yes. Use routing forms and webhooks to capture interest and notify guests when slots open. Automate outreach across channels to fill cancellations quickly.

Workflows for youth organizations

# Automate scheduling for youth organizations with Cal.com workflows

Streamline signups, reminders, and coordination for youth programs. Centralize waivers, approvals, and communications while keeping families, mentors, and staff aligned.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

[Contact sales](https://cal.com/demo)

![Dashboard of setting up an automated workflow in Cal.com for a youth program, sending a 24 hour reminder to participants and parents with session details and confirmation.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/XbmJPoOHSL4IT1JHnXShq2dTRg.png?width=3404&height=3952)

Trusted by fast-growing companies around the world

How it works

## How it works

Set up automated workflows that fit your youth organization’s programs, roles, and safety needs.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

01

### Define your events and roles

Create event types for after school program planning, youth mentorship programs, and summer youth programs. Add organizers, volunteers, parents, and participants, then set availability and booking rules for each group.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jMV0GnTjp1bgeAKQCpsb7iKgaI.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

02

### Configure triggers and actions

Choose triggers like booking created, rescheduled, or before event starts. Automate confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups via email, SMS, and WhatsApp, plus internal notifications for staff and volunteers.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jgBRNxKONKnR1RppUsGkxoCUGs.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

03

### Personalize communications and data collection

Customize messages by audience, collect required information, and attach forms or instructions. Use dynamic fields to include program details, consent reminders, and location updates for each session.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5FI4je2XdUNMsXa7hTHLfRG1o.png?scale-down-to=1024&width=1300&height=694)

Key benefits

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FmSEnTtARJ0DHyAZcZRpyA9344.svg?width=24&height=24)

## Benefits for youth organizations

Give coordinators, mentors, and families a reliable scheduling foundation that scales from small clubs to citywide initiatives.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

![Image showing a Cal.com meeting reminder for a youth mentorship session on a mobile device, with attendees and response status.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/dIPs2KUXTSPzzEETG7EGCPiVZQU.png?width=2080&height=1488)

01

### Reduce administrative overhead

Automate repetitive tasks across youth program management. Replace manual signups and scattered reminders with workflows that send confirmations, rosters, and directions automatically, so staff can focus on impact rather than inbox triage.

02

### Improve attendance and engagement

Boost show rates for teen volunteer programs and mentorship sessions with timely, multi channel reminders. Send pre session checklists, transit tips, and guardian notifications to reduce no shows and late arrivals.

![Image of a bookings dashboard for youth programs showing today and tomorrow sessions including tutoring, mentor matches, and volunteer shifts.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/DQnMCoq0TDHnbaHg107WKhZLuk.png?width=2076&height=1488)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/hRr9qtoytjg3c9HWEp2D2W3OlxY.png?width=1560&height=1116)

03

### Standardize safety and compliance

Build repeatable steps around consent, pickups, and safeguarding. Require parent approvals before bookings, send reminders for missing forms, and log communication for audit readiness across after school program planning.

04

### Coordinate complex schedules with ease

Manage rolling cohorts, recurring meetups, and seasonal signups for summer youth programs. Route bookings to the right mentor or coach, balance capacity, and update all stakeholders when plans change.

![Image of a branded communication template for youth organizations, showing a customizable email subject for session reminders.](https://framerusercontent.com/images/KZqiMz6SaTM7htBUcG4C9esnvM.png?width=2432&height=1752)

Additional features

## Features

Developer friendly, flexible, and built for program scale.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

### Role based communications

Target messages to parents, mentors, volunteers, and participants with dynamic content, ensuring each audience receives only what they need, when they need it.

### Multi channel reminders

Send confirmations and reminders via email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Configure timing windows that fit program age groups and transportation realities.

### Consent and form workflows

Gate bookings behind required forms or approvals. Trigger follow ups for missing documents and mark participants as cleared once complete.

### Advanced routing and assignment

Automatically route signups to the best available mentor or location based on tags like language, skill, neighborhood, or capacity.

### Self host or use the cloud

Run Cal.com in the cloud or self host for stricter data residency and compliance needs common to youth serving organizations.

### API first and open source

Extend workflows with APIs and webhooks. Integrate CRMs, messaging platforms, and student information systems using an open, auditable foundation.

## Frequently asked questions

These are some of our most frequently asked questions.

[Get started](https://app.cal.com/signup)

How does Cal.com help with youth program management?

Cal.com centralizes scheduling across programs, locations, and roles. You can automate signups, set capacity, route bookings to mentors, and send multi channel reminders while keeping parents informed.

Can we require parent or guardian consent before a booking is confirmed?

Yes. Use form and approval steps to collect consent before confirming. Workflows can send reminders for missing forms and restrict attendance until requirements are met.

How do we handle after school program planning across multiple locations?

Create event types per site, set capacity and hours, and enable routing rules. Staff can receive internal notifications and rosters automatically before each session.

Do workflows support youth mentorship programs with matching logic?

Yes. Use tags and routing to match mentees to mentors by availability, interests, language, or location, and keep both sides updated with personalized communications.

Can volunteers manage their own availability for teen volunteer programs?

Volunteers can connect calendars, set availability, and receive assignments automatically. Workflows notify them about shifts, changes, and required check ins or training.

What if our organization needs to self host for compliance?

Cal.com supports self hosting with the same workflow capabilities. This helps organizations meet data residency or policy requirements while retaining full control.

How do we manage seasonal spikes like summer youth programs?

Clone event templates, adjust capacity, and schedule reminders at scale. Use bulk configuration via API to prep sessions, cohorts, and staff assignments in minutes.
